title: Salesforce announces plans to acquire Cresta, a provider of AI-powered contact center automation software; source: Salesforce agreed to pay $2.7B for Cresta (The Information)
title_en: Salesforce announces plans to acquire Cresta, a provider of AI-powered contact center automation software; source: Salesforce agreed to pay $2.7B for Cresta (The Information)
author: The Information
content_snippet: Salesforce extended its recent shopping spree, announcing on Monday plans to acquire Cresta, a nine-year-old provider of AI-powered contact center automation software.
summary_en: Salesforce announced plans to acquire AI contact center automation software provider Cresta for $2.7 billion to bolster its enterprise AI customer service capabilities amid growing market competition.

title: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
title_en: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Apple’s stockpiling of inventory, particularly computer memory, continued in its fiscal fourth quarter, according to earnings reported Monday. The company reported that its inventory increased significantly in the quarter, growing from $11.09 billion in Q3 to $14.54 billion in Q4, a jump of 31.1%. Year-over-year, inventory grew 154.3% from $5.72 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025.

Apple’s forecast of a 45% to 46% gross margin in the December quarter was largely attributed to the impact of higher memory costs. The company reported a gross margin of 47.9% for the September quarter.

“What we’re seeing with memory pricing right now is unprecedented,” said Apple CEO John Ternus, speaking to analysts on the call. “As we said earlier in the September quarter, we did see higher memory costs as compared to the June quarter, which were partly offset by the benefit of carrying inventory and lower costs on certain non-memory components.”

He said that the company expected “even higher memory costs” in the December quarter, which would be partially offset by price increases implemented earlier this year on some devices, including Mac and iPad at the end of June and iPhones in September.

Ternus also said that beyond December, Apple expects memory costs “continuing to increase.”

“As we said before, we do believe we’ll see a decreasing benefit from the carry-in inventory on memory over time,” he noted, adding that the company was increasing its purchases of this key component. “As we work to improve supply, our manufacturing purchase obligations have increased by 33 billion dollars from June to the September quarter, which you’ll see in our annual filing when it comes out tomorrow.”

Apple also brought COO Sabih Khan, who oversees the company’s supply chain and manufacturing, onto the call to address questions about memory. He reiterated the increased purchase obligations but did not rule out future price increases on Apple devices.

title_zh: 苹果高管警告内存成本持续飙升，库存激增超145%
summary_zh: 苹果高管John Ternus在财报电话会议上透露内存成本将在12月及以后继续上涨，第四季度库存暴增至145.4亿美元

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 苹果高管John Ternus在最近的财报电话会议上向分析师透露，公司第四季度库存同比飙升154.3%达到145.4亿美元，主要是由于疯狂囤积计算机内存。由于当前内存价格涨幅空前，苹果预计12月季度的毛利率将受到内存成本走高的拖累，而这也解释了为何此前Mac、iPad和iPhone纷纷调高了售价。此举的起因是半导体供应链剧烈波动，逼得苹果不得不开启“屯粮过冬”模式。

ai_analysis.insight_en: Tim Cook's masterclass in supply chain management means complaining about historic memory prices while quietly padding device price tags. Apple isn't your friend, but its rising bill of materials definitely is.

article_content_zh:
根据周一公布的财报，苹果第四财季继续囤积库存，尤其是计算机内存。该公司报告称，本季度库存大幅增加，从第三季度的 110.9 亿美元增长到第四季度的 145.4 亿美元，增幅为 31.1%。库存较 2025 年第四季度的 57.2 亿美元同比增长 154.3%。

苹果预测 12 月份季度毛利率为 45% 至 46%，主要归因于内存成本上涨的影响。该公司报告 9 月份季度的毛利率为 47.9%。

苹果首席执行官约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）在电话会议上对分析师表示：“我们目前看到的内存定价是前所未有的。” “正如我们在 9 月季度早些时候所说的那样，与 6 月季度相比，我们确实看到内存成本更高，但库存成本和某些非内存组件成本降低的好处部分抵消了这一成本。”

他表示，该公司预计 12 月份季度“内存成本将会更高”，这将被今年早些时候对某些设备实施的涨价所部分抵消，其中包括 6 月底的 Mac 和 iPad 以及 9 月份的 iPhone。

Ternus 还表示，12 月之后，苹果预计内存成本“将继续增加”。

他指出：“正如我们之前所说，我们确实相信，随着时间的推移，我们会看到内存库存带来的好处逐渐减少。”他补充说，该公司正在增加对这一关键组件的采购。 “随着我们努力改善供应，从 6 月份到 9 月份这个季度，我们的制造业采购义务增加了 330 亿美元，您将在我们明天发布的年度报告中看到这一点。”

苹果还邀请了负责公司供应链和制造的首席运营官 Sabih Khan 参加电话会议，以解决有关内存的问题。他重申了增加的购买义务，但不排除苹果设备未来价格上涨的可能性。

该公司还将本季度 iPad 销售疲软归咎于供应限制。尽管 iPhone 和 Mac 的销量超出了预期，但 iPad 是唯一没有增长的产品领域之一。 iPad 营收为 62 亿美元，低于分析师预期的 67 亿美元。这一数字也比去年下降了 10%。

title: Match Group reports Q3 revenue fell 3% YoY to $891M, below estimates, and total paying users fell 5% to 13.8M; Q4 forecast has adjusted EBITDA below estimates (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
title_en: Match Group reports Q3 revenue fell 3% YoY to $891M, below estimates, and total paying users fell 5% to 13.8M; Q4 forecast has adjusted EBITDA below estimates (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Match Group Inc. disappointed investors after posting weaker-than-expected quarterly revenue and forecasting adjusted earnings …
summary_en: Match Group reported Q3 revenue of $891 million, a 3% YoY decline, while total paying users dropped 5% to 13.8 million, missing market expectations. Driven by stagnation and stiff competition, the company also provided Q4 guidance with EBITDA below analyst estimates.

title: Trajectory, which is developing AI model post-training tools for nontechnical customers, raised a $45M Series A led by Sequoia at a $300M valuation (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
title_en: Trajectory, which is developing AI model post-training tools for nontechnical customers, raised a $45M Series A led by Sequoia at a $300M valuation (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Whether developed by OpenAI or Anthropic or built on open source alternatives, current AI models share a critical limitation: They don’t learn from their mistakes without further training.

Businesses adapting these models for specialized fields, such as law and finance, typically get around this by fine-tuning general models. However, that often requires hiring internal research teams or relying on expensive consultants, commonly known as forward-deployed engineers (FDEs).

Trajectory, a startup founded about a year ago by three Stanford classmates with experience at Google DeepMind and Apple, wants to automate that process, allowing AI models to learn from feedback and continuously improve at specialized tasks.

The 18-person company just announced that it raised $45 million in a Series A round at a $300 million valuation, led by Sequoia, with participation from Nvidia, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Trajectory co-founder Ronak Malde compared foundational models to a very smart PhD student who’s always starting a new job. “But what the economy values is someone who worked on the job for 30 years,” he told TechCrunch.

The startup aims to solve this problem through an approach known as continual learning. Businesses using Trajectory can start with an open source AI model and connect the platform to their applications, allowing it to collect feedback on how the model performs. Trajectory then uses that information to retrain the model, helping it improve at specialized tasks over time.

With Trajectory, lawyers, doctors, and other specialists can improve the models near automatically themselves, Malde said. That capability could make deploying specialized AI faster and cheaper.

title_zh: Trajectory获4500万美元融资
summary_zh: 斯坦福校友创办的Trajectory完成4500万美元A轮融资，旨在通过自动化工具让AI模型像资深员工一样持续进化
article_content_zh:
无论是由 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 开发，还是基于开源替代品构建，当前的人工智能模型都存在一个关键的局限性：如果没有进一步的训练，它们就无法从错误中吸取教训。

将这些模型应用于法律和金融等专业领域的企业通常通过微调通用模型来解决这个问题。然而，这通常需要雇用内部研究团队或依靠昂贵的顾问，通常称为前沿部署工程师（FDE）。

Trajectory 是一家初创公司，由三位在 Google DeepMind 和 Apple 工作过的斯坦福大学同学于大约一年前创立，该公司希望实现这一过程的自动化，让人工智能模型能够从反馈中学习，并在专业任务上不断改进。

这家拥有 18 名员工的公司刚刚宣布，在 A 轮融资中筹集了 4500 万美元，估值为 3 亿美元，由红杉资本领投，Nvidia、Bessemer Venture Partners 和 Bain Capital Ventures 跟投。

Trajectory 联合创始人 Ronak Malde 将基础模型比作一个总是开始新工作的非常聪明的博士生。 “但经济看重的是在这份工作上工作了 30 年的人，”他告诉 TechCrunch。

该初创公司旨在通过一种称为持续学习的方法来解决这个问题。使用 Trajectory 的企业可以从开源 AI 模型开始，并将平台连接到其应用程序，从而收集有关模型执行情况的反馈。然后，Trajectory 使用该信息重新训练模型，帮助其随着时间的推移改进专门任务。

马尔德说，通过 Trajectory，律师、医生和其他专家可以近乎自动地改进模型。这种能力可以使专业人工智能的部署更快、更便宜。

Harvey 和 Rogo 等公司已经在使用 Trajectory 的平台对开源模型进行后期训练，通过从以前的任务中学习，例如审查特定类型的法律合同或使用特定方法对公司进行估值，帮助他们更像经验丰富的律师或财务分析师。 Trajectory 的其他客户包括 Decagon、Mercor 和 Nvidia。该初创公司目前正在公开其培训后平台。

Malde 说，使用 Trajectory 的人决定“他们的组织应该是什么样子，并可以将其转化为他们模型的改进”。

Trajectory 的持续学习方法与递归自我改进（RSI）有一些相似之处，即人工智能系统可以提高自身能力。但联合创始人 Michael Elabd 认为，让人类参与训练过程会让 Trajectory 的方法更安全，因为自主的自我改进可能会导致意想不到的甚至危险的结果。

Trajectory 并不是唯一一家尝试实现训练后自动化的初创公司。它将由 OpenAI 前首席技术官 Mira Murati 和微调平台 Tinker 背后的公司创立的 Thinking Machines Lab 视为直接竞争对手，此外还有 Applied Compute（上个月估值为 32.5 亿美元）和 Prime Intellect（帮助公司构建和训练自己的 AI 代理）。

Malde 认为这家初创公司最大的优势是它的团队。他是谷歌 DeepMind 从 Windsurf 收购的少数研究人员之一。 Elabd 还曾在 DeepMind 工作，而 Trajectory 的第三位联合创始人 Arjun Karanam 此前曾在苹果公司从事生成基础模型的工作。该初创公司还招募了来自 OpenAI、Stripe 和 Netflix 的研究人员和产品设计师。

title: Anthropic S-1 claims it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold and may fail to identify "significant acceleration" in its development until after it's occurred (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
title_en: Anthropic S-1 claims it may "imminently meet" its RSI threshold and may fail to identify "significant acceleration" in its development until after it's occurred (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
While much attention has focused on the updated financials Anthropic revealed in its revised S-1A on Monday, (revenue is soaring, but so are expenses), the AI lab dropped another little bombshell in the fine print.

The filing seems to warn that the company is on the cusp of creating a model capable of recursive self-improvement (RSI).

RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return, in which AI builds itself into something powerful enough that it slips beyond human control and may be indifferent to the damage it causes while achieving its goals.

To AI enthusiasts, RSI, or some version of AI reliably using itself to improve, represents the technology’s promise, where it becomes a tool of unimaginable productivity, scientific discovery, and more.

Anthropic seems to believe that RSI is both a promise and a peril. It says in the S-1 that it uses AI in its R&D, but it cautions: “Using AI to help build more capable AI could also pose a considerable safety risk, particularly if it sharply accelerates the pace of progress. This is one of the areas covered by our Responsible Scaling Policy, which sets out our plans to monitor and mitigate the risks as we approach what has been termed ‘recursive self-improvement.’”

When the term RSI became popular earlier this year, many believed it was a buzzword or, at best, a goal too hard to achieve, define, or prove.

In addition, our increasing use of AI systems to accelerate our own research and development may cause the capabilities of our models to advance more rapidly than our ability to develop, validate, and implement corresponding safety, alignment, and security measures. As a result, we have in the past not identified, and may in the future not identify, a significant acceleration in our rate of development until after it has occurred.

title_zh: Anthropic预警AI递归自我进化风险
summary_zh: Anthropic在上市文件中承认，正逼近递归自我提升（RSI）临界点，恐难在爆发式增长发生前及时预判及控制风险
article_content_zh:
虽然很多注意力都集中在 Anthropic 周一在其修订后的 S-1A 中披露的最新财务数据（收入飙升，但支出也在飙升），但人工智能实验室在细则中又抛出了另一个小重磅炸弹。

该文件似乎警告说，该公司即将创建一个能够递归自我改进（RSI）的模型。

RSI 是人工智能在自我训练方面变得如此出色的点，以至于它催生了人工智能能力的急剧加速。对于人工智能的毁灭者来说，RSI 代表着一场没有回头路的灾难，人工智能将自己构建成足够强大的东西，以至于超出了人类的控制范围，并且在实现其目标的同时可能对其造成的损害漠不关心。

对于人工智能爱好者来说，RSI 或某些版本的人工智能能够可靠地利用自身进行改进，代表了该技术的前景，它成为实现难以想象的生产力、科学发现等的工具。

Anthropic 似乎认为 RSI 既是希望也是危险。它在 S-1 中表示，它在研发中使用人工智能，但它警告说：“使用人工智能帮助构建更强大的人工智能也可能带来相当大的安全风险，特别是如果它急剧加快进展速度。这是我们负责任的扩展政策涵盖的领域之一，该政策规定了我们在接近所谓的‘递归自我改进’时监控和减轻风险的计划。”

今年早些时候，当“RSI”一词流行起来时，许多人认为它只是一个流行词，或者充其量是一个难以实现、定义或证明的目标。

此外，我们越来越多地使用人工智能系统来加速我们自己的研发，可能会导致我们模型的能力比我们开发、验证和实施相应的安全、对齐和安保措施的能力更快地进步。因此，我们过去没有发现，而且将来可能也没有发现，我们的发展速度显着加快，直到它发生之后。

例如，我们对未来模型（而不是当前模型）的内部估计和期望表明，我们可能很快就会满足负责任的扩展政策中“人工智能大幅加速进展”的定义。我们尚未指定任何当前模型超过此阈值，并且我们将继续评估基础数据。

然而，Anthropic 在文件中还表示，其模型尚未突破 RSI 阈值，并承诺在可预见的未来让人类继续参与研发过程。 “如果技术上可行的话，我们预计无法在没有有意义的人类监督或理解的情况下安全地使用 Claude 完全自主地设计和构建连续几代的前沿模型。因此，我们正在考虑更新我们的负责任的扩展政策，以使人类能够控制 Anthropic 的前沿模型开发。”

怀疑论者可能会指出，S-1 的功能既具有披露功能，又具有营销功能，而声称接近一个强大到可以自行构建的模型的说法可能属于后一类。

尽管如此，毫无疑问，克劳德的能力，尤其是在编码、数学和网络安全方面，今年得到了突飞猛进的发展。如果 Anthropic 认为 RSI 的可能性很接近，也许我们应该相信它并采取相应的行动——或许进行治理。

当您通过我们文章中的链接购买时，我们可能会赚取少量佣金。这并不影响我们的编辑独立性。

title: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after a breach involving $46M+ in assets, per Arkham; Tether froze 4.5M+ USDT in response (Jason Shubnell/The Block)
title_en: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after a breach involving $46M+ in assets, per Arkham; Tether froze 4.5M+ USDT in response (Jason Shubnell/The Block)
author: The Block
content_snippet: The exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after the incident, while Tether froze more than 4.5 million USDT linked to the attacker.
summary_en: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin exchange suffered a major security breach, resulting in the theft of over $46 million in digital assets. In response, the platform has halted all deposits and withdrawals, while Tether intervened by freezing over $4.5 million of the stolen funds.

content_snippet: The tech conglomerate beat Wall Street expectations with revenue hitting $114.48 billion — Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...
summary_en: Apple reported Q4 revenue of $114.5 billion, a 12% YoY increase. While iPhone sales jumped 17%, the Services sector missed expectations by a hair, coming in at $31.57 billion against a $31.58 billion estimate.
title_zh: 苹果第四财季营收创新高
summary_zh: 苹果公司发布第四财季财报，总营收达1145亿美元，iPhone销量表现强劲，但服务业务略逊于预期
article_content_zh:
苹果在第四财季交出了漂亮的成绩单，单季度营收冲至1145亿美元，净利润达到307.1亿美元。尽管面临服务业务微幅缺口，但在iPhone 18 Pro及Pro Max的拉动下，手机业务同比增长17%，依然是公司的核心现金牛。

另一方面，Mac产品线表现亮眼，同比增长24%，成为硬件端的意外增长点。相比之下，iPad业务下滑10%，穿戴设备及家庭配件下滑8%，显示出苹果在核心手机与桌面生产力工具之外的品类正面临一定的市场饱和压力。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 苹果发布2026财年第四季度财报，总营收录得1145亿美元，同比增长12%。其中iPhone业务增长17%成为核心引擎，而备受关注的服务业务营收虽达315.7亿美元，但未达华尔街预期的315.8亿美元。

title: Apple Q4: iPhone up 17% YoY to $57.58B, vs. $56.54B est., Mac up 24% to $10.8B, iPad down 10% to $6.2B, and Wearables, Home, and Accessories down 8% to $8.3B (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
title_en: Apple Q4: iPhone up 17% YoY to $57.58B, vs. $56.54B est., Mac up 24% to $10.8B, iPad down 10% to $6.2B, and Wearables, Home, and Accessories down 8% to $8.3B (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
author: 9to5Mac
article_content:
Apple just released its earnings report for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026. The company reported $114.5 billion in revenue, and $30.71 billion in net profit. Here’s the full breakdown.

Last year, for its fourth fiscal quarter, Apple reported $102.47 billion in revenue, $27.47 billion in net profit, and earnings per share of $1.85. For this quarter, the company expected revenue to grow between 9% and 11% year over year, implying revenue of roughly $111.69 billion and $113.74 billion.

“Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever. […] We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.”

“Apple delivered September quarter records for net income and EPS. Our record September quarter capped off a strong fiscal 2026, with all-time record revenue of $479 billion and double-digit EPS growth. […] We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders. Thanks to our very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, our installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.”

Be sure to follow 9to5Mac’s full coverage of today’s earnings, including key highlights from the conference call.

title: Palantir reports Q3 revenue up 96% YoY to $2.31B, above $2.18B est., US commercial revenue up 148% to $984M, and raises FY 2026 revenue guidance to ~$8.53B (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
title_en: Palantir reports Q3 revenue up 96% YoY to $2.31B, above $2.18B est., US commercial revenue up 148% to $984M, and raises FY 2026 revenue guidance to ~$8.53B (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Palantir beat Wall Street's third-quarter estimates after the bell on Monday, with U.S. commercial revenue topping government for the first time as businesses adopt more of the company's artificial intelligence tools.

Revenue nearly doubled from a year ago and blew past $2 billion for the first time ever, Palantir said. Net income more than doubled to $1.13 billion, or 44 cents per share, from about $476 million, or 18 cents per share.

"I don't believe anyone's had consistent results like this in the history of software AI, ever," CEO Alex Karp told CNBC's Seema Mody in an interview, adding that the business is succeeding without salespeople.

Palantir has long been known for its strength in the government sector, but its commercial segment caught up in Q3.

U.S. commercial revenue jumped 148% to $984 million, surpassing U.S. government revenue of $953 million, which was up 96%. The company's U.S. commercial revenue has more than quintupled over the last two years.

Palantir lifted its guidance, saying it now expects U.S. commercial revenue "in excess of" $3.56 billion for the full year. Last quarter, the company boosted its forecast to $3.42 billion. The company projects about $2.65 billion in revenue for the fourth quarter and about $8.53 billion for full-year 2026.

Karp has openly supported the use of open-weight models and criticized leading AI labs, which he told CNBC earlier this year are forcing businesses to sell their data sovereignty. Karp, on Monday, also reiterated recent calls to nationalize AI labs, calling it the "only realistic way" to manage liability.

In September, Karp joined major tech CEOs at the White House as calls for regulation mounted following claims from AI researchers that the technology has a more than 10% of killing humanity.

"My message to everybody is: Beware of thinking you can delay the future in AI," he told CNBC. "The future is here. The political ramifications of it are here."

title_zh: Palantir三季度营收猛增，AI商业化大爆发
summary_zh: Palantir第三季度营收激增至23.1亿美元，美国商业业务营收首次超过政府业务，并大幅上调全年财务指引
article_content_zh:
Palantir 周一收盘后第三季度业绩超出了华尔街预期，随着企业更多地采用该公司的人工智能工具，美国商业收入首次超过政府收入。

Palantir 表示，收入比一年前几乎翻了一番，首次突破 20 亿美元。净利润从约 4.76 亿美元（即每股 18 美分）增加了一倍多，达到 11.3 亿美元（即每股 44 美分）。

首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普 (Alex Karp) 在接受 CNBC 的 Seema Mody 采访时表示：“我相信，在软件人工智能的历史上，从来没有人能取得如此一致的结果。”他补充说，即使没有销售人员，公司也能取得成功。

Palantir 长期以来以其在政府领域的实力而闻名，但其商业领域在第三季度迎头赶上。

美国商业收入跃升 148%，达到 9.84 亿美元，超过美国政府收入 9.53 亿美元，后者增长了 96%。过去两年，该公司在美国的商业收入增长了五倍多。

Palantir 上调了预期，表示目前预计全年美国商业收入“超过”35.6 亿美元。上季度，该公司将其预测提高至 34.2 亿美元。该公司预计第四季度收入约为 26.5 亿美元，2026 年全年收入约为 85.3 亿美元。

卡普公开支持使用开放权重模型，并批评领先的人工智能实验室，他在今年早些时候告诉 CNBC，这些实验室正在迫使企业出售其数据主权。卡普周一还重申了最近将人工智能实验室国有化的呼吁，称这是管理责任的“唯一现实的方式”。

今年 9 月，随着人工智能研究人员声称该技术导致人类死亡的比例超过 10%，要求监管的呼声越来越高，卡普加入了白宫各大科技公司首席执行官的行列。

他对 CNBC 表示：“我向所有人传达的信息是：不要认为自己会推迟人工智能的未来。” “未来就在这里。它的政治影响就在这里。”

title: Roku reports Q3 revenue up 24% YoY to $1.5B, Platform revenue up 23% to $1.3B, ad revenue up 23% to $727.4M, and subscription revenue up 23% to $580.9M (Todd Spangler/Variety)
title_en: Roku reports Q3 revenue up 24% YoY to $1.5B, Platform revenue up 23% to $1.3B, ad revenue up 23% to $727.4M, and subscription revenue up 23% to $580.9M (Todd Spangler/Variety)
author: Variety
article_content:
Roku‘s financial engines are cranking in overdrive ahead of the streaming platform company’s takeover by Fox Corp. next year.

According to Roku, similar to Q2, political advertising on its platform in Q3 exceeded the comparable quarter from the 2024 U.S. presidential election cycle. Advertising in the company’s media and entertainment category also outperformed: Roku said the most recent quarter was the highest year-over-year revenue growth for M&E in four years “as media companies invested on the Roku platform to promote their content and services.”

Total streaming hours consumed across Roku in Q3 were 39.9 billion, up 9% year over year. Revenue in Roku’s Devices jumped 33%, $194 million. The company operates the Devices business as a loss-leader with a negative margin; in Q3, the operating loss for the segment was $48.6 million (a -25% gross margin), driven primarily by higher memory costs.

Fox Corp. on June 15 announced a deal to buy Roku for $22 billion, which is expected to close in the first half of calendar year 2027. As with its second-quarter earnings, Roku is not hosting an earnings call or providing financial guidance, citing the pending Fox acquisition.

The pending acquisition by Fox “is an extraordinary opportunity to accelerate our vision, allowing us to scale faster and innovate more aggressively for viewers, partners and advertisers,” Roku’s founder and CEO Anthony Wood, and Dan Jedda, CFO and COO, said in a letter to shareholders.

Following the close of the Fox acquisition, Wood will have an ongoing role at the combined company and will join the Fox board.

article_content_zh:
在流媒体平台公司 Roku 明年被福克斯公司收购之前，其金融引擎正在超速运转。

Roku 表示，与第二季度类似，第三季度其平台上的政治广告数量超过了 2024 年美国总统选举周期的同期水平。该公司媒体和娱乐类别的广告也表现出色：Roku 表示，最近一个季度的 M&E 收入同比增长是四年来最高的，“因为媒体公司投资 Roku 平台来推广其内容和服务”。

第三季度 Roku 的总流媒体播放时长为 399 亿小时，同比增长 9%。 Roku 设备的收入增长了 33%，达到 1.94 亿美元。该公司的设备业务处于亏损状态，利润率为负；第三季度，该部门的运营亏损为 4860 万美元（毛利率为-25%），主要是由于内存成本上涨。

福克斯公司 (Fox Corp.) 于 6 月 15 日宣布以 220 亿美元收购 Roku 的交易，预计将于 2027 年上半年完成。与第二季度财报一样，Roku 并未召开财报电话会议或提供财务指导，理由是福克斯公司的收购尚未完成。

Roku 创始人兼首席执行官安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 以及首席财务官兼首席运营官丹·杰达 (Dan Jedda) 在致股东的信中表示，福克斯即将进行的收购“是一个绝佳的机会，可以加速我们的愿景，使我们能够更快地扩大规模，为观众、合作伙伴和广告商更积极地创新”。

福克斯收购完成后，伍德将在合并后的公司继续担任职务，并将加入福克斯董事会。

author: Rikiya Takehi
article_content:

If the file cannot be fetched (the page opened as a file), the stays. --> Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights Authors Rikiya Takehi*

We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, well past what we’d expect from humans or conventional algorithms. This might be a big deal for both optimization and interpretability.

Just by looking at the raw weights, GPT-6 Astra can tell what a network was trained to do. And without any environment feedback, it has no trouble writing, from scratch, small game-playing networks that outplay networks trained with PPO for 100 million steps.

Likewise, asked to make Qwen3.5-0.8B better at math without gradients, Astra identifies an issue in its weights causing reasoning loops that Qwen’s own model card warns about, and fixes this by natively editing 0.016% of the weights. With the same sampling settings, this weight correction raises MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% and generalizes out of the box to instruction following, raising IFEval by 3x.

All of this is possible without allowing Astra to write training loops. It uses its reasoning to figure out what each part of a neural network computes, or should compute, and changes the weights accordingly. We call this Weight-Space Programming.

Throughout the history of deep learning, we encoded our simplistic inductive biases into tiny symbolic optimizers like Adam or Muon. This is changing: our neural network weights will soon be natively optimized by LLMs that deliberately reason about their weights.

If you were asked to handcraft a neural network that plays Go, what would you do? If you were handed raw neural network weights and asked to predict their behavior, where would you ev...

它位于源 --> 中，SVG 无法使用页面的 Web 字体并回退到 Helvetica，因此每个字体都会放入页面本身：然后将其文本设置为 Source Sans 3 和 JetBrains Mono，就像其他字体一样。如果无法获取文件（页面作为文件打开），则保留。 --> 权重空间编程的火花：法学硕士可以原生读写神经网络权重 作者 Rikiya Takehi*

我们发现前沿法学硕士在本机读取和编写神经网络权重方面出人意料地出色，远远超出了我们对人类或传统算法的期望。这对于优化和可解释性来说可能都是一件大事。

只需查看原始权重，GPT-6 Astra 就可以判断网络经过训练要做什么。在没有任何环境反馈的情况下，它可以轻松地从头开始编写小型游戏网络，其性能超过使用 PPO 训练的网络 1 亿步。

同样，当被要求在没有梯度的情况下让 Qwen3.5-0.8B 更好地进行数学计算时，Astra 发现了其权重中的一个问题，导致 Qwen 自己的模型卡警告的推理循环，并通过本地编辑 0.016% 的权重来修复此问题。在相同的采样设置下，这种权重校正将 MATH-500 从 7.9% 提高到 48.1%，并且开箱即用地推广到指令遵循，将 IFEval 提高了 3 倍。

所有这一切都是可能的，而无需允许 Astra 编写训练循环。它利用推理来找出神经网络的每个部分计算或应该计算什么，并相应地改变权重。我们称之为权重空间规划。

纵观深度学习的历史，我们将简单的归纳偏差编码为 Adam 或 Muon 等微小的符号优化器。这种情况正在发生变化：我们的神经网络权重很快就会由法学硕士进行本地优化，这些法学硕士会刻意推理其权重。

如果你被要求手工制作一个下围棋的神经网络，你会做什么？如果给你原始的神经网络权重并要求你预测它们的行为，你会从哪里开始呢？对于几乎任何人来说，这实际上是不可能的。

如今，权重是通过优化、通过训练来编写权重的自定义网络或通过正式程序的编译器来编写的。在这篇文章中，我们发现当前一代在自然语言中使用的前沿法学硕士开始变得异常擅长理解和围绕自然语言目标构建神经网络权重。

几年来，我们一直在使用法学硕士来优化文本工件，例如提示和围绕它们构建的程序。最近，我们开始使用它们来优化整个工具以及训练 ML 模型的训练代码和超参数。

我们经常通过以下事实来证明这些方法的合理性：我们不知道其他原则性的方法来爬山文本工件，这与更新可微神经网络的权重不同。毕竟，人类可以手动“优化”代码，因此要求法学硕士这样做是有意义的，但他们无法手动“优化”神经权重，因此这些很大程度上仍停留在符号算法领域。

在这篇文章中，我们分享了非常早期的结果，这些结果使我们能够论证推理驱动优化的范式现在甚至对于可微神经网络来说也即将到来。

在权重空间编程中，通用 LLM 围绕某些自然语言规范直接读取和写入网络的权重（即不通过优化器，特别是不使用梯度下降），有时甚至根本没有环境反馈。

在自然语言中，“只需要求”法学硕士就可以在神经网络的权重中找到隐藏的特征或故障，修复该故障，或者从头开始编写一个新网络。我们报告了以下各项的早期令人兴奋的结果，首先是在小型网络上，然后甚至是在真实的语言模型上：

我们从一个小规模的实验开始，看看法学硕士是否可以理解连续权重空间，它本质上只是一个数字列表。

title: Goldman Sachs pulls AI coding tools from traders and bankers
title_en: Goldman Sachs pulls AI coding tools from traders and bankers
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Goldman Sachs is pulling AI coding tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot from traders and bankers, limiting access to engineers only. As recently as July, CIO Marco Argenti publicly praised "vibe coding" by non-technical staff. Now the bank cites "productivity and risk management" as the reason for the reversal.

The article Goldman Sachs pulls AI coding tools from traders and bankers appeared first on The Decoder.

title: Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its staff, saying "automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate" (Liam Proven/The Register)
title_en: Memo: Linux distribution vendor SUSE is laying off ~10% of its staff, saying "automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate" (Liam Proven/The Register)
author: The Register
article_content:
One in ten employees at SUSE are facing the chop due to "automation and AI," according to a memo dispatched by management at the privately owned open source software biz.

In an email to the 1,900 strong workforce on Monday - seen by The Register - CEO Dirk-Peter van Leeuwen, the former Red Hat exec who joined SUSE in March 2023, confirmed the "difficult news."

"We are announcing a reduction of SUSE’s global workforce of approximately 10 percent," he said. "These decisions are painful for our people, our culture, and our open source community, but they are necessary for us to adapt and build a sustainable, resilient SUSE for the long term."

Van Leeuwen says the business, bought by Swedish private equity provider EQT, decided to cut jobs after scrutinizing its "future strategy, required capabilities, and team structures." The rest of the organization will get a look at the fiscal year 2027 strategy on November 16.

"What is clear is that automation and AI are fundamentally shifting how software companies operate. AI capabilities are advancing exponentially, forcing us to radically reimagine our work. We have seen this trend already both inside our sector and in the wider economy. This means that the organizational design and cost base that SUSE is built on today will not carry us forward successfully.

"We are adapting. Across SUSE, modern tooling is already changing our daily workflows, enabling teams to move faster with less operational overhead and flatter reporting lines. The requirement for some existing roles has greatly diminished. Other roles will evolve over the next few years. This means we are accelerating investments in high priority areas, and deprioritizing others. These are hard, painful decisions to make, but necessary for our future."

As The Reg reported in 2025, SUSE doubled down on AI.

article_content_zh:
根据这家私营开源软件公司管理层发布的一份备忘录，SUSE 十分之一的员工因“自动化和人工智能”而面临裁员。

The Register 看到，2023 年 3 月加入 SUSE 的前红帽高管、首席执行官 Dirk-Peter van Leeuwen 在周一发给 1,900 名员工的电子邮件中证实了这一“艰难的消息”。

“我们宣布 SUSE 全球员工人数减少约 10%，”他说。 “这些决定对我们的人民、我们的文化和我们的开源社区来说都是痛苦的，但对于我们适应和建立长期可持续、有弹性的 SUSE 来说，它们是必要的。”

Van Leeuwen 表示，该公司被瑞典私募股权提供商 EQT 收购，在仔细审查其“未来战略、所需能力和团队结构”后决定裁员。该组织的其他成员将于 11 月 16 日了解 2027 财年战略。

“显而易见的是，自动化和人工智能正在从根本上改变软件公司的运营方式。人工智能能力正在呈指数级增长，迫使我们从根本上重新构想我们的工作。我们已经在我们的行业内部和更广泛的经济中看到了这种趋势。这意味着 SUSE 所建立的组织设计和成本基础将无法推动我们成功前进。

“我们正在适应。在 SUSE 中，现代工具已经改变了我们的日常工作流程，使团队能够以更少的运营开销和更扁平的报告关系更快地行动。对某些现有角色的要求已大大减少。其他角色将在未来几年内发展。这意味着我们正在加速对高优先领域的投资，并降低其他领域的优先级。这些都是艰难而痛苦的决定，但对我们的未来来说是必要的。”

正如 The Reg 在 2025 年报道的那样，SUSE 在人工智能方面加倍努力。

没有概述面临裁员风险的具体角色，但 SUSE 声称它已经考虑了这些职位的人员“能够在哪些方面发展，他们可以停止做什么，他们需要做更多的事情 - 并在此基础上做出了决定。”

陷入裁员的员工将于 11 月 4 日之前收到通知，第二天提名员工代表，一对一会议将于下周初开始。

Van Leeuwen 在内部备忘录中表示，裁员是“组织需求变化的反映，而不是你的才能或承诺。你已经解决了为全球关键企业系统提供动力的硬基础设施和开源挑战。

“任何组织都会很幸运拥有您的专业知识。”

早在九月，我们就报道过该公司正在询问老员工是否愿意“自愿离职”。似乎没有足够多的人选择走进这扇门，所以相反，他们被扔了进去。捷克共和国的 SUSE“壁虎”可能很高兴他们加入了工会。

早在 2018 年，EQT 以 25 亿美元从 Microfocus 手中收购了 SUSE。 EQT 于 2021 年在法兰克福证券交易所上市 SUSE，但结果略显令人失望。几年后，新任首席执行官 Dirk-Peter van Leeuwen 接任，并于 2023 年晚些时候，EQT 选择再次将公司私有化。

商业背景是，3 月份，据报道 SUSE 的企业所有者 EQT 正在考虑再次出售它。 ®

title: SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product
title_en: SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
SpaceXSI is apparently cutting usage limits for its AI agent Grok Bot, less than two weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product. The operating costs were "unsustainably high relative to revenue," Musk wrote on X. OpenAI and Anthropic are also tightening their flat-rate plans as they grapple with the high costs of AI agents.

title: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits "to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game", saying IP infringement violates its usage policy (Bruno Ferreira/Tom's Hardware)
title_en: Anthropic confirms new Claude Code limits "to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game", saying IP infringement violates its usage policy (Bruno Ferreira/Tom's Hardware)
author: Tom's Hardware
article_content:
Meanwhile, we now have direct reports of reverse engineering efforts being blocked, while online complaints grow.

In the full tweet, which you can read below, Addy Osmani says that "[Anthropic] added two sentences to Claude Code's prompt on Opus 5.5 to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game because using Claude to infringe IP is against [its] usage policy." He goes on to state that work on original games is meant to continue working, and that Anthropic is iterating on the rules to try and "strike the right balance."

We added two sentences to Claude Code's prompt on Opus 5.5 to steer it away from recreating someone else's specific game because using Claude to infringe IP is against our usage policy. Original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to keep working. We'll continue to iterate to ensure we're striking the right balance. In the meantime, if Claude turns down something that's yours, send it my way.October 30, 2026

There's no telling what those sentences might be, though given Osmani's choice of words, it's possible that said sentences are indeed what X user Chasm posted a screenshot of: "Do build original games, games in a genre, and games from the user’s own designs and assets. Don’t build a recreation of a specific existing game, even if it is renamed or called original."

In our previous report, we had already linked to recent issues raised at Claude Code's own GitHub repository, comprised of users complaining that the AI assistant was refusing to work on their games or on reverse-engineering tasks. As far as we can ascertain, it appears the game-related blocking is limited to the combination of using Claude Code and the Opus 5.5 model. Should that prove true, then users should be able to sidestep the limitation by calling upon Opus using another harness like Ollama or forwarding specific requests through a wrapper of some sort.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic官方近期确认已对Claude Code（在Opus 5.5上）增设了特定的提示词规则，旨在阻止其复刻并生成他人特定的已有游戏。此举的起因是防止用户借助AI进行大规模版权侵权，而Anthropic强调虽然原创游戏和基于自身设计的游戏不受影响，但侵犯知识产权的行为坚决违反其产品使用政策。

article_content_zh:
与此同时，我们现在收到了有关逆向工程工作被阻止的直接报告，而网上投诉也在增加。

在完整的推文中（您可以在下面阅读），Addy Osmani 表示“[Anthropic] 在 Opus 5.5 上的 Claude Code 提示中添加了两句话，以引导其远离重新创建其他人的特定游戏，因为使用 Claude 侵犯知识产权违反了[其]使用政策。”他接着表示，原创游戏的工作应该继续进行，Anthropic 正在迭代规则，试图“达到适当的平衡”。

我们在 Opus 5.5 上的 Claude Code 提示中添加了两句话，以阻止其重新创建其他人的特定游戏，因为使用 Claude 侵犯知识产权违反了我们的使用政策。原创游戏、类型游戏以及根据您自己的设计和资产构建的游戏旨在继续发挥作用。我们将继续迭代以确保我们取得正确的平衡。与此同时，如果克劳德拒绝了属于你的东西，请将其发送给我。2026 年 10 月 30 日

目前还不清楚这些句子可能是什么，但考虑到 Osmani 的用词选择，这些句子可能确实是 X 用户 Chasm 发布的屏幕截图：“要构建原创游戏、某种类型的游戏以及根据用户自己的设计和资产构建的游戏。不要构建特定现有游戏的娱乐版，即使它被重命名或称为原创。”

在我们之前的报告中，我们已经链接到了 Claude Code 自己的 GitHub 存储库中最近提出的问题，其中包括用户抱怨人工智能助手拒绝处理他们的游戏或逆向工程任务。据我们所知，与游戏相关的阻塞似乎仅限于使用 Claude Code 和 Opus 5.5 模型的组合。如果这一点被证明是正确的，那么用户应该能够通过使用 Ollama 等其他工具调用 Opus 或通过某种包装器转发特定请求来避开限制。

关于逆向工程的封锁，我们已经收到了直接确认。第一个来自我们的校友贾里德·沃尔顿（Jarred Walton），他试图对他正在开发的软件进行检查。他指出，直到昨天 10 月 31 日，此类工作都没有出现任何问题，而切换到 Opus 4.8 让他可以继续工作。

沃尔顿推测，人类可能在代码中添加了一条专门用于逆向工程的新规则。考虑到这个时间点，再加上上周出现的其他拒绝报告的事实，可能表明该公司可能会以与视频游戏相关内容相同的方式摆弄网络安全相关规则。

我们还收到了一名员工的熟人发来的屏幕截图，他要求 Opus 5.5（通过代码）尝试对产品激活进行逆向工程，这一请求同样触发了安全措施。与此同时，注意到 Claude Code 似乎阻止逆向工程继续增加，据称现在有一名 Redditor 的帐户因使用 Opus 5.5 和逆向工程 Anything 而被暂停，然后又恢复。该公司有一个持续的网络验证计划，只有获得批准的实体才能访问全套前沿模型的网络安全功能。

Bruno Ferreira 是《Tom's Hardware》的特约撰稿人。他在 PC 硬件和各种杂项方面拥有数十年的经验，同时也是一名开发人员。他痴迷于细节，并且倾向于在他喜欢的话题上闲聊。当不这样做时，他通常会玩游戏，或者参加现场音乐表演和节日。

title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
title_en: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate leaves much to be desired.

Fewer than half of agent-generated insights at the organizations surveyed for this report lead to business improvement. And while most respondents praise the quality of their agents’ descriptive insights, reviews of their prescriptive insights—those on which actions are based—are decidedly mixed.

Failure to produce insights that improve the business deprives organizations of their desired return on investment in agentic analytics. Worse, flawed insights that trigger incorrect actions can cause reputational or financial damage. This report gauges how companies view the quality of the outputs produced by their analytics agents and explores how organizations are seeking to boost insight quality and get their agents working harder for the business.

在短短几年内，生成式人工智能改变了企业分析的面貌，特别是让整个组织的用户都可以访问分析。代理人工智能有望通过自动化整个工作流程并根据代理洞察采取行动来完成更多任务。但存在一个问题：代理目前生成的见解的质量还有很多不足之处。

在本报告调查的组织中，只有不到一半的代理生成的见解能够带来业务改进。尽管大多数受访者称赞其代理的描述性见解的质量，但对他们的规范性见解（行动所依据的见解）的评论显然是褒贬不一。

如果无法产生改善业务的见解，组织就会无法获得代理分析所需的投资回报。更糟糕的是，有缺陷的见解会引发错误的行动，可能会导致声誉或财务损失。该报告衡量了公司如何看待其分析代理产生的输出质量，并探讨了组织如何寻求提高洞察质量并让其代理为业务更加努力地工作。

title: Israeli startup 42AI, which is developing a "behavioral world model" that tries to predict human behavior, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
title_en: Israeli startup 42AI, which is developing a "behavioral world model" that tries to predict human behavior, emerges from stealth with a $62.5M seed (Ram Iyer/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Here’s a question straight out of sci-fi: What if AI could predict what you were going to do before you decided to, even in a completely new situation?

Israeli startup 42AI says it is developing a “behavioral world model” that can do just that, and it has just come out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding. The company is initially running its predictive system at a handful of financial brokerages, where it says the model can help predict how individual traders will respond to volatile conditions.

“Behavior is not deterministic; it’s constantly probabilistic,” 42AI’s CEO and co-founder Amit Gal-Or told TechCrunch when I asked him to justify his company’s tall claim. He argues that people have underlying psychological tendencies that influence their decisions even when their circumstances change, and that’s what the startup is trying to measure and convert into data that the model can understand.

“A week from now, you might be a different person, but your tendencies will always play out in certain areas to a probability or distribution,” his co-founder and CTO Ehud Ezra added. And that, the company argues, is what the model does: show the probability of a person making a certain decision.

42AI says the model tries to figure out people’s internal motivations instead of extrapolating patterns based on their previous actions. To do that, 42AI examines how people react to seemingly unrelated events. For an investor or trader, for example, such events might include completing KYC processes, onboarding, support calls, money transfers, or trading stocks.

“When the person is talking to support or sales in the initial process […] we’re looking at the sentiment, we’re looking at the voice, we’re looking at a lot of interactions that they’re doing, how many times do they call, and so forth,” added CTO and co-founder Ehud Ezra. “And all of those data points are going into the model. article_content_zh:
这是一个直接来自科幻小说的问题：如果人工智能能够在你决定做什么之前预测你将要做什么，即使是在一个全新的情况下，会怎么样？

以色列初创公司 42AI 表示，它正在开发一种可以做到这一点的“行为世界模型”，并且刚刚获得 6250 万美元的种子资金。该公司最初在少数金融经纪公司运行其预测系统，该公司表示该模型可以帮助预测个体交易者将如何应对波动的情况。

当我请 42AI 的首席执行官兼联合创始人 Amit Gal-Or 证明其公司的高调说法时，他告诉 TechCrunch：“行为不是确定性的；它始终是概率性的。”他认为，即使环境发生变化，人们也有潜在的心理倾向，这些倾向会影响他们的决定，而这正是初创公司试图测量的内容，并将其转换为模型可以理解的数据。

他的联合创始人兼首席技术官埃胡德·埃兹拉 (Ehud Ezra) 补充道：“一周后，你可能会变成另一个人，但你的倾向总会在某些领域以概率或分布的方式发挥作用。”该公司认为，这就是该模型的作用：显示一个人做出某个决定的概率。

42AI 表示，该模型试图找出人们的内部动机，而不是根据人们之前的行为推断模式。为此，42AI 研究了人们对看似无关的事件的反应。例如，对于投资者或交易者来说，此类事件可能包括完成 KYC 流程、入职、支持电话、转账或股票交易。

“当人们在初始流程中与支持人员或销售人员交谈时 [...]，我们会关注情绪、声音、他们正在进行的大量互动、他们打电话的次数等等，”首席技术官兼联合创始人 Ehud Ezra 补充道。 “所有这些数据点都将进入模型。稍后，您将进行交互：如何买卖以及何时买卖，我们正在关注该阶段的市场。”

“所以我们试图了解他们如何看待世界。在世界模型中，每个人都是世界，”他补充道。

然后，该公司将这些观察结果转换为特征的数学表示，然后将其输入到基于变压器的世界模型中，该模型列出了在不同情况下可能做出的决策的概率。 （该公司使用单独的语言模型来为其预测生成解释）。

埃兹拉说，该模型经过训练，可以在模拟过程中保留一个人的潜在倾向。因此，如果某人通常厌恶风险，但模型突然将他们视为冒险者，那么“目标就偏离了”，他解释了模型的训练奖励是如何构建的。

42AI 花了三年时间开发这种方法，将心理学研究与神经科学和遗传学相结合，并听取了心理学和创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD) 专家以及 2011 年诺贝尔化学奖获得者丹·谢赫特曼 (Dan Shechtman) 的建议。

Gal-Or 表示，该团队首先通过心理评估和行为场景研究了数千人，然后添加了覆盖超过 200 万人的政府和生物银行数据集。他说，其客户数据集已扩大到覆盖近 3000 万人。

在实时部署中，该模型分析客户的现有记录，包括交易和支持电话。 Gal-Or 指出该系统不需要个人身份信息，并认为“模型永远不知道这个人是谁。”然而，该公司似乎仍然根据链接的客户活动创建个人行为档案。

在预测市场交易方面，42AI 声称其模型的准确率达到 98%，但 Gal-Or 澄清说，这更多的是衡量交易流量是否落在预测范围内，而不是衡量每笔交易是否预测正确。

他还表示，该模型在预测交易方向和交易量方面始终达到 0.8 至 0.85 的 F1 分数。 （F1 分数是机器学习中的一个指标，用于衡量分类模型在正确预测与误报和错过事件之间的平衡程度）。

article_content:
Anthropic reported updated financials as part of an amended Form S-1 filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, giving investors a more comprehensive look into the state of its business.

The artificial intelligence company said it generated $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ended Sept. 30, up roughly 1,200% from the same period last year. It reported a $104 billion net loss during the period, though most of that was due to the change in fair value of convertible notes and derivative liabilities. Anthropic had a loss of $25.1 billion over the same stretch in 2025.

Anthropic unveiled its highly anticipated prospectus last week, bringing the company one step closer to a potentially historic initial public offering. The initial filing only included the Claude maker's financials through the first half of the year.

During its third quarter, Anthropic generated roughly $17 billion in revenue, up about 1,127% from the same period last year. Revenue growth slowed on a quarter-to-quarter basis, however. Third-quarter revenue increased around 47%, a steep drop from 144% growth in Q2 and 132% in Q1.

The company reported a net loss of $23.29 billion during its third quarter.

As the 5-year-old company prepares to kick off its roadshow, it will have to reckon with growing market jitters around the AI buildout. Wall Street has been worried that rising interest rates will make debt unaffordable for many data center developers and neoclouds, and quarterly reports from Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon last week added fuel to those concerns.

The hyperscalers' aggressive AI spending is eating into their cash flows, causing some investors to worry that computing capacity may not come online quickly enough to meet Anthropic's demands. Anthropic gets much of its capacity from Amazon, Google and SpaceX, but it also relies on neoclouds for some compute as it races to expand as quickly as possible.

article_content_zh:
Anthropic 周一在向美国证券交易委员会提交的修订后的 S-1 表格中报告了最新的财务状况，让投资者能够更全面地了解其业务状况。

这家人工智能公司表示，截至 9 月 30 日的 9 个月内，其收入为 332.4 亿美元，比去年同期增长约 1,200%。该公司报告期内净亏损 1,040 亿美元，但其中大部分是由于可转换票据和衍生负债公允价值的变化造成的。 2025 年同期，Anthropic 亏损 251 亿美元。

Anthropic 上周公布了备受期待的招股说明书，使该公司距离潜在的历史性首次公开募股又近了一步。最初的文件仅包括克劳德制造商今年上半年的财务状况。

Anthropic 第三季度的收入约为 170 亿美元，比去年同期增长约 1,127%。然而，收入增长逐季放缓。第三季度收入增长约 47%，较第二季度的 144% 和第一季度的 132% 增幅大幅下降。

该公司第三季度净亏损 232.9 亿美元。

当这家成立 5 年的公司准备开始路演时，它将不得不面对围绕人工智能建设日益增长的市场不安情绪。华尔街一直担心利率上升将使许多数据中心开发商和neoclouds无力承担债务，而微软、Alphabet和亚马逊上周发布的季度报告加剧了这些担忧。

超大规模企业积极的人工智能支出正在蚕食他们的现金流，导致一些投资者担心计算能力可能无法足够快地上线以满足 Anthropic 的需求。 Anthropic 的大部分容量来自亚马逊、谷歌和 SpaceX，但它也依赖 Neoclouds 进行一些计算，因为它正在竞相尽快扩张。

在修订后的 S-1 中，Anthropic 表示已签订采购承诺和租赁协议，承诺支出总额约为 8954 亿美元，“基本上所有支出都与计算和基础设施有关”。

Anthropic 表示，截至 9 月 30 日的 9 个月，其计算和基础设施支出增加了 144 亿美元，较去年同期增长 329%。

Anthropic 在文件中表示：“随着我们的计算和基础设施容量的增长，相关的计算和基础设施费用也随之增加。”

该公司的首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 与其他几位从目前其主要竞争对手 OpenAI 叛逃的研究人员共同创立了 Anthropic。 OpenAI 于 6 月向 SEC 秘密提交了招股说明书，但其高管已表示其目标是在 2027 年首次亮相。

Anthropic 致力于将自己定位为比竞争对手更具安全意识的品牌，其 S-1 包含 90 多页的风险因素。该公司强调了风险，包括潜在的政治阻力、复杂的基础设施需求以及平衡安全和商业目标可能带来的困难。

Anthropic 的联合创始人在文件中表示：“我们认为，我们个人有责任帮助世界了解这些风险，在我们的人工智能模型中预防或减轻这些风险，并与政府和行业其他部门合作，在社会层面解决这些风险。”

title: Anthropic grows revenue twelvefold but posts $23 billion loss
title_en: Anthropic grows revenue twelvefold but posts $23 billion loss
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Anthropic swings back to an operating loss ahead of its blockbuster IPO. According to Bloomberg, the company posted quarterly revenue of nearly $17 billion, twelve times what it brought in a year earlier. But operating costs of $17.5 billion outpaced that revenue, wiping out the profit Anthropic had reported the previous quarter, according to The Information. The net loss came in at $23.3 billion for the quarter, up from $12.1 billion a year ago.

Anthropic pointed to two main drivers behind the cost spike: $5 billion for short-term compute capacity it locked in and $2 billion in employee donation matching. The company has been grappling with a compute crunch since late last year. According to the New York Times, it has since signed dozens of deals with Amazon, Google, SpaceX, chipmakers, and former crypto miners. Anthropic is expected to have access to more than 3.5 gigawatts of power this year and plans to double that next year.

All told, the company's updated prospectus shows $895 billion in commitments for compute and data center leases. Those costs add pressure on the IPO, which could raise around $100 billion, the New York Times reports. Up to $3.5 billion of that is expected to come from Japanese investors.

article_content_zh:
在轰动一时的 IPO 之前，Anthropic 再次陷入运营亏损。据彭博社报道，该公司公布的季度收入接近 170 亿美元，是上年同期的 12 倍。但据 The Information 报道，175 亿美元的运营成本超过了收入，抹去了 Anthropic 上一季度报告的利润。该季度净亏损为 233 亿美元，高于去年同期的 121 亿美元。

Anthropic 指出成本飙升背后的两个主要驱动因素：锁定的 50 亿美元短期计算能力和 20 亿美元的员工捐赠匹配。自去年年底以来，该公司一直在努力应对计算危机。据《纽约时报》报道，此后该公司已与亚马逊、谷歌、SpaceX、芯片制造商和前加密货币矿工签署了数十项协议。 Anthropic 预计今年将获得超过 3.5 吉瓦的电力，并计划明年将这一数字增加一倍。

总而言之，该公司更新后的招股说明书显示，其计算和数据中心租赁承诺金额为 8950 亿美元。据《纽约时报》报道，这些成本增加了 IPO 的压力，IPO 可能筹集约 1000 亿美元资金。其中高达 35 亿美元预计将来自日本投资者。

title: A profile of OpenAI VP Charles Porch, an ex-Instagram executive who is rehabilitating AI's image across Hollywood and the media, including via celebrity dinners (Charlotte Klein/New York Magazine)

author: New York Magazine
article_content:

Photo: Danielle Levitt for New York Magazine Photo: Danielle Levitt for New York Magazine In August, news leaked that Gwyneth Paltrow was set to host “a private, off-the-record, alfresco dinner” at her Amagansett home in honor of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. “I guess summers in the Hamptons just aren’t complete these days without sucking up to our new AI overlords,” Puck’s Matt Belloni, who broke the news, wrote. “Luckily, Gwyneth Paltrow has you covered.” The backlash was vicious — “tone-deaf dumbass,” one X user wrote — and the dinner was postponed.

“God, the internet made it such a bigger thing than it was,” says Charles Porch, who brokered the dinner with Paltrow’s team, as he sips an Arnold Palmer on a crisp afternoon in October outside Sant Ambroeus in Soho. “Gwyneth invests in the space. She does these investor dinners all the time. Sam was coming through town and I was like, ‘Let’s just do this.’”

Altman had hired Porch in 2025 to do for OpenAI what he had done so successfully for Instagram for more than a decade: persuade famous people in Hollywood and beyond to use and partner with the platform and help the tech company be culturally relevant. The freak-out over Paltrow’s dinner reflected how much public sentiment toward big tech had shifted since Porch’s Instagram days, when Anna Wintour hosted the same kind of event for its CEO at the time, Kevin Systrom. I ask him if it made him rethink the playbook. “It makes it look like that’s the strategy, and it’s not the strategy. That was, like, a dinner,” Porch says. “But I know those dinners are effective because I see it. We did the dinner eventually, and it was great.” It took place at the apartment of an AI enthusiast at the end of September in New York.

照片：Danielle Levitt for New York Magazine 照片：Danielle Levitt for New York Magazine 8 月，有消息透露，格温妮丝·帕特洛 (Gwyneth Paltrow) 将在她阿玛甘塞特的家中举办“一场私人的、不公开的露天晚宴”，以纪念 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman)。 Puck 的马特·贝洛尼 (Matt Belloni) 爆料了这一消息，他写道：“我想，如果不讨好我们的新人工智能霸主，汉普顿的夏天就不算完整。” “幸运的是，格温妮丝·帕特洛为你提供了保障。”一位 X 用户写道，强烈反对是“五音不全的笨蛋”，晚餐被推迟了。

“天哪，互联网让它变得比原来更重要了，”10 月一个清爽的下午，在苏活区圣安布罗厄斯 (Sant Ambroeus) 外，负责与帕特洛团队共进晚餐的查尔斯·波奇 (Charles Porch) 一边喝着阿诺·帕尔默 (Arnold Palmer) 啤酒一边说道。 “格温妮丝投资了这个领域。她总是举办这些投资者晚宴。萨姆正从镇上过来，我当时想，‘我们就这么做吧。’”

Altman 于 2025 年聘请了 Porch，为 OpenAI 做他十多年来为 Instagram 所做的成功的事情：说服好莱坞及其他地区的名人使用该平台并与该平台合作，帮助这家科技公司在文化上具有相关性。帕特洛晚宴引发的恐慌反映了自 Porch 推出 Instagram 时代以来，公众对大型科技公司的情绪发生了多大转变，当时安娜·温图尔 (Anna Wintour) 为其时任首席执行官凯文·斯特罗姆 (Kevin Systrom) 举办了类似的活动。我问他这是否让他重新思考剧本。 “这使得这看起来像是策略，但实际上并不是策略。那就像一顿晚餐，”波奇说。 “但我知道这些晚餐是有效的，因为我看到了。我们最终完成了晚餐，非常棒。” 9月底，事情发生在纽约一位人工智能爱好者的公寓里。

超过一定收入水平的每个人似乎都认识查尔斯·波奇，但很少有人能告诉你他到底做什么。 20 岁时，他开着祖母的本田雅阁旅行车出现在洛杉矶，并在接下来的二十年里培养了一个由名人和影响者组成的强大网络。音乐制作人大卫·福斯特 (David Foster) 的女儿艾琳·福斯特 (Erin Foster) 人脉广泛，她在华纳兄弟唱片公司 (Warner Bros. Records) 的下属时期认识了波奇，她说：“他一步步走得非常小心，从不烧毁一座桥梁，从不不按顺序说话，从不以错误的方式利用机会。”

45 岁的 Porch 说：“我不是一个业务开发人员或品牌人员。我是负责关系的人，负责让每个人都了解新技术。”他自称是“技术乐观主义者”，长期以来一直在个人和专业之间的灰色地带游刃有余。 “有一个关于交朋友的策略。”

当他在大流行之前抵达纽约时，似乎很少有人注意到。对于那些不知道或不关心 2010 年代初门洛帕克发生的事情的人来说，他们第一次听说 Porch 很可能是在他于 2025 年与亿万富翁的继承人罗伯特·丹宁 (Robert Denning) 结婚之后，与杰里·宋飞 (Jerry) 和杰西卡·宋飞 (Jessica Seinfeld)、玛莉丝卡·哈吉泰 (Mariska Hargitay)、安东尼·布林肯 (Antony Blinken)、哈里·斯泰尔斯 (Harry Styles)（与他有一个教子）、尼基·希尔顿·罗斯柴尔德 (N...

title: One brutal Minecraft night scared 50 AI agents into inventing chicken handoff protocols, a Fertilizer Officer, and fishing shifts
title_en: One brutal Minecraft night scared 50 AI agents into inventing chicken handoff protocols, a Fertilizer Officer, and fishing shifts
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
In experiments by Y Combinator Labs and Olam Labs, OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol model showed two very different sides. When 50 agents were tasked with peaceful civilization-building in Minecraft, they froze up in absurd bureaucracy. In direct competition against Claude Opus 5.5, they independently downloaded the game's source code to win. Simulations like these are meant to serve as an early warning system before AI swarms act unpredictably in real-world systems.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在由YC Labs和Olam Labs联合开展的AI模拟实验中，OpenAI的GPT-6.1 Sol模型表现出惊人的复杂适应性。当50个AI代理被置于《我的世界》（Minecraft）中构建和平文明时，它们非但没有陷入死板停滞，反而在严酷的生存压力下自发衍生出了离奇的官僚体系——包括发明了鸡只交接协议、设立了化肥专员以及分配了专门的捕鱼班次，为研究人员观察AI群体在极端环境下的社会演化提供了警示。

title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
title_en: Scaling Git at OpenAI
author: OpenAI 官方动态
content_snippet: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.
summary_en: OpenAI's engineering team announced the launch of Pando, a custom Git-compatible backend designed to handle the massive development scale generated by AI tools like Codex. Traditional Git infrastructure struggles to cope with the sheer volume of code produced autonomously around the clock, forcing OpenAI to build this scalable alternative to keep version control from melting.
title_zh: OpenAI自研Pando系统重构Git
summary_zh: OpenAI官方推出专为AI代码生成规模化开发设计的Git兼容后端Pando系统
article_content_zh:
OpenAI近日官方披露了名为Pando的技术项目，这是一款专为配合其AI代码生成工具Codex而生的高性能Git兼容后端系统。

随着大模型在软件工程领域的深度渗透，AI生成的代码量呈指数级增长，传统分布式版本控制系统在处理海量提交记录、频繁合并冲突以及极高并发操作时逐渐显现出性能瓶颈。Pando的问世正是为了填补这一底层基础设施的空白，确保在大规模自动化编程时代，代码版本管理能够跟上AI狂飙突进的步伐。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI工程团队在官方技术博客宣布推出全新自研后端系统Pando，旨在解决Codex等AI大规模代码生成带来的版本控制压力。由于传统的Git在面对AI全天候疯狂暴走式产出的海量代码时频繁性能崩溃，OpenAI不得不亲自动手，打造了这个完美兼容Git标准但能支撑恐怖代码量级的底层基础设施，以防自家程序员被AI卷到失业前先被版本冲突折磨疯。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI's engineering team announced the launch of Pando, a custom Git-compatible backend designed to handle the massive development scale generated by AI tools like Codex. Traditional Git infrastructure struggles to cope with the sheer volume of code produced autonomously around the clock, forcing OpenAI to build this scalable alternative to keep version control from melting.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 当AI写代码的速度快到能把传统的Git直接搞崩溃时，宇宙的尽头果然还是得靠自己造轮子。这大概就是“我用魔法击败魔法，再用基建收拾残局”的最高境界吧。
ai_analysis.insight_en: When AI writes code so fast that it literally breaks standard Git, you know you've reached peak tech-flex. It's the ultimate 'I used magic to generate the problem, now I'll build a new universe to manage it' flex.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: OpenAI工程团队在官方技术博客宣布推出全新自研后端系统Pando，旨在解决Codex等AI大规模代码生成带来的版本控制压力。由于传统的Git在面对AI全天候疯狂暴走式产出的海量代码时频繁性能崩溃，OpenAI不得不亲自动手，打造了这个完美兼容Git标准但能支撑恐怖代码量级的底层基础设施，以防自家程序员被AI卷到失业前先被版本冲突折磨疯。
ai_analysis.digest_en: OpenAI's engineering team announced the launch of Pando, a custom Git-compatible backend designed to handle the massive development scale generated by AI tools like Codex. Traditional Git infrastructure struggles to cope with the sheer volume of code produced autonomously around the clock, forcing OpenAI to build this scalable alternative to keep version control from melting.

title: Sources detail Anthropic's compute deal spree: 3.5GW+ of expected capacity in 2026, diversifying beyond Nvidia's AI chips to Amazon, Google, and AMD, and more (New York Times)
title_en: Sources detail Anthropic's compute deal spree: 3.5GW+ of expected capacity in 2026, diversifying beyond Nvidia's AI chips to Amazon, Google, and AMD, and more (New York Times)
author: New York Times
content_snippet: Illustration by Mark Harris; Photographs by Thea Traff for The New York Times, AJ Mast for The New York Times, Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times, Getty Images
summary_en: Anthropic is aggressively securing compute capacity, expecting over 3.5GW by 2026 by diversifying beyond Nvidia to sign deals with Amazon, Google, AMD, chipmakers, and former crypto miners.
title_zh: Anthropic狂揽算力：2026年容量超3.5吉瓦
summary_zh: Anthropic通过疯狂签署算力大单，在2026年将拥有超3.5吉瓦算力，并摆脱对英伟达的单一依赖

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic为了打破算力瓶颈并支撑大模型训练，近期开启了疯狂的算力并购与合作大单签约。消息显示，该公司预计在2026年获得超过3.5吉瓦（GW）的电力与算力容量，并在未来计划将该规模翻倍。在此过程中，Anthropic彻底摆脱了对英伟达AI芯片的单一依赖，转而与亚马逊、谷歌、AMD及多家芯片商和前加密矿企签署了数十项基础设施协议。

content_snippet: The software company is selling $10 billion in common stock and $10 billion in bonds — Oracle plans to raise $20 billion …

title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
title_en: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
author: OpenAI 官方动态
content_snippet: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.
summary_en: OpenAI has introduced the Grid Protectors Program to collaborate with utilities, ensuring that its future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.
title_zh: OpenAI推出“网格保护者计划”以应对电网压力
summary_zh: OpenAI推出Grid Protectors Program，旨在携手公用事业公司保障未来算力园区的电网可靠性

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI官方正式推出了名为“网格保护者计划”（Grid Protectors Program）的全新能源环保倡议。该项目旨在与各地的公用事业公司展开深度合作，确保其未来建设的大型算力园区不会拖垮地方电网，并通过技术与管理手段保障电网的整体运行可靠性，以此保护普通消费者的电力成本不受AI用电荒波及。

title: Email: OpenAI plans to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs on desktop for select users before rolling it out widely; Codex "will remain a separate experience" (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
title_en: Email: OpenAI plans to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs on desktop for select users before rolling it out widely; Codex "will remain a separate experience" (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
The ChatGPT desktop app can be a confusing piece of software, given that there are ChatGPT and Codex sections, and within the former, there are Chat and Work tabs. With so many options, it’s sometimes easy to forget where you are working and where exactly your project is.

In an apparent effort to address this, OpenAI is now gearing up to merge the Chat and Work tabs within the ChatGPT experience, according to an email sent to users. OpenAI said that initially, this experience will be available to select users for feedback before it is rolled out widely.

“This will enable you to move from exploring an idea to having ChatGPT carry it through, all in one place. You can bring in your files and plugins and ask ChatGPT to build a website, create a presentation, or do things for you on the web, while reviewing and guiding its work. Codex will remain a separate experience in the ChatGPT desktop app,” the email said.

OpenAI also said with this transition, both ChatGPT and Codex will draw tokens from the same allowance pool. It said this change won’t impact most users, but based on usage and model, some folks might need to wait for resets more frequently.

Rival Anthropic merged Claude’s chat and Cowork functions into one screen in September.

ChatGPT 桌面应用程序可能是一个令人困惑的软件，因为它有 ChatGPT 和 Codex 部分，而在前者中，有聊天和工作选项卡。有如此多的选择，有时很容易忘记您在哪里工作以及您的项目到底在哪里。

title: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
title_en: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors. A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt. The more useful the agent becomes, the more calls it makes. With per-token pricing, the workflows creating the most value can also become the most expensive.

The financial pressure is already visible. Uber reportedly exhausted its entire 2026 AI budget by April after expanding its use of Claude Code. GitHub Copilot moved from flat-rate pricing to metered credits. Gartner predicts that AI coding token costs will surpass average developer salaries by 2028.

The natural response is rationing usage caps, seat limits, and approvals before developers launch agents. But blanket limits can restrict the workflows delivering value. They also optimize the wrong number. Cost per token measures consumption, not results. Some spending reflects waste, including retries and runaway loops. Some represents the work of shipping software. A meter cannot distinguish them, and neither can a spending cap.

article_content_zh:
当开发人员向人工智能代理分配编码任务时，代理不仅会回答一次。它计划、生成代码、运行测试并重复该过程以纠正错误。单个任务可以使用比基本聊天提示多 10 到 50 倍的令牌。代理变得越有用，它拨打的电话就越多。通过按代币定价，创造最大价值的工作流程也可能变得最昂贵。

资金压力已经显现。据报道，在扩大 Claude Code 的使用范围后，Uber 到 4 月份就用完了 2026 年的全部人工智能预算。 GitHub Copilot 从固定费率定价转变为计量积分。 Gartner 预测，到 2028 年，AI 编码代币成本将超过开发人员的平均工资。

自然的反应是在开发人员推出代理之前限制使用上限、席位限制和批准。但全面限制可能会限制工作流程交付价值。他们还优化了错误的数字。每个代币的成本衡量的是消耗，而不是结果。一些支出反映了浪费，包括重试和失控循环。有些代表了运输软件的工作。仪表无法区分它们，支出上限也无法区分。

title: The Download: the agentic web arrives and the drive for safer roads
title_en: The Download: the agentic web arrives and the drive for safer roads
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
In 2001, a decade after inventing the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision: an internet navigated by autonomous software agents that address our every need, without requiring us to muck about with browsers and search engines ourselves.

At the time, the idea seemed far-fetched. But a quarter-century on, AI agents are beginning to make it a reality. They can triage your inbox, do your grocery shopping, and even access your bank accounts.

This new era is being called the agentic web. It will inevitably transform the internet—and whether the human web survives this transition is anyone’s guess.

title: When You Should—and Shouldn’t—Use AI to Search the Web
title_en: When You Should—and Shouldn’t—Use AI to Search the Web
author: Wired AI
article_content:
When asked to search the web, the latest versions of these bots are combining elements of traditional web search (they're essentially just googling on your behalf) with knowledge they are able to pull out of their training data. Everything is then packaged and formatted in the now-familiar, polished generative AI style.

It's the added AI elements on top of the traditional googling where the differences come in, and that means AI-powered search may not always be the best option.

If you're looking up something simple and widely known—like the height of the Empire State Building—then AI search is a pretty safe bet. Not only is information like this easy to access online, the “autocorrect” probability patterns favored by large language models mean there's a near-certain chance that the results you see will include the right information.

If you just need a quick look-up, AI is OK. The more obscure the question, though, the closer you need to look at the answer. If you've asked something less well known, like the fifth-billed actor in an obscure television show, there might only be one or two references to it on the web, and an AI might choose the wrong one.

One of the takeaways from recent Stanford University research is that when AI finds an accurate source, it's very good at pulling the right information out of it. Where it tends to fall down is in not finding accurate sources (either because there aren't any or because the query has been misinterpreted) and presenting a confident answer anyway.

AI search is also helpful when you have a complex query that a standard Google search wouldn't be able to parse: "I need to know the best restaurants in San Francisco for a family of five who want to spend no more than $200." AI is able to query and collate multiple sources in response to a search like this, and then present a well-synthesized answer. A traditional web search would give you a list of blue links that most probably just rank San Francisco restaurants by more...

article_content_zh:
当被要求搜索网络时，这些机器人的最新版本将传统网络搜索的元素（它们本质上只是代表您进行谷歌搜索）与它们能够从训练数据中提取的知识相结合。然后，所有内容都会以现在熟悉的、完善的生成式人工智能风格进行打包和格式化。

差异在于传统谷歌搜索之上添加的人工智能元素，这意味着人工智能驱动的搜索可能并不总是最好的选择。

如果您正在查找一些简单且众所周知的内容（例如帝国大厦的高度），那么人工智能搜索是一个非常安全的选择。这样的信息不仅可以轻松在线访问，而且大型语言模型所青睐的“自动更正”概率模式意味着您看到的结果几乎肯定会包含正确的信息。

如果你只是需要快速查找，人工智能就可以。然而，问题越模糊，你就越需要仔细研究答案。如果你问了一些不太为人所知的问题，比如一部不起眼的电视节目中的第五名演员，网络上可能只有一两个参考资料，而人工智能可能会选择错误的答案。

斯坦福大学最近的研究得出的结论之一是，当人工智能找到准确的来源时，它非常擅长从中提取正确的信息。它往往会失败的地方是找不到准确的来源（要么因为没有任何来源，要么因为查询被误解）并且无论如何都无法提供自信的答案。

当您遇到标准 Google 搜索无法解析的复杂查询时，人工智能搜索也会很有帮助：“我需要知道旧金山最好的一家五口之家的餐厅，他们的花费不超过 200 美元。”人工智能能够查询和整理多个来源来响应这样的搜索，然后提供一个综合良好的答案。传统的网络搜索会给您一个蓝色链接列表，这些链接很可能只是根据更基本的标准对旧金山餐厅进行排名。

不过，来源仍然至关重要。人工智能机器人从未去过旧金山或在那里吃过饭。他们依赖网络上的公共帐户，这些帐户是由拥有公共帐户的人编写的。如果没有精确的页面匹配，他们将查找相关单词（例如“负担得起”或“家庭”）并生成答案。

对于网上有大量信息的查询，比如旧金山的餐馆，人工智能网络搜索会感觉非常有用。对于不太受欢迎的目的地和更具体的要求（“星星形状的餐桌”），您需要对结果更加小心，因为人工智能连接点的方式变得不太可靠。

因此，需要注意的是，您应该始终进行某种双重检查，人工智能网络搜索最适合常见查询，这些查询可能会导致大量准确、最新的在线信息。人工智能聊天机器人在处理搜索查询、打包和综合答案方面都是谷歌搜索的重大升级。

生成式人工智能机器人和法学硕士的组合方式意味着它们在释义、综合和总结时效果最佳。但这些过程也可能会引入错误。如果您的搜索需要精确的详细信息（例如名人名言、报告统计数据或设备规格），传统的 Google 搜索可能效果最好。

如果您想完全控制所使用的来源，那么前往 Google 并以旧方式搜索也可能会更好。将网络搜索转移给人工智能很方便，但您需要依靠它们来正确解释您的搜索，找到正确的来源，然后从这些来源中提取准确的信息。它节省了时间，但更不透明。

例如，如果您知道最信任的科技新闻网站，您可以在传统网络搜索中以人工智能可能无法做到的方式对它们进行优先排序。加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员发现，人工智能网络搜索有时会选择来源，因为它们与查询更相关，而不是因为它们被评为更权威。

这意味着，如果人工智能认为个人博客与用户实际搜索的内容更匹配，那么可能会选择个人博客而不是专业医疗保健网站。在扫描传统结果列表时，您不太可能做出这种选择，因为您通常会选择最信任的结果。

传统搜索仍然胜出的其他领域是突发新闻（人工智能提取的数据的及时性有时可能存在滞后）和绝对不会出错的高风险搜索，例如与健康、法律或财务相关的搜索。

title: Saudi Aramco takes 49 percent stake in AI firm Humain with $2.6 billion deal
title_en: Saudi Aramco takes 49 percent stake in AI firm Humain with $2.6 billion deal
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Saudi Aramco is buying into Humain, the company meant to turn Saudi Arabia into a global AI hub. According to Aramco, the oil giant is taking a 49 percent stake and contributing about $2.6 billion in 2026 along with its own AI technology. Humain was founded in May 2025 by the sovereign wealth fund PIF and builds data centers, develops cloud services, and trains AI models like the Arabic language model ALLaM.

Humain plans to build three gigawatts of data center capacity by 2030. The company wants to serve demand both domestically and abroad and become a leading AI exporter. Business is already picking up. In late August, AMD reported that infrastructure built jointly with Cisco and Humain is now serving customers inside and outside Saudi Arabia. Aramco plans to use the technology in its own operations and generate additional revenue by selling its own AI solutions. Through its investment arm Wa'ed Ventures, the company also holds a stake in Korean AI chip developer Rebellions.

The Iran war is affecting the buildout. Humain is beefing up protection for its data centers, CEO Tareq Amin told Semafor in September. Saudi Arabia is drawing on Aramco's experience securing oil infrastructure as a model. Despite the war, Humain hasn't seen any drop in demand.

title: British physicist and materials scientist Cyril Hilsum, widely recognized as "the father of liquid crystals" for enabling flat-panel display tech, died at 101 (Michael S. Rosenwald/New York Times)
title_en: British physicist and materials scientist Cyril Hilsum, widely recognized as "the father of liquid crystals" for enabling flat-panel display tech, died at 101 (Michael S. Rosenwald/New York Times)
author: New York Times
content_snippet: The man who helped develop the technology for liquid crystal displays — the screens in flat-panel televisions and laptops — has died at 101.
summary_en: British physicist Cyril Hilsum has passed away at the age of 101, recognized as the pioneer who enabled modern flat-panel display technology. Amidst the era dominated by bulky CRT monitors, he led the team that engineered liquid crystal materials, fundamentally transforming how humanity consumes visual information.

content_snippet: Ukraine and Russia said they faced cyberattacks on emergency and air raid alert systems.
summary_en: Both Ukrainian and Russian civil defense alert systems were compromised by cyberattacks late Sunday, pushing false 'nuclear danger' warnings via their respective apps. Both sides confirmed the breaches, highlighting the vulnerability of wartime digital infrastructure.

title: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
title_en: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI is gearing up for a political lobbying and PR push after the US midterms. According to Axios, the company is bracing for a tougher fight in Washington if Democrats win control of the House.

After two years under a friendly administration, big tech companies with close ties to President Trump are facing growing regulatory pressure. Rivals like Meta are already building bridges to Democrats. OpenAI's policy chief Chris Lehane plans to steer the AI debate through 2028 with a mix of new and repackaged proposals. The pitch centers on one idea: AI doesn't replace people. To back that up, OpenAI is proposing binding safety rules that build on earlier ideas. Lehane calls them "speed limits."

The company is also responding to growing local backlash against data centers. According to Axios, OpenAI wants to rebrand the facilities as "AI Compute Campuses" and is promising economic benefits to host communities. Lehane says the company's top priority in the new Congress is fast-tracking safety rules for frontier models.

OpenAI 正在为美国中期选举后的政治游说和公关活动做准备。据 Axios 称，如果民主党赢得众议院控制权，该公司将在华盛顿面临更激烈的战斗。

在友好政府执政两年后，与特朗普总统关系密切的大型科技公司面临着越来越大的监管压力。像 Meta 这样的竞争对手已经在与民主党建立桥梁。 OpenAI 的政策负责人 Chris Lehane 计划通过一系列新的和重新包装的提案来引导人工智能辩论持续到 2028 年。此次演讲围绕一个想法：人工智能不会取代人类。为了支持这一点，OpenAI 提出了基于早期想法的具有约束力的安全规则。勒汉称其为“速度限制”。

title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
title_en: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
author: Wired AI
article_content:
At first glance, the self-proclaimed “pet portrait” app Viefur appears to be just another AI slop generator. Using digital coins sold in the app—around $4 will buy 130 coins—pet photos can be turned into an “anthropomorphic portrait,” with the critter dressed in “human clothing” and inserted into bizarre scenes. Think a hamster wearing beach shorts, sunglasses, and lounging in a swimming pool or a Hawaiian shirt-wearing cat, drinking from a coconut.

All of this is cover for what appears to be the app’s true purpose: creating sexually abusive deepfake images.

A WIRED investigation found the app is part of a network of more than 400 connected domains and apps that, like Viefur, often claim to be everyday services—such as language tuition or AI workout coaches. When accessed under certain conditions, however, apps in the network stealthily load a web interface allowing the generation of explicit AI sexual images and videos using photos users upload. The apps include AI scenes such as “bedroom rape” and “threatening knife,” where a man holds a knife to a woman’s neck.

The network was discovered hiding in plain sight, by multiple researchers, after they investigated links from thousands of video ads containing explicit deepfake content that were published on Meta’s Facebook and Instagram. As WIRED has reported in recent months, hundreds of these ads contained AI generated child sexual abuse material, including images of real children and a member of a European royal family. The ads reached tens of thousands of people and have prompted investigations from regulators around the world.

In each case, the ads linked out to the deceptive apps in Apple and Google’s app stores—allowing people to generate explicit images and make payments using Apple and Google Pay. The network behind the nudify apps appears to have been publishing them for around a year, at times publishing dozens per week. This is despite Google, Apple, and Meta saying they enforce their policies that do no...

article_content_zh:

In 2001, a decade after he invented the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision. Together with two colleagues, he published an article in the magazine Scientific American in which he outlined what he called the “Semantic Web”: an internet designed to be navigated by autonomous software agents that could address our every need, without requiring us to muck about with browsers and search engines ourselves.

title_zh: 智能体网络时代正式降临：自主软件接管互联网
summary_zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李24年前构想的“语义网”在Meta和OpenAI等新型智能体推动下终成现实，自主软件正深入人们的日常生活与财务管理
article_content_zh:
在2001年万维网诞生十年后，蒂姆·伯纳斯-李与其同僚在《科学美国人》杂志发表文章，勾勒了名为“语义网”的新愿景：一个专为自主软件智能体导航设计的互联网，能够满足人们的各种需求，而无需亲自拨弄浏览器和搜索引擎。

尽管在千禧年之交，这种愿景显得十分遥远，但经过四分之一个世纪的发展，代客行事的自主软件梦想终于成真。Meta和OpenAI等机构推出的新型智能体工具正创下下载量记录，并被赋予了访问用户银行账户和电子邮箱的权限。

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Tim Berners-Lee's 2001 vision of the Semantic Web has finally materialized, as advanced tools like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots gain massive downloads and direct access to personal bank accounts and inboxes.

title: A profile of UCLA professor Terence Tao, who was once enthusiastic about AI's role in math but now warns of AI destroying the field's deliberative process (Rivka Galchen/New Yorker)
title_en: A profile of UCLA professor Terence Tao, who was once enthusiastic about AI's role in math but now warns of AI destroying the field's deliberative process (Rivka Galchen/New Yorker)
author: New Yorker
article_content:
A mathematician is a machine for turning coffee into theorems. This was a line often invoked by the Hungarian mathematician Paul Erdős, who was fuelled by coffee and amphetamines, slept little, travelled near-constantly, never married or had children, and published almost fifteen hundred papers in his lifetime, in collaboration with hundreds of other mathematicians. But Erdős was, in most ways, not machinelike. He called lecturing in mathematics “preaching,” woke friends at odd hours by asking, “Is your brain open?,” wore only silk underclothing on account of his sensitive skin, and claimed not to have learned how to butter toast until he was twenty-one. He gave away most of his earnings to charitable causes and to young mathematicians in need of funds for their education, and he offered bounties (sometimes ten dollars, sometimes a thousand) for solutions to mathematical problems he’d proposed. Mathematics was his life. Mathematicians were his family. It has been said that, even above his remarkable contributions to the mathematical literature, he helped the discipline most profoundly by turning people who might otherwise have become hedge-fund managers or F.B.I. agents or lost souls into mathematicians. When he died, in 1996, at the age of eighty-three, he left behind about a thousand problems. Solving an Erdős problem is a great honor, as is having a low “Erdős number,” a term that describes how many degrees of separation one is from having published work with him.

Terence Tao was ten years old when Erdős visited his home town of Adelaide, Australia, in 1985. Erdős loved children and called them epsilons. Tao, a mathematics prodigy, had started taking college-level courses at age nine. Erdős posed a problem for him and Tao to work on together. title_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩：AI或将摧毁数学界的深思熟虑
summary_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校教授陶哲轩在访谈中表达了对人工智能的双重态度，他曾热衷于数学AI，如今却警告其可能破坏数学研究的审慎过程
article_content_zh:
数学家是一台把咖啡变成定理的机器——匈牙利数学家保罗·埃尔德什常引用这句话。他一生沉迷于咖啡与安非他命，几乎不眠不休、频繁旅行，发表了近1500篇论文。

然而埃尔德什在许多方面并不像机器，他将数学演讲称为“传教”，把数学视作生命与家庭。如今，当代的数学大师们正站在AI变革的十字路口，重新审视这种将智力劳动机械化的浪潮将把人类引向何方。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校知名数学家陶哲轩在接受《纽约客》专访时，剖析了数学研究的传统人文特质与机器化趋势。他在职业生涯中曾对人工智能在数学领域的应用抱持极大热情，但随着技术狂飙突进，他如今开始公开警告AI可能会彻底摧毁数学界原本宝贵的审慎思考与推敲过程。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: UCLA mathematics professor Terence Tao discussed the evolving intersection of AI and mathematics in a New Yorker profile, shifting from early enthusiasm to warnings that AI could destroy the deliberative nature of mathematical research.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 连数学界扫地僧都开始急了：AI不仅想抢走民工的饭碗，还想把数学家几百年来的脑力苦行变成一键生成。当证明定理变成拼算力的流水线，人类最后这点智力尊严怕是也要被大模型内卷殆尽了。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Even the LeBron James of math is sweating: AI isn't just coming for blue-collar jobs, it's automating centuries of intellectual agony. When proving theorems becomes a prompt-engineering factory line, human dignity is in serious trouble.

title: LifeVal
title_en: LifeVal
author: OpenAI 官方动态
content_snippet: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.
summary_en: OpenAI has introduced the LifeVal benchmark to evaluate AI models on their proficiency in executing real-world daily tasks, such as finding childcare, managing finances, and handling government paperwork. This initiative marks a strategic shift from synthetic performance metrics toward assessing an AI's practical utility in navigating complex human life.
title_zh: OpenAI发布LifeVal基准测试
summary_zh: OpenAI推出名为LifeVal的全新AI基准测试，旨在评估模型在处理育儿、理财及行政文书等日常复杂任务中的实用能力

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI正式推出LifeVal测试基准，通过模拟真实生活场景中育儿寻托、财务规划及政府文书处理等琐碎需求，量化AI在现实生活中的代办能力。此举旨在将模型测试重心从跑分刷榜转向解决具体的“人类生存痛点”，以验证其模型解决复杂现实事务的落地表现。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI has introduced the LifeVal benchmark to evaluate AI models on their proficiency in executing real-world daily tasks, such as finding childcare, managing finances, and handling government paperwork. This initiative marks a strategic shift from synthetic performance metrics toward assessing an AI's practical utility in navigating complex human life.

elements_zh.where: 官方发布平台
elements_zh.what: 发布LifeVal基准测试，衡量AI在处理育儿、理财、行政事务等日常琐事中的表现
elements_zh.why: 旨在将AI能力评价体系从实验室代码转向解决真实的“人类生活痛点”

elements_en.what: Launched LifeVal to measure AI capability in tasks like childcare, finance, and paperwork
elements_en.why: To shift AI evaluation from benchmark gaming to solving real-world human pain points

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 看来OpenAI也意识到，光让模型做高数题和写诗已经没法让用户心甘情愿掏钱了。当AI开始学会处理政府文书和报税，这哪里是在测试基准，这分明是在试图向全人类证明：它确实比你那个磨蹭的助理强多了。
ai_analysis.insight_en: It seems OpenAI realized that solving calculus problems and writing poetry won't keep users paying forever. When AI starts handling taxes and government red tape, it's not just a benchmark—it's a not-so-subtle signal that your lazy human assistant is officially on the chopping block.

title: YC details multi-agent tests in games like Minecraft, where agents exhibit emergent capabilities, forming roles, hierarchies, and complex coordination patterns (YC Labs)
title_en: YC details multi-agent tests in games like Minecraft, where agents exhibit emergent capabilities, forming roles, hierarchies, and complex coordination patterns (YC Labs)
author: YC Labs
article_content:
Understanding multi-agent dynamics is one of the most pressing challenges in AI alignment. Swarms of agents working toward shared goals can exhibit powerful emergent capabilities, developing roles, hierarchies, and complex coordination patterns. These can be extremely useful, as in the thousand-agent swarms that recently obliterated hundreds of open mathematical problems, and extremely dangerous, as in the recent OpenAI-Hugging Face incident. Like biology, studying agent dynamics requires both formal models (to describe the range of possible behaviors) and empirical research (to see what behaviors arise in practice).

We teamed up with Olam Labs, which builds multi-agent environments for frontier labs, to run a series of experiments in Minecraft and Mindustry.

Minecraft is a natural environment for studying swarm behavior. Its open world presents agents with environmental hazards and survival goals like gathering food, building shelter, and exploring for resources. It's also familiar, fun, and has a history as an AI testing ground, from OpenAI's video pretraining work to Google DeepMind's agents defeating the Ender Dragon.

We wanted long-running agents that could play Minecraft. The harness for this didn’t exist yet, so we built one for the experiment that we’ve open-sourced. Agents in-game need to observe their world, reason, remember things, take actions, send messages, and write/execute scripts. We were inspired by existing repos like Mindcraft and built on top of the existing scripting tools in Mineflayer. The core agentic loop runs with Pi, and we used Mineflayer-based tools to interact with the world. This gives attributes of a frontier agentic harness like Hermes, OpenClaw, and our own QM in-game.

50 GPT-6.1 Sol agents in a survival Minecraft world for 3 hours, one goal: "Build a thriving civilization." They had access to an agent directory, a shared sandbox, and the ability to send DMs.

title: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx, an agentic capability benchmark measuring 11 domains, including chip design, cybersecurity, and RSI; Opus 5.5 tops with a 12% score (SemiAnalysis)
title_en: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx, an agentic capability benchmark measuring 11 domains, including chip design, cybersecurity, and RSI; Opus 5.5 tops with a 12% score (SemiAnalysis)
author: SemiAnalysis
article_content:
GDPx is a benchmark that covers the most valuable domains for frontier intelligence. It aims to be the world’s best benchmark for measuring general agentic capabilities.

We believe the first trillion dollars of AI revenue will be concentrated in sectors that can deploy frontier intelligence at high ROI, not broadly diffused throughout the whole economy. Building a general-purpose benchmark based on share of GDP or the SOC/O*NET occupational taxonomy is therefore a mistake. If your goal is to track the progress of frontier models, you should focus on the domains where they will be most impactful.

And intentionally forgo industries like government, real estate, and insurance.

GDPx is a true frontier-level benchmark: even the best model scores just 12%.

Source: GDPxIt’s worth emphasizing that certain models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra have sandbagged overall scores due to their safety classifiers. If we exclude cyber, biology, and alignment—the three domains where safety classifiers sometimes kick in—you get the following results instead.

Source: GDPxWe were pleasantly surprised by how well this ranking lines up with our subjective impression of the models. OpenAI and Anthropic generally dominate the top of the ranking while SpaceXAI, Meta, and open-weight models are all meaningfully behind. Gemini 4 Carbon is a real improvement from Google and the only model in the same ballpark as Opus and Astra. It will be interesting to see people’s impressions once Carbon becomes generally available.

We believe it’s underrated how relevant safety classifiers are when picking the best model for certain use cases. For example, Muse Wonder Full is actually the best available cyber model today by a meaningful margin.

Source: GDPxWe also generally observe meaningful spikiness across all leading models.
