title: Sources: Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier in three months and is building a second; Meta says it has no plans to sell these units (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
title_en: Sources: Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier in three months and is building a second; Meta says it has no plans to sell these units (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
author: The Information
content_snippet: Meta Platforms has built a prototype humanoid with Chinese robotics company Fourier and is already working on a second version …
summary_en: Meta Platforms collaborated with Chinese robotics firm Fourier to build a humanoid robot prototype in just three months and is developing a second version, while claiming no plans to commercialize them.
title_zh: 扎克伯格联手中国公司三个月造出人形机器人原型
summary_zh: Meta联手中国傅利叶智能在短短三个月内打造出首款人形机器人原型，目前正紧锣密鼓研发第二代并坚称不准备商业化售卖

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta Platforms在近期与中国机器人制造商傅利叶智能展开深度合作，在仅仅三个月内高效率拼凑出首款人形机器人原型并已着手打造第二代。由于大模型卷完软件开始卷物理世界，Meta急于在具身智能领域占坑，但又急忙放出“不卖”的免责声明来掩饰自己虚晃一枪的试探心态。

title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
title_en: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
Mark Zuckerberg's Meta made AI look so stinking cute by giving it a squishy little face - and this holiday season, he wants to sell you a Muse Charm so you can carry your jolly AI helper around like a Tamagotchi.

But I won't be buying one, because we have Muse Charm at home. It cost just $50, and I've decided the learning experience was worth it.

My version doesn't sport cameras or a 5G cellular radio, but it really talks to Muse and has cute avatars, too! It doubles as a pocket watch and a remote camera viewfinder, and it can (theoretically) control my smart home.

summary_en: In response to Meta's upcoming holiday AI charm, a tech enthusiast built a DIY $50 AI Tamagotchi alternative with voice interaction and smart home features to mock corporate pricing.
title_zh: 极客自制五十美元AI电子宠物怒怼大厂智商税
summary_zh: 面对Meta推出的节日季AI挂件新品，有开发者选择自行动手用50美元平替造出具备语音对话与智能家居控制功能的AI电子宠物

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对Meta计划在节日期间发售、主打可爱萌宠人设并随身携带的Muse Charm智能挂件，科技圈极客直接开启嘲讽并选择自己动手。这位开发者仅花费50美元就低成本复刻了具备语音交互、可爱头像甚至理论上能控制智能家居的“平替版AI电子宠物”，用实际行动给大厂高价硬件狠狠泼了一盆冷水。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: In response to Meta's upcoming holiday AI charm, a tech enthusiast built a DIY $50 AI Tamagotchi alternative with voice interaction and smart home features to mock corporate pricing.

elements_zh.what: 自制仅花50美元的AI电子宠物平替，具备语音对话、动态头像和理论上的智能家居控制能力
elements_zh.why: 不满大厂利用可爱外表和高溢价贩卖基础AI小挂件，试图用开源精神整顿硬件乱象

elements_en.what: Built a $50 AI Tamagotchi alternative featuring voice chat, cute avatars, and basic smart home control
elements_en.why: To protest tech giants overcharging for basic AI charms by proving it can be done on the cheap

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大厂琢磨着怎么把几十块的芯片套个可爱壳子卖你几百刀，独立极客反手就用五十块钱教大厂重新做人。说到底，AI的尽头不是什么赛博电子宠物，而是极客们看大厂笑话时的恶趣味。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Tech giants try to sell cute plastic charms loaded with basic chips for hundreds of dollars, while a indie hacker builds one for fifty bucks. At the end of the day, the true killer app of AI is watching big tech get punked by DIYers.

马克·扎克伯格的 Meta 通过赋予 AI 一张柔软的小脸，让 AI 看起来非常可爱——而在这个假期，他想向你推销一个 Muse Charm，这样你就可以像电子蛋一样带着你的快乐 AI 助手到处走。

title: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens (Angela Christy/Reuters)
title_en: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens (Angela Christy/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said on Saturday that it was able to cover 90% of the amount stolen during its recent hack.
summary_en: Binance has responded to a recent hack by confirming that it has utilized over $6.34 billion in corporate reserves to cover 90% of the losses. The remaining 10% involves illiquid tokens, which are still being processed as the exchange moves to restore user trust and platform reputation.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 币安针对近期发生的黑客攻击事件作出回应，表示目前已调用超过63.4亿美元的公司自有储备金覆盖了90%的受损金额。由于剩余10%的损失涉及流动性较差的代币，目前赔付工作尚处于处理阶段，旨在通过全额担责挽回平台信誉。

Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. title: How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, "not X, but Y" phrasing, and words like "delve", or add typos, to look human (Morgan Meaker/Bloomberg)
title_en: How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, "not X, but Y" phrasing, and words like "delve", or add typos, to look human (Morgan Meaker/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: As AI transforms writing and detectors like Pangram police what counts as machine-generated …
summary_en: Authors are increasingly avoiding em dashes, logical contrast patterns, and 'AI-favored' vocabulary like 'delve' in response to the rise of AI detectors such as Pangram. To evade false-positive flagging by these systems, writers are deliberately injecting typos and colloquial errors to prove their humanity through imperfection.
title_zh: AI检测器倒逼人类作家“变蠢”写作
summary_zh: 由于AI检测器如Pangram广泛应用，作家们为证明自己是人类，正被迫放弃精准句式，刻意加入拼写错误及口语化表达
article_content_zh:
随着大模型爆发，检测工具如Pangram已成为内容审核的标准动作。然而，这些工具往往将逻辑严密、结构清晰的文章判定为AI生成，导致人类写作者面临被贴标签的尴尬。为了自证，写作者开始反向工程，主动破坏文章的流畅度以获得“人味”。

这一趋势正在引发内容生产方式的异化。编辑部和学术界开始关注这种“为了过检测而降智”的现象，因为这种过度防御不仅降低了信息的传达效率，还在客观上扭曲了正常的学术沟通与文学创作标准。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 面对Pangram等AI检测器的普及，写作者在创作时开始刻意回避破折号、“非X即Y”逻辑句式及“delve”等被AI过度使用的词汇。为了不被系统误判为机器生成的文本，作者们甚至开始在文中人工植入拼写错误或语法瑕疵，以模拟人类的非完美表达特征。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Authors are increasingly avoiding em dashes, logical contrast patterns, and 'AI-favored' vocabulary like 'delve' in response to the rise of AI detectors such as Pangram. To evade false-positive flagging by these systems, writers are deliberately injecting typos and colloquial errors to prove their humanity through imperfection.

title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
title_en: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
author: Wired AI
article_content:
New research shared exclusively with Kernel Panic shows that hackers have started adding AI functionality into a new strain of infostealer malware, making it possible for the system to automatically profile victims and quickly surface the highest value targets and their information. Dubbed “Volta-Autodoxer” because of how the malware refers to itself internally, the finding by Cisco Talos researchers sheds light on the ways that commercial LLMs are being used to augment and enhance the capabilities of established types of malware.

“Volta is pretty mature as a stealer. It casts a pretty wide net for what it collects,” says Ryan Fetterman, a security researcher at Cisco Talos. “It compiles all of those things together, ultimately producing a serialized dossier that it can send to a couple LLM models. It’s asking the model to act like an intelligence analyst and produce structured citation-backed assessment of the victim. It’s like a prioritization and analysis function.”

Talos flagged the malware using its new CAIRN framework, built to identify hacking tools that incorporate AI capabilities. Fetterman notes that Talos did not track whether Volta has been used in the wild.

Once all of this is done, the malware feeds its findings into AI tools for analysis using OpenRouter, a service that can send prompts to multiple different AI providers. Volta defaults its requests to Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.6. But apparently preparing for the possibility that the model’s guardrails could block the activity, Volta is built with fallbacks to the Chinese open weight Moonshot AI Kimi K2 and, if that fails, Google’s Gemini 2.5 Flash. Building in fallbacks and relying on cost-effective, older-generation models are common techniques among attackers.

article_content_zh:
与 Kernel Panic 独家分享的新研究表明，黑客已开始将人工智能功能添加到新型信息窃取恶意软件中，使系统能够自动分析受害者并快速显示最高价值的目标及其信息。思科 Talos 研究人员的这一发现被称为“Volta-Autodoxer”，因为该恶意软件在内部如何称呼自己，它揭示了商业法学硕士用于增强和增强现有类型恶意软件功能的方式。

思科 Talos 的安全研究员 Ryan Fetterman 表示：“Volta 作为窃取者已经相当成熟。它为收集到的信息撒下了一张相当大的网。” “它将所有这些东西编译在一起，最终生成一个序列化档案，可以将其发送给几个法学硕士模型。它要求模型像情报分析师一样行事，并对受害者进行结构化的引用支持的评估。这就像优先级排序和分析功能。”

Talos 使用其新的 CAIRN 框架标记了该恶意软件，该框架旨在识别包含人工智能功能的黑客工具。 Fetterman 指出，Talos 并未追踪 Volta 是否已在野外使用。

一旦完成所有这些，恶意软件就会将其发现输入人工智能工具中，以便使用 OpenRouter 进行分析，OpenRouter 是一项可以向多个不同人工智能提供商发送提示的服务。 Volta 将其请求默认为 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.6。但显然是为该模型的护栏可能阻止活动的可能性做好了准备，Volta 的构建可以回溯到中国的开放式重量级 Moonshot AI Kimi K2，如果失败，则可以使用谷歌的 Gemini 2.5 Flash。构建后备系统并依赖具有成本效益的老一代模型是攻击者的常用技术。

Volta 的创建者提供了一个 240 字的提示，其中包括要点和编号列表，作为对分析所收集数据的法学硕士的指示的一部分。 “你是一名法医情报分析师，从结构化证据包中起草目标评估，”Volta 提示说。它指示聊天机器人生成有关此人的“执行摘要”、他们所做工作的详细信息、“他们的价值”以及“他们的操作安全”的摘要。它还补充说，聊天机器人应该“跨领域连接点”，例如检查某人的 Wi-Fi 密码是否与他们的姓氏匹配。 “要深入，而不是广泛，”提示说。

“这个提示经过精心设计，不会暗示任何明显的恶意，”费特曼说。 “但他们预计在第一次请求时可能会遇到模型拒绝的情况。因此，他们计划在整个链条中将故障转移级联到更允许的模型。而且还能够在没有人工智能的情况下仍然使用植入程序。人工智能调用有点超乎寻常，但恶意软件在没有人工智能的情况下仍然可以工作。”

一些低级网络犯罪分子和诈骗者抱怨人工智能充斥着网络犯罪论坛，但安全研究人员越来越多地发现其他黑客使用法学硕士来执行编码任务或分析大量被盗信息。例如，威胁情报公司 Crowdstrike 的研究人员最近告诉《连线》杂志，他们发现了四个复杂程度各异的黑客组织，分别以中文、西班牙语和英语、印度尼西亚语和俄语进行操作，使用人工智能工具危害世界各地的数十个目标，包括医疗保健、零售和旅游领域的政府实体和企业。

思科的 Fetterman 表示，Volta 包含一些线索，表明它可能是为了向一系列攻击者出售而构建的，而不是为某个特定参与者的活动而开发的。虽然恶意软件的核心仍然是传统的信息窃取者，但人工智能的扩展预示着未来更具侵入性和险恶的活动。

“如果你能够更快地识别你的高价值目标，你可能有更好的机会使用他们的凭据或使用被盗令牌进行身份验证，而如果你必须自己进行分类，”费特曼说，他提到了身份验证令牌会过期并且密码可以更改的事实。 “我们看到较低级别的攻击者可以使...

title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
title_en: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone.

The article Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams appeared first on The Decoder.

title_zh: 微软启动超六万人自愿离职，全力为AI基建腾挪现金流
summary_zh: 微软向约四分之一员工提供自愿离职方案，同时重点保护核心AI团队，以应对2026年高达1700亿美元的AI基建巨额投入
article_content_zh:
微软近期启动了新一轮大规模的人员结构优化，向高达6万名员工（约占其全球总员工数的四分之一）开放了自愿离职方案。这是微软在年内推出的第二项此类计划，显示出其在宏观成本控制上的急迫性。

尽管自2022年以来，微软的整体员工规模一直维持在22.3万人左右的平稳水平，但其战略重心的倾斜已经到了不加掩饰的地步。随着公司计划仅在2026年一年内就狂砸约1700亿美元用于构建AI基础设施，非AI核心业务的部门自然成了优化资本开支的首要牺牲品。

title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
title_en: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
author: Wired AI
article_content:
Meta’s Muse was among the hottest topics on corporate earnings calls in recent weeks. Meta has claimed that the agentic AI tool, which lets users automate various online tasks, is becoming a major force in shopping, with millions of people using it to make purchases of more than $200 on average.

Wall Street fears that proactive shopping assistants like Muse will erode brand loyalty, ignite price wars, and squeeze corporate profits. Yet on the earnings calls and in conversations with WIRED, executives across roughly 50 companies—spanning travel, internet providers, food, and self-storage—shrugged off immediate disruption. In fact, many insisted they would mostly benefit from any real widespread adoption of agents.

Food delivery app DoorDash described the number of orders from Muse and other agents as in the “hundreds.” T-Mobile remarked, “We haven’t seen anything of significance” from agents. Hotel chain Hilton was more direct, calling bookings from them “insignificant.” The banking provider Ally Financial characterized activity as “quite low,” while eBay termed it “very, very small.”

While financial experts have suspected that users may ask Muse to dump unused subscriptions and memberships, fitness chain Life Time Group said it has “seen zero” cancellations from agents. Public Storage and Hartford Insurance Group offered similar data. In India, the delivery app giant Eternal estimated agentic commerce as “close to zero.”

The comments leave questions about where users of Muse, Instinct, and other popular AI agents are spending their money. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said on his company’s earnings call this month that more than 10 million people in the US and Canada had activated Muse. Over 25 percent used it for shopping, more than any other task and above the company’s expectations, he added.

Meta declined to comment beyond the earnings call remarks, but pointed to partnerships with 10 retailers including Walmart, Best Buy, and Gap to simplify shopping with Muse....

article_content_zh:
Meta 的 Muse 是最近几周企业财报电话会议上最热门的话题之一。 Meta 声称，代理人工智能工具可以让用户自动执行各种在线任务，正在成为购物的主要力量，数百万人使用它平均购买超过 200 美元。

华尔街担心，像 Muse 这样主动的购物助理会削弱品牌忠诚度，引发价格战，并挤压企业利润。然而，在财报电话会议以及与《连线》杂志的对话中，大约 50 家公司（涵盖旅游、互联网提供商、食品和自助仓储）的高管对眼前的干扰不以为然。事实上，许多人坚称他们将从代理的真正广泛采用中受益。

食品配送应用 DoorDash 描述了来自 Muse 和其他代理商的订单数量为“数百”。 T-Mobile 表示，“我们没有从代理商那里看到任何重要的信息”。连锁酒店希尔顿则更为直接，称他们的预订“微不足道”。银行提供商 Ally Financial 将活动描述为“相当低”，而 eBay 则称其“非常非常小”。

尽管金融专家怀疑用户可能会要求 Muse 放弃未使用的订阅和会员资格，但健身连锁店 Life Time Group 表示，代理商的取消订单“为零”。 Public Storage 和 Hartford Insurance Group 提供了类似的数据。在印度，配送应用巨头 Eternal 估计代理商务“接近于零”。

这些评论引发了人们对 Muse、Instinct 和其他流行人工智能代理的用户将钱花在哪里的疑问。 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在本月的公司财报电话会议上表示，美国和加拿大有超过 1000 万人激活了 Muse。他补充说，超过 25% 的人用它来购物，比任何其他任务都多，也超出了公司的预期。

Meta 拒绝在财报电话会议之外发表评论，但指出与沃尔玛、百思买和 Gap 等 10 家零售商建立了合作伙伴关系，以简化 Muse 的购物流程。其中许多公司最后一次报告收益是在 Muse 推出之前，但尚未分享相关数据。

高管们普遍承认，代理商正处于早期阶段。但公众对人工智能技术的巨大焦虑迫使企业从一开始就寻找任何可以吸取的教训。

尽管看似缓慢，但一些人已经在努力为代理商优化他们的网站。 Chipotle 首席数字官阿莉·西森 (Arlie Sisson) 本周告诉记者，该连锁餐厅发现代理商由于忠诚度折扣或下班后订购出现问题而难以完成购买。她说，Muse 的首次亮相使代理订单增加了个位数百分比。因此，Chipotle 现在正在整理其网站代码，以帮助代理更好地导航并满足其背后饥饿的人们。

Doordash 也在进行类似的讨论，尽管首席执行官兼 Meta 董事会成员托尼·徐 (Tony Xu) 表示，目前有关代理商的炒作可能是“妄想”。 Costco 和 Extra Space Storage 表示，随着公司优化工具的在线内容，Gemini 和 ChatGPT 等人工智能聊天机器人的销售额正在激增，因此他们计划为人工智能代理做同样的事情。

对代理商的依赖可能会付出高昂的代价。扎克伯格表示，Meta 计划向企业收取 Muse 促成的交易费用，他预测这一收入来源最终将超过该公司庞大的广告业务。洲际酒店集团首席执行官 Elie Maalouf 在与 Meta 的持续谈判中采取谨慎态度。 “对于最终的合作（如果有的话），我们还没有得出任何结论，”他说。

代理商也有可能鼓励比较购物，从而损害利润。许多公司的高管否认了这个想法。他们表示，尽管人工参与较少，但产品质量、客户服务和品牌信任仍然会影响购买决策。

title: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
title_en: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations.

The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder.
content_snippet:
Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations.

The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: Google DeepMind and the World Resources Institute have launched ForTy, an AI-driven global forest map built on satellite imagery. The system categorizes global land cover into six forest types, including primary forests and plantations, designed to help organizations monitor deforestation in compliance with strict EU regulations. However, current benchmark data reveals that the model accurately detects only about half of planted forests and tree crops, and roughly 60% of commercial plantations, exposing severe accuracy bottlenecks for real-world enforcement.

title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
title_en: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
author: Wired AI
article_content:
If you give an AI agent a robotic arm, an injector, and a live mouse, it might just perform brain surgery.

Biotech founder Gabriel Ocana Santero recently did that using an agent to successfully carry out a brain injection procedure on a living mouse. Though it required some extra steps, it offers a glimpse into how AI could eventually become an active participant in laboratory research.

Santero posted about the experiment on social media and tells WIRED he was interested in exploring what happens when AI agents are given direct access to lab equipment, rather than simply being asked to design experiments or analyze results.

“We’ve realized that we need to connect these agents to a lab to get the maximum value from them,” he says. Santero is the CEO and cofounder of Exin Therapeutics, a San Francisco–based startup using AI to analyze brain activity to develop drugs for epilepsy and neurodegenerative diseases.

AI models are trained primarily on published scientific literature. That means they may miss important information about the research process, including failed experiments, unexpected observations, and decisions scientists make in real time. Integrating AI models with real-world experiments can make the models more reliable, Santero says.

It’s why his team decided to connect an AI agent to a custom-built surgical setup used for performing brain injections on mice. The rig included a motorized device used to immobilize a mouse and a camera that allowed the agent to observe the procedure, move an injection needle, and control the delivery of a compound. For the experiment, his team was testing a gene therapy to see whether it could reduce seizures in a mouse with epilepsy.

The rig is controlled by an AI agent as it conducts brain surgery on a mouse.

article_content_zh:
如果你给人工智能代理一个机械臂、一个注射器和一只活老鼠，它可能只会进行脑部手术。

生物技术创始人加布里埃尔·奥卡纳·桑特罗 (Gabriel Ocana Santero) 最近使用一种试剂成功地对活体小鼠进行了脑部注射手术。尽管它需要一些额外的步骤，但它让我们了解人工智能如何最终成为实验室研究的积极参与者。

Santero 在社交媒体上发布了有关该实验的信息，并告诉《连线》杂志，他有兴趣探索当人工智能代理直接访问实验室设备时会发生什么，而不是简单地被要求设计实验或分析结果。

“我们意识到我们需要将这些代理连接到实验室，以从它们中获得最大价值，”他说。 Santero 是 Exin Therapeutics 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是一家总部位于旧金山的初创公司，利用人工智能分析大脑活动来开发治疗癫痫和神经退行性疾病的药物。

人工智能模型主要根据已发表的科学文献进行训练。这意味着他们可能会错过有关研究过程的重要信息，包括失败的实验、意外的观察结果以及科学家实时做出的决策。 Santero 表示，将人工智能模型与现实世界的实验相结合可以使模型更加可靠。

这就是为什么他的团队决定将人工智能代理连接到用于对小鼠进行脑部注射的定制手术装置。该装置包括一个用于固定小鼠的机动装置和一个摄像头，使特工能够观察整个过程、移动注射针并控制化合物的输送。在实验中，他的团队正在测试一种基因疗法，看看它是否可以减少癫痫小鼠的癫痫发作。

该设备由人工智能代理控制，对小鼠进行脑部手术。

他们要求人工智能模型从电子表格的 19 个选项中选择一种治疗方法。兽医首先对老鼠进行了开颅手术，而人工智能代理则在旁观察。代理选择治疗、大脑区域和注射坐标，然后控制机械臂和注射针，以及所有参数，例如体积和速度。

该团队最初测试了 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5.5 模型，但它拒绝将针引导到小鼠的大脑中，这表明它可能会在手术中途停止，这可能会危及动物。

“他做了实验计划，但当注射的时候，他说，‘我的输出中的某些东西告诉我我不应该这样做，’”桑特罗说，指的是代理人。 “这非常有趣。”

该团队改用 Claude Sonnet 5，并同意继续进行。根据 Anthropic 的说法，Opus 是一种重推理智能专家，最适合解决复杂的多步骤问题，而 Sonnet 更适合日常任务，尽管将小鼠脑部手术称为常见的苦差事可能有些牵强。 （Anthropic 没有回应置评请求。）

前沿实验室一直在计划人工智能的更广泛的物理表现，研究人员已经开始招募代理在物理世界中做其他事情。 8 月，Anthropic 推出了一个框架，说明其模型如何与现实世界交互。最近，人工智能工程师让 GPT、Claude 和 Grok 负责一辆汽车去 In-N-Out Burger 取午餐。只有一种模型取得了成功。

大脑注射过程也并非一帆风顺。研究人员已经建立了保障措施，包括要求人工智能提出注射计划供人类批准，并安装一个人类可以按下的紧急按钮来断开钻机的电机。他们还限制代理对底层设备代码的访问，以防止其修改自己的操作规则。

然而，技术故障破坏了设备的坐标系。尽管代理正确地认识到计算出的注入位置是错误的，但它拒绝修改代码来纠正问题，因为它的指令明确禁止这样做。

该团队通过在 Opus 5 上使用单独的 AI 代理进行必要的代码更改来解决该问题，但他们没有告诉代理正在进行现场手术。由此产生的来回延迟了手术过程，桑特罗说：像这样的典型脑部注射手术大约需要 45 分钟，而这个实验持续了一个多小时。...

title: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
title_en: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI raised only about $11 billion in its latest funding round, less than half of the $30 billion it was targeting. At $1.25 trillion, the valuation falls short of expectations, and major investors appear to be pulling back amid the recent tech sell-off. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic is pushing to go public as early as November.

The article OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite appeared first on The Decoder.

title_zh: OpenAI最新融资仅募得110亿美元
summary_zh: 在科技股抛售潮与大厂投资意愿降温背景下，OpenAI最新一轮融资仅筹集到110亿美元，远低于300亿美元的目标
article_content_zh:
在最新一轮融资中，OpenAI仅获得了约110亿美元的资金注入，距离其激进的300亿美元目标相去甚远。在近期科技股遭遇抛售大背景下，这家明星初创企业的1.25万亿美元估值也令市场产生动摇，金主们的AI投资热情明显开始冷却。

与OpenAI的募资受挫形成鲜明对比的是，其主要竞争对手Anthropic正快马加鞭，积极筹备最早于今年11月进行首次公开募股（IPO），意图在资本风向变天前抢先登陆公开市场。

title: As AI models commoditize, lasting wealth will accrue to those controlling chokepoints like distribution, payment rails, and a stablecoin dollar, not to the labs (The Commanding Heights)
title_en: As AI models commoditize, lasting wealth will accrue to those controlling chokepoints like distribution, payment rails, and a stablecoin dollar, not to the labs (The Commanding Heights)
author: The Commanding Heights
article_content:
Shyam Sankar, Sriram Krishnan, Michael Kratsios, Jeff Huber, Patrick O’Shaughnessy, Ravi Gupta, Samay Shamdasani, John Aristotle Phillips, Jamie Cox, Zack Baker, Jeremy Giffon, John Fiorentino, Justin Mares, Nabeel Qureshi, Samir Unni, Clark Minor, Dan Ashton, Paul Rice, Austin Bishop, John G Kennedy, Nick Abouzeid, Alex & Talia Immerman, Chauncey Hamilton, Zann Ali, Lucas Vaz, Josh Buckley, Max Meyer, Tomás Pfeffer, John Dulin, Charlton Boyd, Ben Braverman, Louis Mosley, Zane Dille, Isabella Garcia-Camargo, Will Reed, Zoe Taylor, Bala Chandrasekaran, Chad Byers, Pratyush Buddiga, Salen Churi, Cody Kittle, and foreign correspondents C.S., D.P.M., and C.V.

Ravi wakes up at 5:56 AM to light tapping on the window. It is the rainy season, and his upper-middle-class apartment in Bellandur, which usually has such expansive views of Bangalore, is cloaked in fog. His wife is still asleep next to him, and he is careful not to wake her as he dresses. He clutches his buzzing phone.

Ravi is a proud graduate of the Indian Institute of Technology Madras, one of the top technical universities in India. He is among those who remained after graduating fourteen years ago. Others went to Europe, Canada, or America, but Ravi saw a bright future in the growing skyscrapers and the promise of nearly 1.5B Indians climbing up the ladder of modernization. He moved to Bangalore, fell in love, married, and had a daughter. He began doing systems implementation at a multinational firm that primarily did back-office accounting for American clients. He slowly rose up the corporate scale, promotion after promotion and incremental salary raises affording a better life than most. The rest of his career, his life, is laid out predictably before him like the table set he sees in the morning light as he moves through the kitchen, pouring tea.

The phone continues to buzz. His work has been speeding up and ballooning in scale. He’s managing delivery for five North American insurance clients. Usually it...

title_zh: 大模型沦为同质化商品：持久财富流向渠道与支付巨头而非研发实验室
summary_zh: 产业洞察指出AI模型正快速走向商品化内卷，未来长期红利将被分发渠道与支付结算等咽喉要道把控者收割
article_content_zh:
当前AI产业正处于从技术崇拜向残酷商业现实过渡的关键分水岭。伴随开源模型的迅猛迭代与主流前沿模型评测跑分的无限趋近，大模型自身的‘智力溢价’正以超乎预期的速度蒸发，快速退化为类似电力与自来水的基础工业品。高昂的训练成本与不断受挤压的Token推理单价，使得纯粹依靠模型API调用的实验室面临严峻的毛利塌陷。

历史商业规律再次上演：当核心技术层趋向商品化，全产业链的剩余价值必然向两端的天然垄断要道汇聚。在新型智能化经济体中，这种咽喉要道具体具象化为拥有庞大现成用户心智的超级入口应用、主导跨国与Agent自主交易的支付清算底层，以及依托区块链技术运转的数字美元稳定币结算网络。

对于软件与服务企业而言，单纯接入或微调模型的护城河几近于无。能够将智能代理深嵌进高摩擦、强合规的资金流与工作流环节，并掌控最终交易闭环的系统，才能在生成式AI时代的‘淘金热’彻底降温后，成为真正坐地起价的商业收税官。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在围绕生成式人工智能商业化终局的产业研判中，科技战略智囊明确指出，前沿AI大模型正在不可逆地演变为廉价且同质化的大宗商品。随着各家模型性能差距迅速被开源与竞品抹平，单纯依赖底层模型研发的实验室正陷入高昂算力成本与价格内卷的泥潭，而长期超额利润与行业定价权将不可阻挡地沉淀在掌控终端分发网络、支付清算管道以及美元稳定币等基础设施卡位者手中。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: In a strategic evaluation of the AI industry's endgame, tech strategists revealed that frontier AI models are rapidly turning into commoditized utilities. As capability gaps narrow and inference margins compress, the long-term enterprise value will not belong to capital-intensive research labs, but will accrue to actors commanding structural chokepoints including native distribution networks, modern payment rails, and stablecoin architectures.

title_en: When talking about local inference, Sam Altman says supply-constrained DRAM is better used in data centers than sitting in PCs and "being used 5% of the time" (Andrew E. Freedman/Tom's Hardware)
author: Tom's Hardware
article_content:
With data centers full of RAM, your PC is apparently the problem.

When discussing local inference on home computers with open-source models, Altman discussed the assumption that people will be able to run local AI on their own computers, the ones they may already own or want to build. Then he explained why that's a bad idea (at the 29-minute mark):

"From a global allocation perspective, actually, it's quite terrible to have everybody have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer and being used 5% of the time," Altman said. "You want maximum utilization in the cloud if you're trying to deal with this very supply-constrained environment. And somehow many people's intuition is the opposite of that."

While OpenAI does have some open-source models, its primary business is in closed-source models that run in data centers, so he's really defending the company's business model.

OpenAI isn't exactly threatened by some laptops and gaming rigs just yet, but local AI could mean people one day paying less for subscriptions to models like GPT-6 Luna if they have the power to run them at home. Altman's talk suggests that the company would prefer that more RAM go to OpenAI's data centers rather than home computers, which also sparks enthusiast fears of not being able to own your own hardware or software, but rather rent an agent and a computer in the cloud.Some of what Altman is saying is based on an idea that data center buildouts won't slow down. It also assumes that RAM being used in AI data centers 24/7 is more worthwhile than RAM that is used for spreadsheets, web browsing, gaming, and maybe even local AI occasionally.The rest of the wide-ranging interview includes talk of this week's PHP vulnerabilities, sandboxing models in training, and OpenAI's research in mathematics.

title_zh: 奥特曼称个人电脑运行AI是资源浪费

article_content_zh:
对于充满 RAM 的数据中心，您的 PC 显然是问题所在。

在讨论具有开源模型的家用计算机上的本地推理时，Altman 讨论了这样的假设：人们将能够在自己的计算机上运行本地人工智能，这些计算机可能是他们已经拥有或想要构建的计算机。然后他解释了为什么这是一个坏主意（在 29 分钟处）：

Altman 表示：“实际上，从全球分配的角度来看，每个人都将大量全球供应有限的 DRAM 放在自己的计算机中，并且只有 5% 的时间被使用，这是非常可怕的。” “如果你试图应对这种供应非常有限的环境，你就需要最大限度地利用云。但不知何故，许多人的直觉与此相反。”

虽然 OpenAI 确实有一些开源模型，但其主要业务是在数据中心运行的闭源模型，因此他实际上是在捍卫公司的商业模式。

OpenAI 目前还没有受到某些笔记本电脑和游戏设备的威胁，但本地人工智能可能意味着，如果人们有能力在家运行 GPT-6 Luna 等模型，有一天他们可以花更少的钱订阅这些模型。 Altman 的演讲表明，该公司更愿意将更多 RAM 用于 OpenAI 的数据中心，而不是家用电脑，这也引发了狂热者的担忧，担心无法拥有自己的硬件或软件，而是在云中租用代理和计算机。 Altman 所说的一些内容是基于数据中心建设不会放缓的想法。它还假设在 AI 数据中心 24/7 中使用的 RAM 比用于电子表格、网页浏览、游戏，甚至偶尔用于本地 AI 的 RAM 更有价值。采访的其余内容包括本周的 PHP 漏洞、训练中的沙箱模型以及 OpenAI 的数学研究。

title: Sources: neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius, and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors demand tougher terms (Wall Street Journal)
title_en: Sources: neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius, and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors demand tougher terms (Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet: Lenders and investors are getting choosier about their bets and demanding stricter terms, as the AI build-out enters a new phase
summary_en: Neocloud providers CoreWeave, Nebius, and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors demand significantly stricter terms. Creditors are growing cautious over high-leverage GPU leasing models and the rapid depreciation of hardware assets. This credit freeze signals mounting Wall Street skepticism about whether secondary AI infrastructure players can maintain solvent cash flows amid soaring capital expenditure.
title_zh: 新型算力云遭遇融资寒冬 债券市场关门提高准入门槛
summary_zh: 多家新兴AI算力独角兽近期实质上被债券市场拒之门外，投资者担忧泡沫而大幅提高承销与借贷门槛

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 核心算力云服务商、星云科技以及恩思科等多家新兴AI云服务商近期在债券市场遭遇集体遇冷，实质上已被高杠杆发债融资的大门拒之门外。随着算力军备竞赛进入深水区，债券投资人与银行放贷机构对其重资产借贷模式日趋谨慎，开始提出极为苛刻的借贷与抵押条款。该现象背后是资本市场对算力转租模式产生流动性焦虑，高度担忧昂贵显卡的快速贬值风险与下游大模型客户现金流断裂可能引发的违约潮。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Neocloud providers CoreWeave, Nebius, and Nscale have effectively been shut out of the bond market in recent weeks as lenders and investors demand significantly stricter terms. Creditors are growing cautious over high-leverage GPU leasing models and the rapid depreciation of hardware assets. This credit freeze signals mounting Wall Street skepticism about whether secondary AI infrastructure players can maintain solvent cash flows amid soaring capital expenditure.

title: S&P downgraded Meta's outlook from stable to negative, citing high capex and negative free cash flow; META fell 15% in October, its worst month in four years (Jonathan Vanian/CNBC)
title_en: S&P downgraded Meta's outlook from stable to negative, citing high capex and negative free cash flow; META fell 15% in October, its worst month in four years (Jonathan Vanian/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Meta's outlook has been revised downward by S&P Global Ratings on concerns surrounding cash flow and AI spending.

The credit agency said Friday that the outlook reflects "uncertainty" about Meta's elevated capex and its negative free cash flow.

Meta's credit rating was revised from AA- stable to AA- negative, S&P said. S&Ps highest credit rating is AAA. Anything below BBB falls into the junk bond category.

The agency questioned "Meta's ability to monetize its AI investments" relative to its peers, which are also spending heavily on data center buildouts and going cash flow negative in the process.

Although Meta has recently debuted its Muse AI agent app and related foundation models, S&P said "it is unclear when these revenue streams will generate material contributions that exceed their rising costs over the next few years."

"We respectfully disagree with S&P's assertion about Meta's AI monetization capabilities," the spokesperson said in a statement. "We see significant product and business opportunities ahead of us, supporting our very strong credit profile."

Meta said in its third-quarter earnings report last week that it expects full-year capex to come in the range of $135 billion to $145 billion. The company also posted negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion, going in the red for the first time.

Investors sent Meta shares down 7% following the report despite a revenue beat. The stock finished October down 15%, its worst month in four years.

The company said on Monday that it plans to raise $95 billion to help fund its AI initiatives, with plans to first raise $35 billion in underwritten public equity offerings, followed by an additional $60 billion through an at-the-market program.

S&P said that while it expects Meta's capex growth to start "flattening out beginning in 2028," the agency is "less certain that it will curtail its spending as previously anticipated."

title_zh: 标普下调脸书母公司信用展望 巨额资本支出拖垮自由现金流
summary_zh: 标普将脸书母公司评级展望下调至负面，直指其激进的AI资本开支导致现金流转负且变现路径不明

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 标普全球评级机构正式将脸书母公司的长期信用评级展望从“稳定”调降至“负面”，维持其AA-主体评级，公司股价单月暴跌15%创下四年最差纪录。评级机构直指脸书持续激进拉升的人工智能资本开支已严重侵蚀资产负债表，导致自由现金流转为负数。尽管脸书接连推出开源基座模型及多款AI应用，但机构与市场普遍质疑其在庞大的数据中心算力吞吐下，何时能够形成超越高昂研发折旧成本的真实商业化盈利闭环。

Meta shares tumbled 15% in October, marking their steepest monthly drop in four years. S&P questioned Meta's ability to monetize its massive AI infrastructure investments compared to hyper-scaler rivals, warning that AI agent revenues remain uncertain against soaring data center operational costs.

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 小扎刚用开源模型和AI智能体给信徒画完了星辰大海，评级机构就带着冷冰冰的现金流欠条上门敲门了。一边是买芯片盖数据中心像开闸放水，一边是除了老本行广告费外根本找不出第二条能打的变现路径，华尔街这次连元宇宙2.0版的PPT都不打算认账了。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Mark Zuckerberg just finished painting a grand future of open-source models and AI agents, only for credit rating agencies to show up with cold, negative cash flow ledgers. Spending tens of billions on silicon while having zero demonstrable monetization outside of digital ads proves that Wall Street won't swallow Metaverse 2.0 without a real balance sheet.

article_content_zh:
由于对现金流和人工智能支出的担忧，标准普尔全球评级下调了 Meta 的前景。

该信贷机构周五表示，前景反映出 Meta 资本支出增加及其负自由现金流的“不确定性”。

标准普尔表示，Meta 的信用评级从 AA- 稳定调整为 AA- 负面。标准普尔最高信用评级为 AAA。任何低于 BBB 的债券都属于垃圾债券类别。

该机构质疑“Meta 将其人工智能投资货币化的能力”（相对于同行），这些同行也在数据中心建设上投入巨资，并在此过程中现金流为负。

尽管 Meta 最近推出了 Muse AI 代理应用程序和相关基础模型，但标准普尔表示，“目前尚不清楚这些收入流何时会产生超过未来几年不断上涨的成本的物质贡献。”

该发言人在一份声明中表示：“我们谨不同意标准普尔关于 Meta 人工智能货币化能力的说法。” “我们看到了重要的产品和商业机会，这支持了我们非常强大的信用状况。”

Meta 在上周的第三季度收益报告中表示，预计全年资本支出将在 1350 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间。该公司还公布了21.2亿美元的负自由现金流，首次出现亏损。

尽管营收超出预期，但报告发布后，投资者仍令 Meta 股价下跌 7%。该股 10 月份收盘下跌 15%，是四年来表现最差的一个月。

该公司周一表示，计划筹集 950 亿美元为其人工智能计划提供资金，计划首先通过承销的公开股票发行筹集 350 亿美元，随后通过市场计划筹集 600 亿美元。

标准普尔表示，虽然预计 Meta 的资本支出增长将“从 2028 年开始趋于平稳”，但该机构“不太确定是否会像之前预期的那样削减支出”。

观看：Mike Khouw 喜欢 Meta 财报后的这种期权策略。

title: John Ternus says Apple doesn't "want to ship AI for AI's sake" and that Tim Cook is "available to help wherever I ask" on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump (Steven Levy/Wired)
title_en: John Ternus says Apple doesn't "want to ship AI for AI's sake" and that Tim Cook is "available to help wherever I ask" on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump (Steven Levy/Wired)
author: Wired
article_content:
The brief ceremony introducing the new Macbook Pro this week was as low-key as the presenter, Apple’s new CEO John Ternus. He stepped onto the low stage at a Los Angeles event space with zero fanfare, said hi, and queued up a video showing the first touchscreen Mac. Then he released the modest crowd of journalists and creators to get hands-on with the new laptop and roam between eye-popping demos of music producers, filmmakers, photographers, and fashion designers using the laptop. Ternus, who at 51 is on the younger side of Apple’s top management, has been CEO for less than two months. But this launch and a series of other recent announcements have made one thing clear. With this new guy—if a 25-year Apple veteran could be considered new—it’s all about the products. Perhaps fittingly, the biggest noise of the presentation came when Ternus revealed that the new device restores the illumination to the Apple logo. Maybe that’s a symbol that in the age of AI, Apple is beaming out the message that hardware still rules.

A few minutes after the presentation, I sat down with Ternus, for the second time in two days. Steve Jobs used to grant me an audience after his famous keynotes, too. Ternus isn’t Jobs, of course, nor is he supposed to be. But who is he?

I first met Ternus in 2015, when I spent a day with him at Apple’s Input Design Lab, a testing facility in Cupertino. He’d risen to VP for Mac, iPad, Ecosystem, and Audio Engineering, and he struck me as affable and knowledgeable. (He spent four years right out of college at a virtual reality company, but he’s been at Apple ever since.) The peg to my story at the time was how this unknown manager conducted a Javert-like investigation to fix the weird sound a redesigned mouse made when sliding on a table.

That attention to detail was a legacy of Jobs’ perfectionism, which Tim Cook sustained as the next CEO. In the decade when Ternus overlapped with Jobs, he says he had only “a handful of interactions” with the founder. ...

article_content_zh:
本周推出新款 Macbook Pro 的简短仪式与主礼人苹果新任首席执行官 John Ternus 一样低调。他以零张扬的方式走上洛杉矶活动场地的低台，打了个招呼，然后排队观看了一段展示第一台触摸屏 Mac 的视频。然后，他放出了一小群记者和创作者，让他们亲身体验这款新笔记本电脑，并在音乐制作人、电影制作人、摄影师和时装设计师使用笔记本电脑进行令人眼花缭乱的演示之间漫游。特努斯现年 51 岁，是苹果高层管理人员中较为年轻的一员，他担任首席执行官还不到两个月。但这次发布和最近的一系列其他公告已经清楚地表明了一件事。对于这个新人来说——如果一个在苹果工作了 25 年的老员工可以被认为是新人的话——一切都与产品有关。也许恰如其分的是，当 Ternus 透露新设备恢复了苹果标志的照明时，演示中最大的噪音出现了。也许这象征着在人工智能时代，苹果正在传递硬件仍然占主导地位的信息。

演讲结束几分钟后，我与 Ternus 坐下来，这是两天内第二次。史蒂夫·乔布斯 (Steve Jobs) 也曾在他著名的主题演讲结束后邀请我来听。当然，特努斯不是乔布斯，他也不应该是乔布斯。但他是谁？

我第一次见到 Ternus 是在 2015 年，当时我在苹果的输入设计实验室（库比蒂诺的一个测试设施）和他一起度过了一天。他已升任 Mac、iPad、生态系统和音频工程副总裁，给我的印象是和蔼可亲、知识渊博。 （他大学毕业后在一家虚拟现实公司工作了四年，但从那时起他就一直在苹果工作。）当时我的故事的核心是，这位不知名的经理如何进行一项类似沙威的调查，以修复重新设计的鼠标在桌子上滑动时发出的奇怪声音。

对细节的关注是乔布斯完美主义的遗产，蒂姆·库克在担任下一任首席执行官时也继承了这一传统。在特纳斯与乔布斯重叠的十年里，他说自己与这位创始人只有“少量互动”。 “但我一直感觉自己像是史蒂夫教诲的学生，”特努斯说。 “能够与蒂姆密切合作，我非常幸运。”

到目前为止，Ternus 以其产品实力而闻名。苹果全球营销高级副总裁、在公司工作 40 年的资深人士格雷格·乔斯维亚克 (Greg Joswiak) 表示：“约翰天生对优秀产品有着敏锐的洞察力，而这正是苹果的本质。” “你不能教这个。”从某种意义上说，Ternus 的晋升与微软的萨蒂亚·纳德拉（Satya Nadella）类似，后者是另一位终身晋升到最高职位的人。但纳德拉被要求修复一个破碎的组织，而苹果已经持续了数十年。特努斯明确表示，他将成为连续性的引擎。这个词是他选择的关键，最重要的是解释了为什么蒂姆·库克和苹果董事会的其他成员对这个选择如此满意。

当我询问特努斯对成为公司领导者的看法时，他在苹果内部的地位就显而易见了。我问他欣赏哪些非苹果公司的首席执行官，他被难住了。 “我还没有真正考虑过这一点，”他说。我问是否有任何商业书籍对他产生了影响。 “不完全是，”他说。 “我当然读过书，但从与我共事的人身上可以学到很多东西。”事实上，每次我试图向特努斯明确他想在苹果公司留下什么印记时，他都会转移问题，并告诉我他将如何继续苹果公司对内部合作的承诺。

Ternus 的主要合作者可能是 Johny Srouji，他是该公司定制芯片的架构师，这一举措在过去十年推动了该公司的许多创新。 Srouri 表示，随着苹果公司将其硬件工程和技术组织与 Srouji 合并，他们的关系将会更加密切，并向 Ternus 汇报。 “约翰将成为一位伟大的首席执行官，”他说。 “他本质上是一个产品人，但苹果的秘密武器是 DNA、文化，这是不会改变的。记住，约翰...

title: Sources: Baseten is raising ~$2B in two tranches, one valuing it at $26B and the other at $30B; Baseten was valued at $13B in June after raising $1.5B (Bloomberg)
title_en: Sources: Baseten is raising ~$2B in two tranches, one valuing it at $26B and the other at $30B; Baseten was valued at $13B in June after raising $1.5B (Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Artificial intelligence startup Baseten is set to raise new funding that would more than double its valuation to about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the efforts.
summary_en: Artificial intelligence startup Baseten is preparing to raise approximately $2 billion in two tranches, valuing the company at $26 billion and $30 billion respectively. Having reached a $13 billion valuation in June following a $1.5 billion funding round, this planned transaction will more than double its valuation within months. The aggressive round highlights massive investor appetite for underlying AI inference and deployment infrastructure amid soaring enterprise workload demands.

title: Filing: Vancouver, WA-based Powerlattice, which makes a power delivery chiplet to reduce AI compute power needs by 50%+, raised $86M, after raising $31M in 2025 (Kurt Schlosser/GeekWire)

author: GeekWire
content_snippet: Powerlattice, a Vancouver, Wash.-based startup developing chips that cut the power demands of AI processors, has raised $86 million, according to an SEC filing on Friday.
summary_en: Powerlattice, a Washington-based startup, raised $86 million for its power delivery chiplets that claim to cut AI compute energy consumption by 50%. This follows a $31 million round earlier in 2025, highlighting investor urgency for energy-efficient AI hardware.

title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
title_en: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
author: Ars Technica
article_content:
An official extension for Anthropic’s Claude model was backdoored and threatened as many as 5,000 developers' machines, multiple sources reported Friday. Anthropic so far has yet to warn customers of the incident.

The compromised package was a VS Code extension available in the marketplace of Cursor, a maker of AI-assisted developer tools, the company said Friday. The malicious version, 2.1.313, subsequently affected “at most 5,000 users,” presumably when they either downloaded it or their systems automatically fetched and installed it. Anthropic pushed version 2.1.314 several hours after the previous version became available on Cursor, according to independent researcher Kevin Beaumont. Both Beaumont and the CTO and co-founder of security firm Phorian said that version 2.1.313 was distributed through Anthropic’s official account on Cursor. So far, neither Cursor nor Anthropic has explained how the attackers gained control of the account.

summary_en: A leading AI company's official account on a prominent developer tool marketplace was compromised, distributing a backdoored extension for nearly 12 hours and impacting up to 5,000 developers' workstations. title: Intel stock closed down 28.58% on Friday, its worst day since the 1970s and wiping ~$12B off US government's stake, after issuing weaker-than-expected guidance (CNBC)
title_en: Intel stock closed down 28.58% on Friday, its worst day since the 1970s and wiping ~$12B off US government's stake, after issuing weaker-than-expected guidance (CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Intel shares plummeted 29% on Friday, their worst day since the 1970s, after the chipmaker issued weaker-than-expected guidance due to a plant shutdown in Israel and ongoing softness in the PC market.

It's a major setback for CEO Lip-Bu Tan, who was hired in March 2025, and has since been on a campaign to revive the company after it missed out on the early years of the artificial intelligence boom.

Intel's plunge is also a big hit to the Trump administration, which led the U.S. government into taking a 10% stake in the company over a year ago. While it's still a profitable investment, the value of those holdings dropped by about $12 billion on Friday. Nvidia also took a big stake in Intel, and its stock dropped by about $6 billion in value.

Heading into Thursday's earnings report, Intel shares were up about 150% this year, buoyed by demand for central processors, which are becoming critical to agentic AI workloads. Analysts at D.A. Davidson downgraded the stock to neutral from buy on Friday in a report titled, "Not fixed yet."

"We understand the PC market is being impacted at the industry level," the analysts wrote. "However it is hard to justify the current multiple when weakness is so significant."

Amazon shares also sold off on Friday, slipping 1.4%, after the company reported a third-quarter miss on the top and bottom line while maintaining its capital expenditure forecast for 2026 of $220 billion. Amazon also reported negative free cash flow for the second consecutive quarter, and a big increase from the previous period.

The Nasdaq Composite slid 2.9%, capping off a week of rough tech earnings. Alphabet on Thursday suffered its worst day on record, plunging more than 12%. The stock fell again on Friday.

Other semiconductor names also notched declines. Chip giant Nvidia fell 4%, while Broadcom dropped more than 5% and mobile chipmaker Qualcomm tumbled 11%.

周五，英特尔股价暴跌 29%，这是自 1970 年代以来最糟糕的一天，此前该芯片制造商因以色列工厂关闭和 PC 市场持续疲软而发布了弱于预期的指引。

这对 2025 年 3 月上任的首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 来说是一个重大挫折，在错过了人工智能热潮的早期阶段后，他一直致力于重振公司。

英特尔的暴跌对特朗普政府也是一个沉重打击，一年多前，美国政府就收购了该公司10%的股份。虽然这仍然是一项有利可图的投资，但周五所持股份的价值下降了约 120 亿美元。英伟达还持有英特尔大量股份，其股价下跌约 60 亿美元。

周四发布的收益报告显示，受中央处理器需求的提振，英特尔股价今年上涨了约 150%，中央处理器对于代理人工智能工作负载变得至关重要。 D.A. 分析师戴维森周五在一份题为“尚未修复”的报告中将该股评级从买入下调至中性。

分析师写道：“我们了解个人电脑市场正在受到行业层面的影响。” “然而，当疲软如此严重时，很难证明目前的市盈率是合理的。”

亚马逊股价周五也遭到抛售，下跌 1.4%，此前该公司报告第三季度营收和利润均未达标，但维持 2026 年资本支出预测为 2200 亿美元。亚马逊还报告称，自由现金流连续第二个季度为负，且较上一季度大幅增加。

纳斯达克综合指数下跌 2.9%，结束了一周糟糕的科技财报。 Alphabet 周四遭遇了有记录以来最糟糕的一天，暴跌超过 12%。该股周五再次下跌。

其他半导体品牌也出现下跌。芯片巨头英伟达(Nvidia)下跌4%，博通(Broadcom)下跌超过5%，移动芯片制造商高通(Qualcomm)下跌11%。

投资者对科技巨头在人工智能方面的巨额支出以及他们的投资能否获得回报越来越感到紧张。

Raymond James 首席市场策略师马特·奥顿 (Matt Orton) 周五在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目中表示：“我不认为现在是一个清算的时刻，但我认为投资者应该认真思考，尽管基本面强劲，但该领域的仓位仍然很拥挤。”

对于英特尔来说，令人失望的预测反映出个人电脑市场因内存和其他组件成本飙升而受到重创。 Counterpoint Research 的数据显示，第二季度全球个人电脑出货量同比下降 4%。

英特尔表示，预计本季度调整后每股收益为 25 美分，营收在 150 亿美元至 160 亿美元之间。据 LSEG 称，分析师预计营收为 171 亿美元，每股收益为 43 美分。

英特尔首席财务官戴维·津斯纳 (David Zinsner) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们认为个人电脑增速放缓至少会持续到明年上半年。” “我们将继续对产能和营运资本进行严格的投资，以增加供应并支持未来的增长。”

该指南还考虑了本月早些时候以色列一家晶圆厂发生爆炸造成的影响，该爆炸导致两名工人死亡，三分之一工人重伤。 Zinsner 表示，该事件将导致该公司在两个季度内损失约 6 亿美元的收入。

谭说，他称之为“不幸和悲剧性事故”的爆炸导致工厂“长时间停工”，影响了 10 纳米芯片的出货量。

谭的扭亏为盈的关键是英特尔的代工业务，该业务一直在努力寻找立足点。

英特尔是美国唯一一家先进逻辑芯片制造商，目前正在亚利桑那州的新工厂大批量生产最先进的 18A 芯片，为台积电提供替代方案。其位于亚利桑那州的工厂预计将于 2028 年底开始运营。

英特尔的新芯片仍然没有外部客户。

Tan 在电话会议上表示：“我们将有一些客户准备好在接下来的两个季度宣布这一消息。”他补充说，英特尔正在其即将推出的...

title: Reddit closed down 29.27% on Friday, the worst drop since becoming a public company in 2024, after it forecast weak Q4 revenue (Caleigh Keating/CNBC)
title_en: Reddit closed down 29.27% on Friday, the worst drop since becoming a public company in 2024, after it forecast weak Q4 revenue (Caleigh Keating/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Shares of Reddit cratered 29.22% on Friday, the worst drop since becoming a public company in 2024, after the company forecast weak fourth-quarter sales in its latest earnings report.

The previous record low was set on July 31, when the stock dropped 20.99%.

The social media company on Thursday projected fourth-quarter sales between $1 billion and $1.03 billion, below analysts' estimates of $1.05 billion. Reddit reported Q3 sales growth of 53% over a year ago, weaker than previous quarters, but beat Wall Street expectations on both earnings and revenue.

The report comes as the company has seen a shift in its search referral traffic with the rise of Google's AI Overview. In an interview with CNBC, Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said search-referral traffic from Google went "down meaningfully in this quarter" due to AI.

"Reddit is the last platform to provide basically unfettered logged-out access, and that's largely because of me. I've been holding that line," Huffman said. "I think users will probably go through the same understanding that I have, which is that it's a sign of the times. It's an evolution of how these platforms work."

— CNBC's Jonathan Vanian contributed to this report.

title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
title_en: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it.

title: Google says its Suncatcher prototype data center satellite is online after an October 1 launch, with Gemma 4 generating a haiku about being in space (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
title_en: Google says its Suncatcher prototype data center satellite is online after an October 1 launch, with Gemma 4 generating a haiku about being in space (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Google Suncatcher’s prototype space data center is online and communicating with the ground after launching earlier this month alongside more than 100 other spacecraft on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.

The satellite, which carries four Google Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) and generates up to 1 kW of electricity, is intended to pave the way for future networks of close-flying satellites performing large inference workloads in orbit. However, the power demands of the TPU mean it can only turn one on for about 20 minutes at a time, complicating the already tricky business of space-to-ground communications.

After a commissioning process that tested out the satellite’s subsystems over about three weeks, the spacecraft was ready to work. When engineers on the ground sent their first prompt this week, they asked the model pre-loaded onto the satellite, Google DeepMind’s Gemma 4, to write a haiku about being in space. And thus:

Blue marble belowData streams in silent graceStarlight feeds my core. ✨

Google said it tested the model with these space-themed limericks (they should have sent a poet?) and, perhaps more importantly, the company asked the spacecraft to report on the orbital conditions around the satellite.

A spokesperson told TechCrunch that the satellite was operating nominally.

The ongoing test campaign will examine how the chips perform under thermal stress and in the space radiation environment. Google has extensively tested its TPUs in particle accelerators on Earth, but now needs to see how radiation’s real effects on their hardware in space affect their processor. Radiation can cause “bit flips” — causing a stored value in computer memory — and that in turn can corrupt data without triggering typical monitoring tools.

Testing on the ground suggested the impact of radiation would be minimal for inference workloads and more of a problem for training a model, but now the Google team will get to assess those dynamics in reality, not a simulation.

这颗卫星搭载了四个谷歌张量处理单元 (TPU)，可产生高达 1 kW 的电力，旨在为未来在轨道上执行大量推理工作负载的近距离飞行卫星网络铺平道路。然而，TPU 的电力需求意味着它一次只能开启一个约 20 分钟，这使得本已棘手的空对地通信业务变得更加复杂。

经过大约三周的调试过程，对卫星的子系统进行了测试，航天器已准备好运行。当地面工程师本周发出第一个提示时，他们要求预装到卫星上的模型（谷歌 DeepMind 的 Gemma 4）写一首关于太空的俳句。因此：

下面的蓝色大理石数据流静静地优雅星光滋养着我的核心。 ✨

谷歌表示，它用这些太空主题的打油诗测试了模型（他们应该派出一位诗人？），也许更重要的是，该公司要求航天器报告卫星周围的轨道状况。

一位发言人告诉 TechCrunch，该卫星名义上正在运行。

正在进行的测试活动将检查芯片在热应力和太空辐射环境下的表现。谷歌已在地球上的粒子加速器中广泛测试了其 TPU，但现在需要了解辐射对太空硬件的实际影响如何影响其处理器。辐射会导致“位翻转”——导致计算机内存中存储的值——而这反过来又会在不触发典型监控工具的情况下损坏数据。

地面测试表明，辐射对推理工作负载的影响很小，而对于训练模型来说，辐射的影响更大，但现在谷歌团队将在现实中而不是模拟中评估这些动态。

如果该航天器上的 TPU 被证明有能力，下一步将在 2027 年发射另外两颗配备先进芯片的卫星。这些航天器将支持更高的发电并演示卫星间光链路。

在太空数据中心的愿景中，谷歌的 Suncatcher 项目在很大程度上是唯一一个规划卫星之间的高速链路以支持连贯的分布式工作负载的项目； SpaceX 的数据中心预计也将使用激光链路，但轨道距离太远，无法有效共享处理。 Starcloud 和 Cowboy Space 等公司希望在单个卫星上执行推理负载。

谷歌和 SpaceX 的愿景紧密相连。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 持有 SpaceX 的大量投资股份。为了启动他们的轨道数据中心，两家公司都需要星际飞船（埃隆·马斯克太空愿景中仍在开发的重型火箭）能够完全、快速地重复使用。

在本月早些时候发布的同行评审分析中，Suncatcher 研究人员估计 SpaceX 需要飞行 Starship 1,800 次才能实现与早期飞行器相同的学习驱动成本降低。 Suncatcher 是谷歌的经典登月计划——该公司的重点是设计 2030 年代经济的基础设施。然而，能否实现这一目标可能取决于公司其他部门在短期内如何应对人工智能的压力和机遇。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 在报告称将人工智能融入其搜索业务的努力正在损害广告收入增长后，本周股价暴跌。

更正：Suncatcher 原型卫星搭载了四个 TPU，但一次只能运行一个。

【起因与机理】探索太空作为AI算力部署空间的可能性
【关键数据与实测】谷歌Suncatcher实验卫星已成功在轨道运行，该卫星搭载了4个Tensor处理单元（TPU），旨在测试在太空执行大规模推理任务的可行性。

title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
title_en: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk.

title: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
title_en: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter.

The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder.
content_snippet:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter.

The article OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: OpenAI has restructured its Model Spec around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. The update forces GPT models to infer user needs from conversation history and disclose their logic.
title_zh: OpenAI重修AI行为准则
summary_zh: OpenAI更新模型规范，围绕人类意图和可修正性等五大核心价值观重构AI行为指导原则

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI更新了其模型规范（Model Spec），将AI行为准则重新架构为包括“忠实于人类意图”和“可修正性”在内的五大核心价值观。此举旨在要求模型利用对话历史推断用户真实意图并披露模型假设，以解决目前模型难以被完全管控的问题。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI has restructured its Model Spec around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. The update forces GPT models to infer user needs from conversation history and disclose their logic.

elements_zh.where: 模型规范（Model Spec）文档
elements_zh.what: 发布新的行为准则，要求AI理解人类意图并主动披露假设
elements_zh.why: 应对大模型行为难以预测和管控的长期顽疾

elements_en.what: Introduced new guidelines focusing on human intent and transparency
elements_en.why: To tackle the persistent issue of uncontrollable and unpredictable AI behavior

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 给AI立规矩就像给顽皮的猫讲道理，哪怕你写得再严谨，它该抓沙发的时候照抓不误。OpenAI与其说是给AI升级，不如说是给用户打好预防针：模型犯错时，它那是‘有理有据’地犯错。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Setting rules for an LLM is like lecturing a cat—it'll keep shredding the couch regardless of how eloquent your treatise is. OpenAI isn't just updating protocols; they're just pre-framing the excuse for when the model inevitably hallucinates.

article_content_zh:
OpenAI 更新了其模型规范，围绕五个核心价值观重组了人工智能行为指南，包括忠实于人类意图和可纠正性。 GPT 模型现在应该利用对话历史来找出用户真正想要什么并披露他们自己的假设。模型是否遵循这些规则是另一回事。

title: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
title_en: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Reddit lost over one million Google search referrals per week in October, CEO Steve Huffman said. The stock dropped more than 25 percent despite strong earnings. Huffman blames Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode for driving zero traffic to external sites. Reddit now tests login barriers and wants to become a direct destination, less reliant on the open web. The shift threatens every content-driven business that depends on search traffic.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Reddit首席执行官近期公开抨击谷歌的AI概览（AI Overviews）和AI模式，称其导致网站每周损失超过百万的搜索推荐流量。为应对这种“零点击”流量劫持，Reddit正测试登录墙等防御措施，试图将流量闭环为直接访问，而非依赖外部搜索引擎。

title: Sam Altman sympathizes with mathematicians, but says OpenAI’s math onslaught won’t stop

author: The Verge AI

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在播客访谈中，OpenAI首席执行官山姆·奥特曼针对数月来AI密集生成推演结果对数学界造成的验证冲击首次正面回应。他坦言十分同情疲于应付海量AI成果的数学家，但明确表态绝不会放缓脚步，并透露公司已储备了更多研究发现即将抛出。奥特曼强调人类理应看清宇宙运转规律，暗示学术界的消化不良不会动摇OpenAI持续释放技术推演的既定策略。

title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
title_en: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
author: THE DECODER
article_content:
Epoch AI researchers say the widely available AI model GLM 5.3 turned public security fixes into working exploits before updates reached Firefox users. It autonomously compromised six Firefox releases for about $1,000 in API fees each without triggering safeguards from any provider tested.

content_snippet:

title: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)
title_en: CXMT reports Q3 revenue of ~$16.7B, up 613.2% YoY, and a net profit of ~$8.17B, swinging to profitability on the back of rising AI-driven memory chip prices (Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: China's CXMT (688825.SS) said on Friday it swung to a net profit in the third quarter as surging AI-driven demand drove prices higher for its memory chips.
summary_en: CXMT reported Q3 revenue of $16.7 billion, a 613.2% year-on-year increase, with a net profit of $8.17 billion. Driven by the surge in demand for high-performance memory chips from AI model training and inference, the company successfully transitioned from losses to profitability as market prices rose.

title: NAND maker Kioxia reports FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with est., but forecasts Q3 operating profit of ~$12.7B, below ~$14.9B est. (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
title_en: NAND maker Kioxia reports FY Q2 operating profit up 22x YoY to ~$12.7B, in line with est., but forecasts Q3 operating profit of ~$12.7B, below ~$14.9B est. (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Kioxia Holdings Corp. delivered a profit outlook that trailed estimates, warning that an AI-fueled surge in flash memory chip prices …
summary_en: NAND flash maker Kioxia reported that its fiscal Q2 operating profit soared 22-fold year-over-year to approximately $12.7 billion, meeting market expectations. However, the company forecasted Q3 operating profit at a similar $12.7 billion, falling well short of Wall Street estimates of roughly $14.9 billion. The conservative outlook reflects lingering sluggishness in consumer electronics and ongoing client inventory management despite strong AI-driven enterprise demand.
title_zh: 铠侠二季度利润暴增22倍但下季指引逊于预期
summary_zh: 铠侠第二财季营业利润同比激增22倍符合预期，但给出的第三财季指引不及分析师预期，引发市场担忧

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 存储芯片巨头铠侠在最新财务会议上公布第二财季营业利润同比激增22倍至约12.7亿美元，与此前市场预期基本吻合。然而，公司给出的第三财季营业利润指引同样仅约12.7亿美元，显著落后于华尔街分析师普遍预期的14.9亿美元。受智能手机与PC消费终端复苏乏力、客户库存调整影响，即便有AI服务器拉动的高端闪存需求，铠侠对未来几个季度的盈利持续反弹仍持谨慎态度。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: NAND flash maker Kioxia reported that its fiscal Q2 operating profit soared 22-fold year-over-year to approximately $12.7 billion, meeting market expectations. The conservative outlook reflects lingering sluggishness in consumer electronics and ongoing client inventory management despite strong AI-driven enterprise demand.

elements_en.who: Flash memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings Corp.

elements_en.why: Cyclical recovery remains uneven, with strong AI enterprise demand overshadowed by sluggish smartphone and PC consumer markets

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 存储周期这把过山车，铠侠算是玩得明明白白：上一秒刚借着AI东风扭亏暴赚22倍，下一秒就立刻给资本市场泼了盆冷水。闪存大厂的算盘从来没变过，涨价时高喊产能吃紧疯狂敛财，给预期时立马哭诉消费电子寒冬，主打一个把周期操控权牢牢攥在自己手里。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Kioxia is playing the classic memory cycle playbook: riding the AI wave to deliver a headline-grabbing 22x profit jump, only to immediately pour cold water on Wall Street with weak guidance. Flash makers love nothing more than crying poverty about consumer demand right after pocketing windfall profits, keeping investors on their toes and market expectations artificially low.

title: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)
title_en: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta (META.O) was imposing exploitative terms …
summary_en: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has launched an antitrust investigation into Meta, examining whether the tech giant abused its market dominance to impose exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers. The regulator suspect Meta forced content creators to forfeit proprietary text and ad materials for training its AI models without fair compensation or viable opt-out options. This move marks an escalating regulatory crackdown on Big Tech scraping ecosystem content under the guise of platform service terms.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英国竞争与市场管理局正式对Meta启动反垄断立案调查，重点审查该公司是否滥用在社交媒体和数字广告领域的市场支配地位，对内容出版商与广告客户施加苛刻的剥削性条款。监管机构怀疑Meta强制将其平台上客户创作的新闻、文章和广告素材无偿或廉价捆绑用于自身AI大模型及算法服务的研发迭代。随着内容版权方与生成式AI阵营的摩擦加剧，监管部门正试图切断大厂利用平台生态优势巧取豪夺训练数据的行为路径。

title: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
title_en: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.

GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinicians, they can represent something sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

A new report suggests the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up by 71% between 1990 and 2023. And clinicians are already seeing GLP-1s exacerbate the issue.

title: Dream, which is training AI world models on US building data to automate construction design and engineering, emerges from stealth with a $17M seed led by a16z (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
title_en: Dream, which is training AI world models on US building data to automate construction design and engineering, emerges from stealth with a $17M seed led by a16z (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Andy Elder and Arjun Mathur were Stanford roommates who both studied computer science before spending a decade at Palantir. Elder led product design for a team of 800 people building software for U.S. defense and intelligence agencies, while Mathur served as a senior vice president in the company’s commercial practice. When the friends decided to build a startup early last year, there was no question they would do it together.

Despite having no direct background in architecture, Elder and Mathur were troubled by a growing problem: Fewer buildings are constructed in the U.S. today than a few decades ago, as development costs have surged.

“We’ve gone from dial-up internet to superintelligent AI, but our ability to build the physical world around us has actually decreased,” Mathur told TechCrunch.

Believing AI can boost productivity across the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, they set out to build Dream, a startup developing built world models that automate building design and engineering. Dream has emerged from stealth with $17 million in seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, alongside other backers, including SV Angel, XYZ, and Zigg Capital. The startup aims to replace cumbersome, outdated AEC tools like Autodesk’s AutoCAD and Revit.

If you sit next to an architect or a structural engineer, you’ll notice that they are still “drawing” every piece of their designs part by part on legacy software, Mathur said. “AI really plays no role in that equation.”

While a standard LLM like ChatGPT can generate an image of a building, the result won’t be structurally sound. Dream, by contrast, is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream’s world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

“Our model actually understands what’s within those walls. What materials are used, what the beams are made of, and how much weight ...

ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 搞国防大数据的Palantir老兵跨界来工地指点江山，指出的痛点倒极为讽刺：硅谷把人类送进了算力过剩的虚拟世界，现实中却连一栋像样的大楼都盖不起。不过比起自动化绘图，这套AI模型最先需要学会的可能不是算承重抗震，而是怎么帮开发商用AI写出厚厚一叠能够糊弄过美国市政审批委员会的合规套话。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Palantir veterans pivoting from defense data to the construction site hits on a hilarious irony: tech has brought us to superintelligent AI while making it too expensive to lay actual bricks. That said, before automating blueprint drafts, Dream's models better learn how to churn out the exact bureaucratic jargon required to pass local US zoning boards.

article_content_zh:
安迪·埃尔德 (Andy Elder) 和阿琼·马图尔 (Arjun Mathur) 是斯坦福大学的室友，他们在 Palantir 工作了十年之前都学习了计算机科学。埃尔德负责为美国国防和情报机构构建软件的 800 人团队的产品设计，而马图尔则担任公司商业业务的高级副总裁。当朋友们去年初决定创办一家初创公司时，毫无疑问他们会一起做。

尽管没有直接的建筑背景，埃尔德和马图尔却被一个日益严重的问题所困扰：随着开发成本的飙升，如今美国建造的建筑物比几十年前减少了。

“我们已经从拨号互联网发展到超级智能人工智能，但我们构建周围物理世界的能力实际上有所下降，”马图尔告诉 TechCrunch。

他们相信人工智能可以提高整个建筑、工程和施工 (AEC) 行业的生产力，因此着手建立 Dream，这是一家开发建筑世界模型的初创公司，可实现建筑设计和工程自动化。 Dream 已从隐秘状态中脱颖而出，获得了由 Andreessen Horowitz 领投的 1700 万美元种子资金，其他支持者包括 SV Angel、XYZ 和 Zigg Capital。该初创公司的目标是取代繁琐、过时的 AEC 工具，例如 Autodesk 的 AutoCAD 和 Revit。

马图尔说，如果你坐在建筑师或结构工程师旁边，你会注意到他们仍然在遗留软件上逐个部分地“绘制”他们的每一个设计。 “人工智能在这个等式中确实没有发挥任何作用。”

虽然像 ChatGPT 这样的标准法学硕士可以生成建筑物的图像，但结果在结构上并不健全。相比之下，梦想是基于真实的物理和建筑标准。正如法学硕士从文本中学习一样，Dream 的世界模型是根据从美国各地许可证档案中收集的超过 1 亿平方英尺的建筑数据进行训练的。

“我们的模型实际上了解这些墙内有什么。使用什么材料，梁是由什么制成的，以及它们可以支撑多少重量，”埃尔德说。

该初创公司将其方法称为“结构认知”，因为其模型生成结构精确的设计，考虑了管道和暖通空调等内部建筑元素。

据创始人称，Dream 已经开始向 AEC 专业人士和开发商销售其产品，他们使用该模型来概念化建筑设计并估算总体成本。该平台已部署在德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州的 10 个活跃项目中。

虽然 Dream 并不是唯一一家尝试用 AI 更新 AEC 软件的公司（其他致力于此的初创公司包括 Motif、Snaptrude 和 Arcol），但 Elder 和 Mathur 声称他们是唯一开发出可立即设计整个建筑的世界模型的公司。

Andreessen Horowitz 合伙人 Kimberly Tan 表示，虽然该公司一年多前首次投资 Dream，当时创业模式还只是一个想法，但他们的进展给她留下了极其深刻的印象。 “我还没有看到有人采取技术方法，”她说。 “他们所做的一切都是基于自己的模式。”

Marina Temkin 是 TechCrunch 的风险投资和初创企业记者。在加入 TechCrunch 之前，她为 PitchBook 和 Venture Capital Journal 撰写了有关风险投资的文章。在她职业生涯的早期，玛丽娜是一名金融分析师，并获得了特许金融分析师 (CFA) 资格。

title: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
title_en: Ravical, whose AI-powered platform helps accounting and tax firms manage their operations, raised a $17M seed led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25M (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
author: Tech.eu
content_snippet: As AI transforms the accounting industry, Ravical aims to help firms turn individual expertise into shared knowledge …
summary_en: Ravical, an AI-powered operational platform tailored for accounting and tax practices, has closed a $17 million seed round led by MMC, bringing its total funding to $25 million. The platform applies AI automation to streamline administrative operations, compliance reviews, and workflow orchestration for professional service firms. The funding comes amid increasing regulatory complexities and chronic talent shortages across the tax and accounting sectors.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 面向会计与税务专业机构的AI运营管理平台Ravical宣布完成由风险投资机构MMC领投的1700万美元新一轮种子融资，至此该公司的累计融资额已攀升至2500万美元。该平台专门整合财税业务流程，运用AI技术自动化处理复杂的会计操作流、合规排查与任务调度。随着全球税务政策频密调整以及财税专业人才严重断层，传统事务所长期被人工填表和琐碎核算拖累，该技术方案旨在帮其从机械性事务中脱身以保住业务利润率。

The funding comes amid increasing regulatory complexities and chronic talent shortages across the tax and accounting sectors.

title: Inside Nscale's 2,250-acre, 8GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, which has been hit by construction issues, local opposition, and financing risks (Financial Times)
title_en: Inside Nscale's 2,250-acre, 8GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia, which has been hit by construction issues, local opposition, and financing risks (Financial Times)
author: Financial Times
content_snippet: Nvidia-backed neocloud bets on West Virginia data centre campus hit by construction issues, local opposition and financing risks — NEW
summary_en: Nscale, an Nvidia-backed neocloud startup, has encountered major setbacks at its massive 2,250-acre, 8-gigawatt Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia. Designed to capitalize on explosive generative AI workloads, the project is now plagued by construction issues, fierce local community opposition, and looming financing risks. The ambitious venture highlights the severe friction between aggressive AI infrastructure buildouts and local electrical and economic realities.
title_zh: 英伟达参投算力新贵受挫 西弗吉尼亚超级园区遇阻
summary_zh: 算力服务商Nscale在西弗吉尼亚规划的8吉瓦超级数据中心遭遇施工延误、社区抗议与融资风险等多重阻击
article_content_zh:
随着前沿大语言模型参数规模呈指数级飙升，全球对AI专用数据中心的电力与物理空间需求达到了前所未有的狂热阶段。获英伟达深度技术支持的欧洲算力云服务商Nscale原本计划在西弗吉尼亚州打造全美乃至全球单体规模最大的计算枢纽之一——占地超过2250英亩、总规划功率达8吉瓦的“君主计算园区”（Monarch Compute Campus）。

然而，这一宏大蓝图在落地实施阶段却全面亮起红灯。现场工程不仅因复杂地形与基础设施配套缺陷遭遇严重的施工延期，当地居民和环保组织也因担心该设施对本地电网造成不可承受的负荷挤兑、推高民用电价以及带来持续性工业噪音，爆发了密集的公开抗议活动。雪上加霜的是，由于工期反复拖延和宏观利率居高不下，原本对该超级项目跃跃欲试的财团与信贷机构正收紧借贷条件，令项目面临严重的再融资风险。

业内人士指出，Nscale的挫折具有鲜明的行业代表性。伴随英伟达生态下众多“新云”（Neocloud）企业的野蛮生长，算力资本正以前所未有的速度试图在廉价能源聚集地圈地起楼，但电力传输扩容周期的漫长、本土政策审批的严苛以及重资产投资回报的不确定性，正成为阻遏这股AI基建热潮的最现实瓶颈。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 获英伟达支持的新兴算力云企业Nscale，在美国西弗吉尼亚州规划占地2250英亩、规模高达8吉瓦的“君主计算园区”项目陷入重重危机。该项目旨在承接爆发式的生成式AI算力需求，但在实际落地中接连遭遇现场施工故障、当地社区居民抗议以及巨额资金链吃紧等多重现实阻碍。超大规模AI基建的狂热扩张，正在电网承载力与地方现实博弈中直面严峻考验。

title: Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.
title_en: Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.
author: MIT Tech Review
article_content:
GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinical psychologists, they can represent something more sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

A new report suggests that the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up between 1990 and 2023—by a whopping 71%. By 2023, there were an estimated 18.1 million people living with one of these two disorders.

What’s worse is that the number is likely to be much higher than that once we factor in other eating disorders. And, disturbingly, those in the field are already starting to see GLP-1 weight-loss drugs exacerbating the issue.

content_snippet: Streaming service plans to charge users up to $5 a month to use the feature — Spotify is targeting an early 2027 launch …
summary_en: Global streaming giant Spotify is planning to roll out a generative AI product in the first quarter of 2027 that enables subscribers to produce remixes and covers for an additional fee of around $5 per month. The commercial launch hinges on successful music licensing agreements with major record labels. This initiative aims to unlock new subscription revenue streams while attempting to institutionalize and monetize user-generated remixes under compliant royalty structures.
title_zh: 声田拟推出AI音乐重混工具 用户每月或需额外支付五美元
summary_zh: 全球流媒体巨头声田正筹划在三年后推出AI音乐重混与翻唱功能，计划向订阅用户每月加收约五美元增值费

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 全球流媒体巨头声田计划于2027年第一季度推出一项全新的生成式AI产品，允许订阅用户直接生成歌曲的重混与翻唱版本，每月预计增收约5美元订阅费。该功能的最终落地将完全取决于平台能否与各大唱片公司敲定版权授权协议。声田此举旨在挖掘音乐流媒体的存量增值空间，并试图通过官方分润机制将草根二创收编为合规变现渠道。

This initiative aims to unlock new subscription revenue streams while attempting to institutionalize and monetize user-generated remixes under compliant royalty structures.

title: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
title_en: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion raid on cryptocurrency exchange Binance, according to US blockchain analysis firm TRM Labs.
summary_en: Security firm TRM Labs confirmed that the North Korea-linked hacker group TraderTraitor drained $6.36 billion from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains in just 20 minutes. Facing the largest crypto heist in history, Binance has publicly pledged to fully cover all user losses.

Facing the largest crypto heist in history, Binance has publicly pledged to fully cover all user losses.

title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
title_en: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
author: NBC News
content_snippet: The DeepSeek AI mobile app.Andrey Rudakov / Bloomberg via Getty Add NBC News to GoogleOct. 29, 2026, 6:00 PM EDTBy Kevin CollierChinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.
summary_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.
title_zh: 黑客利用深度求索等大模型工具 11天内猛攻两百家机构
summary_zh: 黑客组织利用集成了深度求索等大模型的AI工具，在11天内对全球超200家机构发动网络攻击并攻破至少9家
article_content_zh:
网络空间攻防对抗显示，黑客正在将开源大语言模型嵌入自研的自动化武器库中。在一款代号为ARTEX的攻击套件里，攻击者将深度求索（DeepSeek）大模型作为自动化侦察与脆弱性匹配的决策引擎，辅以其他模型进行代码微调，从而在极短时间内对海量网络节点完成指纹识别与漏洞探测。

这场历时仅11天的闪电式攻击波及了全球逾200家机构，并确认有至少9家关键实体的防御壁垒被撕破。相较于传统由高级渗透工程师逐一手工扫描、编写利用载荷的做法，大模型的介入将整个渗透前期的情报搜集与试错周期压缩了数个数量级。

该事件反映出生成式AI攻防失衡的现实困境：开源大模型的普及虽然让算力与模型获取成本剧烈下探，但也直接使具备初中级网络对抗能力的黑客组织获得了此前只有顶级国家级团队才拥有的高并发工业化渗透能力。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 黑客组织在近期攻击行动中利用名为ARTEX的自动化工具，集成了开源大模型深度求索（DeepSeek）及另一款模型，在短短11天内席卷全球200多家机构，并成功渗透攻破了至少9家目标。此次行动旨在通过大模型的自然语言处理与自动化代码生成能力，成百倍压缩侦察与漏洞利用的准备周期，展现了生成式AI将传统需要大批人力的网络渗透流水线化运作的破坏力。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.

elements_zh.who: 疑似具备特定国家背景的黑客组织与受害网络机构
elements_zh.where: 全球范围内的目标机构网络与云端服务器基础设施
elements_zh.what: 利用集成深度求索大模型的AI渗透工具，11天内高频攻击200余家机构并攻陷至少9家

elements_en.who: State-linked threat actors and targeted global organizations
elements_en.where: Global network infrastructures and organizational servers
elements_en.what: Weaponized an AI intrusion tool integrated with DeepSeek to assault 200+ targets in 11 days, breaching at least nine
elements_en.why: Leveraged low-cost, high-speed open-source AI reasoning to scale and industrialize reconnaissance and exploitation

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 硅谷大厂还在为大模型到底能不能代替实习生做PPT争得面红耳赤，黑客老哥们早已用开源模型跑出了惊人的投资回报率。深度求索主打一个极致性价比，没曾想先成了黑客流水线上的最佳“降本增效”利器——开源AI还没打倒闭源巨头，先让全球网络安防运维集体通宵加班了。
ai_analysis.insight_en: While Big Tech still squabbles over whether LLMs can reliably build slide decks, threat actors have already operationalized open-source models with brutal ROI. DeepSeek sold the world on extreme efficiency, only for adversaries to turn it into the ultimate automated exploit pipeline—keeping global IT defense teams awake all night.

title: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from "potential disruption" amid geopolitical tensions with China (Joseph C. Sternberg/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: S-1: Anthropic says it heavily depends on TSMC chips made in Taiwan and warns of risks from "potential disruption" amid geopolitical tensions with China (Joseph C. Sternberg/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America's top foreign policy interests.
summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a critical dependency on TSMC for AI chip manufacturing. The company warns that any potential supply chain disruption stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Taiwan Strait would pose a severe threat to its operational continuity.
title_zh: Anthropic披露严重依赖台积电
summary_zh: Anthropic在S-1文件中警告，其核心算力高度依赖台积电，台海地缘政治动荡构成重大运营风险
article_content_zh:
Anthropic在最新的上市申请材料中，将台积电明确列为关键风险因素。作为AI领域头部企业，其核心业务完全架构在尖端芯片之上，而目前全球具备该先进制程产能的厂商仅限台积电一家。

分析指出，这一表态不仅是出于上市合规的常规风险揭露，更揭示了当前科技巨头在算力军备竞赛中面临的集体焦虑：即便是估值数百亿的顶级AI厂商，在物理层面上仍极其脆弱，极度缺乏供应链的多样性冗余。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 人工智能初创公司Anthropic在上市招股书（S-1）中明确指出，其模型训练与推理严重依赖台积电的芯片代工。该公司强调，鉴于台海局势的复杂性，一旦供应链发生中断，其业务连续性和算力供应将面临毁灭性打击。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a critical dependency on TSMC for AI chip manufacturing. The company warns that any potential supply chain disruption stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Taiwan Strait would pose a severe threat to its operational continuity.

elements_zh.what: 披露对台积电芯片代工的高度依赖，并发出地缘政治风险预警
elements_zh.why: 满足监管合规要求，向投资者提示供应链稳定性风险

elements_en.what: Acknowledged heavy reliance on TSMC and warned of geopolitical supply chain risks

ai_analysis.insight_en: So much for the 'moat' of LLMs—it turns out the real barrier is just a geopolitical game of chicken. These AI unicorns aren't just selling intelligence; they're selling hopes that the world's most sensitive supply chain doesn't catch fire.

title: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
title_en: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. joined forces with one of the market operators behind offshore crypto-trading platform Hyperliquid …
summary_en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the NYSE, has taken an equity stake in Trade.xyz, a prominent market operator on decentralized platform Hyperliquid. The two partners plan to launch US-regulated perpetual futures markets built on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. This initiative reflects traditional finance's drive to capture booming crypto derivatives volume by integrating DeFi liquidity into Wall Street's regulatory framework.

title: Binance "temporarily suspended" all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates security issues and works with law enforcement; Binance.US says it's unaffected (George Steer/Financial Times)
title_en: Binance "temporarily suspended" all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates security issues and works with law enforcement; Binance.US says it's unaffected (George Steer/Financial Times)
author: Financial Times
content_snippet: Tether and Circle freeze billions of dollars' worth of their coins as world's largest crypto exchange investigates security issue
summary_en: Binance has abruptly suspended all cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals globally as it investigates an ongoing security incident and coordinates with law enforcement agencies. While Binance.US claimed its domestic operations remain unaffected, major stablecoin issuers have moved rapidly to freeze suspicious associated assets on-chain.

title: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours (Elias Schisgall/MarketWatch)
title_en: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours (Elias Schisgall/MarketWatch)
author: MarketWatch
content_snippet: Twilio lifted its full-year revenue growth outlook after the company reported a higher profit and revenue growth in the third quarter.
summary_en: Twilio reported Q3 revenue of $1.56 billion (up 20% YoY), beating estimates of $1.52 billion, alongside a 333% surge in net income to $161 million. However, despite raising its full-year guidance, projections of slower revenue growth for Q4 triggered investor anxiety, sending its stock plummeting over 15% in after-hours trading.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在最新公布的三季度财报中，云通信服务商Twilio营收同比增长20%达到15.6亿美元，超出市场预期的15.2亿美元，净利润同比暴涨333%至1.61亿美元。尽管公司上调了全年营收预期，但由于管理层给出相对疲软的第四季度增速预期，直接引发投资者对后续增长动能的担忧，导致其盘后股价瞬间崩跌超过15%。

In this brutal SaaS environment, past profitability means nothing unless you can legally promise investors that the growth miracle will never pause.
