article_content_zh:
Bluesky 正在阻止用户打开新泄露的超过 41,000 名国土安全部员工和承包商的记录档案的链接，并将这些页面标记为“恶意”。

Bluesky 告诉《连线》杂志，这些文件包括人们的电子邮件地址和电话号码，“未经授权就被共享”，这违反了其社区准则。该公司表示，它选择屏蔽这些链接，而不是删除个别帖子，“以避免限制公众讨论或限制更广泛的报道和评论。”

透明非营利组织“分布式否认秘密”周三公布的国土安全部记录列出了员工和承包商的姓名、联系信息以及内部团体的成员身份，在某些情况下与监视和卧底行动有关。 《连线》杂志的一项调查发现，这些文件详细列出了国土安全部的组织方式，从高级领导层到个人移民代理，在某些情况下似乎还显示了谁有权使用某些技术。

尝试通过 Bluesky 网站或应用程序打开存档的用户会登陆标有“已阻止链接”的页面，该页面表示该 URL 已被识别为“恶意”并出于安全考虑而被阻止。 Bluesky 没有回答有关封锁是否自动实施或是否有任何政府机构要求该公司限制访问数据的问题。

DDoSecrets 主页通常从 Bluesky 加载。至少有一款第三方应用程序 Klearsky 在没有任何警告的情况下打开了 DHS 档案的链接。

Bluesky 提倡一种去中心化的内容审核方法，让用户可以选择独立的服务来标记或过滤帖子。其当前的社区准则禁止共享“家庭地址、个人联系信息、财务或医疗数据或身份证明文件”。 （《连线》分析的国土安全部泄密预览显然包含与工作相关的联系信息，一位专家将其描述为将打印在“名片上”的详细信息。）同样的指导方针明确保护“与政府透明度和公职人员相关”的公共利益问题的“事实报道”。

Bluesky 于 2019 年作为 Twitter 研究项目启动，后来独立，并于 2024 年 2 月向公众开放。截至今年 8 月，它的注册账户已达 4500 万个，6 月份估计有 1040 万人使用其移动应用程序。 Automattic 的创始首席执行官托尼·施奈德 (Toni Schneider) 自联合创始人杰伊·格雷伯 (Jay Graber) 三月份辞职以来一直负责管理该公司。由于网络运行在开放协议上，外部开发人员可以构建自己的 Bluesky 应用程序并决定应用公司的哪些审核标签。

DDoSecrets 联合创始人艾玛·贝斯特 (Emma Best) 表示，这并不是社交媒体平台第一次错误地将该组织的网站标记为恶意或试图限制对其出版物的访问。 2020 年，在埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 收购和 X 品牌重塑之前，Twitter 暂停了 DDoSecrets 的账户，并在该组织发布了 BlueLeaks（来自数百个警察机构和融合中心的 269GB 内部记录宝库）后屏蔽了其网站的链接。贝斯特表示，科技平台经常屈服于政府压力，但坚称它们无法阻止信息传播。 “他们无法阻止信号，”他们说。

一个自称和平部的组织将这份名为“Icepick”的档案交给了 DDoSecrets 和记者 maia 纵火犯。 crimew 还建立了一个用于搜索记录的网站，Bluesky 也在其网站和应用程序中屏蔽了该网站。

至少 Bluesky 的一位竞争对手采取了不同的策略。在 X 上，X 母公司构建的 Grok 聊天机器人将好奇的用户引导至 Icepick 网站，将其描述为“经过清理的可搜索网络工具”，并表示可以通过 DDoSecrets 网站或 torrent 下载完整的数据集。 X 没有立即回应置评请求。

title: National Student Clearinghouse: US computer science enrollment fell 12%+ for undergrads and 10%+ for grad students this fall, as AI reduces coding jobs (Elizabeth Rembert/Bloomberg)
title_en: National Student Clearinghouse: US computer science enrollment fell 12%+ for undergrads and 10%+ for grad students this fall, as AI reduces coding jobs (Elizabeth Rembert/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Computer and information science departments at US colleges saw an exodus of students this fall, with enrollment declining more than 12% …
summary_en: The National Student Clearinghouse reports a sharp decline in U.S. computer science enrollment this fall, with undergrads and grad students falling by over 12% and 10% respectively. This shift stems from fears that AI's ability to automate coding tasks is eroding job prospects for entry-level developers.
title_zh: 美国计算机专业遇冷：AI冲击下生源锐减
summary_zh: 美国国家学生交流中心数据显示，受AI替代初级编码岗位影响，本硕计算机专业入学人数分别暴跌超12%与10%

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国国家学生交流中心发布最新秋季入学数据，显示计算机及信息科学专业的本科与研究生入学人数分别大幅下滑超过12%和10%。这一现象的深层背景在于生成式AI对初级程序员岗位的挤压，导致过去被视为“金饭碗”的编程专业吸引力断崖式下跌。

title: Google plans to expand "high-quality ads within AI Overviews in AI Mode" into international markets, as growth in its core search ad business slows (Lauren Forristal/TechCrunch)
title_en: Google plans to expand "high-quality ads within AI Overviews in AI Mode" into international markets, as growth in its core search ad business slows (Lauren Forristal/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Google is bringing ads in its AI-powered Search experiences to international markets, betting that generative AI can open up new revenue opportunities even as growth in its core search advertising business slows.

The announcement came Wednesday during Alphabet’s third-quarter earnings call, as the company reported $127.6 billion in revenue, up 25% year over year. But Search advertising growth continued to decelerate, and Alphabet shares fell 8% following the results.

Google Search revenue grew 12% year over year in the third quarter, down from 17% growth in the second quarter and 19% in the first quarter. The slowdown puts added pressure on Google to turn its expanding AI features into a meaningful source of advertising revenue.

“We are now scaling high-quality ads within AI overviews in AI mode to more users and queries,” Philipp Schindler, Google’s chief business officer, said during the call with investors. “This includes taking our monetization footprint global for the first time. Today, we’re announcing the expansion of ads in AI mode into international markets alongside multi-turn ads and AI mode in the U.S.”

Google says early results suggest the formats are working. Click-through rates for sponsored product listings in AI Mode are already comparable to those for organic listings, according to Schindler. The company’s user research also indicates that people find the ads relevant.

The move builds on Google’s May announcement of new Gemini-powered ad formats, including conversational discovery ads that respond to users’ questions and sponsored recommendations integrated into AI-generated answers.

Google CEO Sundar Pichai also said that Search queries grew at their fastest year-over-year rate in five years, though he did not disclose the exact growth rate. He credited AI features with changing how people use Search, including prompting longer and more complex queries.

title_zh: 随着核心搜索广告业务增长放缓，谷歌计划将“AI 模式下的 AI 概述中的高质量广告”扩展到国际市场
summary_zh: 面对核心搜索广告增速连续下滑的业绩阵痛，谷歌火速宣布将AI搜索摘要广告向全球市场全面铺开
article_content_zh:
谷歌在最新的第三季度业绩沟通中披露，尽管公司整体季度营收达到1276亿美元，实现了25%的同比增长，但其最具盈利韧性的搜索广告大盘增速却呈现持续放缓态势，单季增速从第一季度的19%与第二季度的17%进一步滑落至12%，引发资本市场抛售并导致母公司股价当即受挫下跌8%。

面对传统变现支柱的减速风险，管理层明确表示正在加速AI技术的商业化变现转化，正式将此前处于测试阶段的“AI概览模式高质广告”全面推展至全球海外市场。除常规静态摘要外，谷歌还同步向国际广告主开放基于多轮追问场景的原生交互广告位，试图在用户依靠大模型获取结构化答案的第一时间完成商业截流。

title: Samsung shares fall as much as 6.6% as a lack of a new shareholder return plan, higher capex, and its chip unit's profit miss weigh on investor sentiment (Bloomberg)
title_en: Samsung shares fall as much as 6.6% as a lack of a new shareholder return plan, higher capex, and its chip unit's profit miss weigh on investor sentiment (Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Samsung Electronics Co. shares reversed earlier gains to slide as much as 6.6% as the lack of a new shareholder return plan in its earnings disappointed investors.
summary_en: Samsung Electronics shares slumped as much as 6.6%, wiping out earlier gains following its latest earnings and business update. The steep selloff was triggered by the chip division missing profit expectations, paired with a surge in planned capex and the complete absence of a new shareholder return plan. Investors reacted swiftly, alarmed that massive cash outlays without immediate dividend or buyback offsets would heavily drag down near-term margins and cash flow.
title_zh: 芯片利润不达标且开支激增 三星股价重挫逾6%

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 三星电子在最新财报发布后股价盘中剧烈跳水，跌幅一度高达6.6%，抹平早盘全部涨幅。半导体芯片部门利润未达市场预期，加之公司大幅增加资本支出却未宣布任何新的股票回购或分红计划，直接引发了投资者的抛售狂潮。市场对巨额资本投入短期内难以变现、反而大幅稀释现金流和利润率的前景表现出强烈担忧。

Investors reacted swiftly, alarmed that massive cash outlays without immediate dividend or buyback offsets would heavily drag down near-term margins and cash flow.

title: Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers (Bloomberg)
title_en: Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers (Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Samsung Electronics Co. plans to hike spending more than 60% this year after selling out of high-end chips for 2027 …
summary_en: Samsung Electronics revealed an aggressive capacity expansion roadmap, projecting this year's capex to surge roughly 60% to approximately $63 billion. The company disclosed that its entire high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity is fully booked through 2027, backed by 10 signed long-term supply agreements with tier-one clients. This massive capital commitment represents an all-out effort to reclaim semiconductor supremacy lost to archrivals in the AI chip boom.
title_zh: 三星拟年砸630亿美元扩产 内存产能售罄至2027年
summary_zh: 三星电子计划将今年资本开支激增60%至630亿美元，其高带宽内存产能已售罄至2027年并锁定10份长期供应大单

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 三星电子公布了激进的产能扩张路线，预计今年资本支出将同比增长约60%，攀升至创纪录的约630亿美元。公司透露旗下用于人工智能算力的高带宽内存（HBM）全部产能已被各大科技巨头预订一空，排期直达2027年，并已正式签署10项关键客户的长期供货合约。这一前所未有的开支狂飙旨在全速夺回在先进制程存储领域被竞争对手抢占的失地。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Samsung Electronics revealed an aggressive capacity expansion roadmap, projecting this year's capex to surge roughly 60% to approximately $63 billion. The company disclosed that its entire high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity is fully booked through 2027, backed by 10 signed long-term supply agreements with tier-one clients. This massive capital commitment represents an all-out effort to reclaim semiconductor supremacy lost to archrivals in the AI chip boom.

elements_zh.where: 年度资本支出指引与先进封装制造布局规划中
elements_zh.what: 资本支出猛增约60%至630亿美元，高带宽内存产能至2027年售罄，锁定10份长期供应大单

elements_en.where: Annual capex guidance announcement and advanced packaging roadmap
elements_en.what: Plans to increase capex by ~60% to ~$63B with HBM sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term contracts signed
elements_en.why: Skyrocketing AI accelerator demand and the pressing urgency to leapfrog rivals in high-bandwidth memory

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 一口气砸下630亿美元造芯片，说明三星在HBM赛道被SK海力士压制得实在破了大防。产能排到2027年看似风光无两，但半导体行业周期向来残酷，一旦狂热的AI基建潮稍有降温，这台狂奔的重资产绞肉机随时可能反噬自己。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Dropping $63 billion in one shot proves just how badly Samsung was stung by SK Hynix in the HBM race. Being sold out through 2027 sounds invincible, but in the notoriously cyclical chip industry, overbuilding into a potential AI hype digestion could turn that shiny capex into an excruciating balance-sheet trap.

title: Google's search revenue rose 12% YoY to $63.25B in Q3 2026, down from 14.5% in Q3 2025, with Google attributing the slowdown to "lower monetization" in AI Mode (Simon Sharwood/The Register)
title_en: Google's search revenue rose 12% YoY to $63.25B in Q3 2026, down from 14.5% in Q3 2025, with Google attributing the slowdown to "lower monetization" in AI Mode (Simon Sharwood/The Register)
author: The Register
article_content:
Simon Sharwood Simon Sharwood APAC Editor Published thu 29 Oct 2026 // 01:12 UTC Make us preferred on Google READ MORE Please state the nature of the medical emergency: Google is building a robot medic for NASA 7 hours ago How Google fumbled the frontend with Angular 2 13 hours ago Big Red gets cozy with Google to offer TPUs to AI customers 1 day ago Microsoft releases emergency .NET security fixes for Google Brotli bug 2 days ago Nervous ISPs replace Chrome as strange consumers of DNS resources 8 days ago Shares in Google’s parent company Alphabet dived by almost ten percent on Wednesday, after the web giant admitted AI-powered searches earn it less money than it earns by serving ads with its old-school search engine.

Google’s revenue from search rose 12 percent year-over-year to $63.25 billion, a little lower than the 14.5 percent growth the company reported in last year’s Q3.

During Alphabet’s earnings call, chief business officer Philipp Schindler said the slowdown was caused by “lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode.”

That’s a worry given that Google is spending enormous sums on infrastructure. $51.4 billion went out the door in Q3, around two thirds of it going towards servers and networking equipment. The rest funded datacenter builds.

That spending appears to have impacted profitability, as Alphabet reported $26.17 billion net income for the quarter. Last year’s Q3, during which Google revenue was $102.35 billion, produced $35 billion net income.

“On AI Mode, many of these queries are upper funnel queries, allowing us to capture new, high-value commercial intent,” he told investors. “In addition, the majority of AI Mode queries are incremental, creating more monetization opportunities over time.”

Google tried to seize one of those opportunities today, by turning on ads alongside AI Mode searches around the world, after first testing them in the US only.

But for now, AI Mode searches aren’t as lucrative as Google’s existing search business, whic...

Given the massive $51.4 billion infrastructure spending, this gap between high AI costs and lower returns triggered a nearly 10% drop in stock price.

article_content_zh:
Simon Sharwood Simon Sharwood 亚太区编辑 发布于 2026 年 10 月 29 日// 01:12 UTC 让我们在 Google 上成为首选 阅读更多 请说明医疗紧急情况的性质： 7 小时前 Google 正在为 NASA 打造机器人医生 Google 如何用 Angular 2 摸索前端 13 小时前 Big Red 与 Google 合作，向 AI 客户提供 TPU 1 天前 Microsoft 针对 Google Brotli bug 发布了紧急 .NET 安全修复程序2 天前 紧张的 ISP 取代 Chrome 成为 DNS 资源的奇怪消费者 8 天前 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 的股价周三下跌了近 10%，此前这家网络巨头承认人工智能驱动的搜索赚的钱比通过其老式搜索引擎提供广告赚的钱少。

谷歌的搜索收入同比增长 12%，达到 632.5 亿美元，略低于该公司去年第三季度公布的 14.5% 的增幅。

在 Alphabet 的财报电话会议上，首席商务官菲利普·辛德勒 (Philipp Schindler) 表示，增长放缓的原因是“我们在人工智能模式下看到的货币化程度较低”。

鉴于谷歌在基础设施上投入巨资，这是一个令人担忧的问题。第三季度支出 514 亿美元，其中约三分之二流向服务器和网络设备。其余资金用于数据中心建设。

这些支出似乎影响了盈利能力，Alphabet 报告本季度净利润为 261.7 亿美元。去年第三季度，谷歌营收为 1023.5 亿美元，净利润为 350 亿美元。

“在人工智能模式下，许多查询都是漏斗上层查询，使我们能够捕捉新的、高价值的商业意图，”他告诉投资者。 “此外，大多数人工智能模式查询都是增量的，随着时间的推移会创造更多的盈利机会。”

谷歌今天试图抓住其中一个机会，在首次仅在美国进行测试后，在全球范围内与人工智能模式搜索一起打开广告。

但就目前而言，AI 模式搜索的利润还不如谷歌现有的搜索业务，后者带来的收入仅占 Alphabet 1258 亿美元季度收入的一半以下。

谷歌的云计算是其第二大收入来源，本季度收入为 247.5 亿美元，但它也遇到了麻烦，因为 Big G 没有足够的能力来服务所有客户。该公司已开始将一些客户工作负载转移给第三方，并警告称这将削弱其未来的利润率。

谷歌云首席执行官 Thomas Kurian 表示，该公司有超过 100 家公司使用其 TPU 芯片，并补充说“TPU 系统的所有库存都与承诺的合同相关”——这意味着谷歌可以看到一些收入来支付一些资本支出。该公司预计将在未来几个季度通过向第三方销售 TPU 获得收入。

CEO桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)对未来的人工智能收入充满乐观，指出谷歌的Gemini应用程序赢得10亿用户的速度比该公司历史上任何其他产品都要快，并赞扬了其模型的性能。他表示，谷歌正在快速开发代理人工智能工具，但首先将重点关注商业客户，“因为安全和治理的门槛非常高。”

他补充道：“下一步，我们将把这些功能引入搜索，当然也将引入 Gemini 应用程序上的十亿用户。”

皮查伊没有透露代理人工智能何时会进入搜索领域，也没有透露他是否预计它会避免人工智能模式已经造成的盈利问题。

然而，该公司还坚持今年 195-2050 亿美元的资本支出预测，并表示打算在 2027 年“大幅”增加支出。®

title: DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart (Ville Heiskanen/Bloomberg)
title_en: DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart (Ville Heiskanen/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: DoorDash Inc., the food delivery provider in talks to take over Instacart, moved its earnings release date forward by almost a week.
summary_en: DoorDash has unexpectedly moved its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to October 29, before market open. This shift is widely linked to the rumored $17 billion acquisition of Instacart, a strategic move to consolidate dominance in the local delivery market.

title: Fragment, which uses AI to resolve purchasing and payment issues across manufacturing datasets, emerges from stealth with $56M from 8VC and others (Chris Metinko/Axios)
title_en: Fragment, which uses AI to resolve purchasing and payment issues across manufacturing datasets, emerges from stealth with $56M from 8VC and others (Chris Metinko/Axios)
author: Axios
content_snippet: Procurement startup Fragment is exiting stealth with $56 million raised, CEO Pranav Mulgund tells Axios Pro exclusively.
summary_en: Procurement startup Fragment has officially emerged from stealth mode with $56 million in funding led by 8VC. The company has built an AI-powered automation platform specifically designed to reconcile purchasing, invoice matching, and payment discrepancies across fragmented manufacturing datasets. Faced with chronic supply-chain reconciliation delays and legacy ERP silos, Fragment aims to replace tedious manual bookkeeping with autonomous data-matching agents.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 搞通用大模型的还在卷谁写情诗更押韵，务实的VC已经把几千万美金砸给‘帮制造业工厂对账单’了。毕竟让AI在PPT里改变世界需要时间，但帮采购经理在乱成一团的Excel和老古董ERP里找回多付的货款，客户是真肯立刻掏钱买单。
ai_analysis.insight_en: While consumer AI startups are busy teaching chatbots to write poetry, smart venture capital is pouring tens of millions into solving the unsexy nightmare of factory invoice reconciliation. Automating messy procurement sheets in prehistoric ERPs might not sound romantic, but it's where real enterprise enterprise budgets actually live.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 制造业采购协同初创公司Fragment正式结束隐形运作状态，宣布完成总计5600万美元的早期融资，本轮融资由知名风投机构8VC领投。该平台开发了一套基于人工智能的自动化工作流，专门攻克制造业跨系统、跨数据集之间极其繁琐的采购核对与发票支付对账问题。制造业长期受困于不同供应商间数据孤岛和碎片化账目导致的结算延误与坏账风险，Fragment希望借助AI解析非结构化采购凭证来彻底取代传统人工对账流程。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Procurement startup Fragment has officially emerged from stealth mode with $56 million in funding led by 8VC. The company has built an AI-powered automation platform specifically designed to reconcile purchasing, invoice matching, and payment discrepancies across fragmented manufacturing datasets. Faced with chronic supply-chain reconciliation delays and legacy ERP silos, Fragment aims to replace tedious manual bookkeeping with autonomous data-matching agents.

title: How surging demand from AI hyperscalers has quintupled flash memory prices and shifted market and negotiating power from Apple to suppliers like Kioxia (Rolfe Winkler/Wall Street Journal)
title_en: How surging demand from AI hyperscalers has quintupled flash memory prices and shifted market and negotiating power from Apple to suppliers like Kioxia (Rolfe Winkler/Wall Street Journal)
author: Wall Street Journal
content_snippet: The iPhone maker for years bullied flash-storage makers into steep discounts—until AI hyperscalers bid up prices and gobbled up supply
summary_en: Surging demand for flash memory from AI hyperscalers has driven prices up fivefold, shifting power dynamics. Apple, which long bullied storage makers with aggressive pricing, has lost its bargaining leverage as suppliers now hold the cards.
title_zh: 闪存价格狂飙五倍，苹果痛失议价权
summary_zh: 由于AI大厂对存储需求激增，闪存价格暴涨五倍，存储厂商不再看苹果脸色，供需关系彻底逆转
article_content_zh:
苹果公司长期利用其庞大的采购规模，对闪存供应商实施严苛的价格压榨，这种单方面强势的“霸凌”模式在过去数年屡见不鲜。然而，AI浪潮下超大规模计算中心对高密度存储的需求爆炸，彻底重构了供需天平。

目前闪存价格已暴涨五倍，这使得供方完全扭转了博弈地位。铠侠等核心存储厂商不再需要卑微寻求苹果订单，而是有底气拒绝无理压价，苹果长期倚赖的低成本供应体系正面临严重的结构性崩塌。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 受AI超大规模数据中心扩建影响，闪存市场需求量呈爆发式增长，导致相关存储产品价格翻了五倍。长期习惯通过压价欺压供应商的苹果公司，如今被迫丧失议价主导权，存储厂商地位重回上风。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Surging demand for flash memory from AI hyperscalers has driven prices up fivefold, shifting power dynamics. Apple, which long bullied storage makers with aggressive pricing, has lost its bargaining leverage as suppliers now hold the cards.

title: Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
title_en: Samsung reports Q3 revenue up 127% YoY to a record ~$146.3B and a record operating profit up 783% to ~$80.5B, both roughly in line with estimates (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
South Korean tech giant Samsung Electronics on Thursday reported third-quarter operating profit that is broadly in line with analysts' expectations, as demand for advanced memory chips used in artificial intelligence applications continued to grow.

Following the announcement, Samsung shares were trading 5% lower.

The company plans to increase sales of advanced memory chips used in AI applications and secure long-term contracts to meet growing demand.

Samsung's revenue rose 126.88% year-on-year and 13.85% from the previous quarter, while operating profit rose 783.11% from a year earlier.

The company also announced 30 trillion won in cash dividends for the third quarter, equivalent to 4,601 won per common and preferred share.

The company plans to return another 55 trillion to 75 trillion won to shareholders this year through dividends and share buybacks, as the board will finalize the total shareholder returns and specific execution plans at a meeting scheduled for late January 2027.

Samsung said it became the first global technology company to top 100 trillion won in quarterly operating profit, while posting record revenue and profit for a fourth straight quarter.

Its semiconductor business reported 147.1 trillion won in revenue and 106.5 trillion won in operating profit, driven by strong demand for AI-related memory chips.

Furthermore, its memory business also achieved record quarterly revenue and operating profit, supported by a significant ramp-up in HBM4 sales and growing demand for server solid-state drives.

However, Josh Gilbert, lead analyst for APAC at investment platform eToro, appeared unaroused by the numbers, as the results failing to generate much enthusiasm in the market.

"Investors have been so spoilt by the AI trade that a record result is now treated as the bare minimum rather than a reason to celebrate," Gilbert said, adding that Samsung's chip business accounted for nearly all of its operating profit in the third quarter, highlighting its...

article_content_zh:
韩国科技巨头三星电子周四公布第三季度营业利润，基本符合分析师的预期，因为人工智能应用中使用的先进存储芯片的需求持续增长。

消息公布后，三星股价下跌 5%。

该公司计划增加用于人工智能应用的先进存储芯片的销量，并获得长期合同，以满足不断增长的需求。

三星营收同比增长126.88%，环比增长13.85%，营业利润同比增长783.11%。

该公司还宣布第三季度现金股息为30万亿韩元，相当于每股普通股和优先股4,601韩元。

该公司计划今年通过股息和股票回购向股东再返还55万亿至75万亿韩元，董事会将在定于2027年1月下旬举行的会议上最终确定股东总回报和具体执行计划。

三星表示，它成为第一家季度营业利润突破 100 万亿韩元的全球科技公司，同时连续第四个季度创下创纪录的收入和利润。

在人工智能相关存储芯片的强劲需求推动下，其半导体业务收入为 147.1 万亿韩元，营业利润为 106.5 万亿韩元。

此外，在 HBM4 销量大幅增长和服务器固态硬盘需求不断增长的支持下，其内存业务还实现了创纪录的季度收入和营业利润。

然而，投资平台 eToro 亚太区首席分析师乔什·吉尔伯特 (Josh Gilbert) 似乎对这些数字并不感兴趣，因为这些结果未能引起市场的太大热情。

吉尔伯特表示：“投资者已经被人工智能行业宠坏了，以至于创纪录的业绩现在被视为最低限度，而不是值得庆祝的理由。”他补充说，三星的芯片业务几乎占其第三季度的全部营业利润，突显其对存储芯片的依赖日益加深。

他表示：“尽管人们都在谈论三星是一家多元化巨头，但今天持有该股票的任何人实际上都持有一家附带手机业务的内存制造商。”他表示，该公司的命运现在在很大程度上取决于内存价格。

展望未来，该公司预计人工智能基础设施投资将在 2027 年加速，需求上升可能会进一步收紧内存供应。

三星还计划增加 HBM（一种用于人工智能芯片的高性能内存）以及用于服务器和数据存储的其他内存产品的销售。

第三季度，三星电子及其五家附属公司宣布对 KKR 支持的 Helix Digital Infrastructure 总共投资 10 亿美元。三星电子将投资 5 亿美元，其余资金来自其关联公司。

这家科技巨头还宣布与法国人工智能初创公司 Mistral AI 合作，在其半导体业务中使用人工智能技术，包括芯片设计和制造。该公司还领投了 Mistral 的 D 轮融资。

title: The personal data of 41,000+ DHS employees and contractors, including CBP and ICE agents, leaks online after hackers claim they breached DHS' Okta login system (Wired)
title_en: The personal data of 41,000+ DHS employees and contractors, including CBP and ICE agents, leaks online after hackers claim they breached DHS' Okta login system (Wired)
author: Wired
article_content:
An unprecedented leak of Department of Homeland Security records has exposed details of more than 41,000 employees or contractors who work for the department and its constituent agencies. The records include email addresses, phone numbers, and office addresses, but also references to internal systems and sensitive information on undercover and surveillance programs. In all, the leak provides a map of how DHS is organized and how it operates.

The records, which span DHS itself as well as seven component agencies, including Immigration and Customs Enforcement and US Customs and Border Protection, were last updated on August 19, 2026. The transparency nonprofit Distributed Denial of Secrets and cybersecurity researcher and journalist maia arson crimew previewed the data for WIRED, which they say they obtained from a group calling itself the Department of Peace.

An Okta spokesperson tells WIRED that it is unaware of any breach of its systems. “We are aware of this report. Okta is secure, and we have no evidence our data or systems were compromised,” the spokesperson says.

The leak comes as DHS has aggressively pursued its critics, seeking to unmask anonymous social media users, obtain customer records on protesters, and secure warrants for surveillance tools aimed at reporters. Since the start of the second Trump administration, DHS and the federal government have moved to hide DHS employees’ names and faces. The agency has also expanded its definition of “doxing”—a term that typically refers to publishing someone’s home address and other personal details for malicious purposes—to encompass the publication of basic facts about public employees, like their names and titles.

The leak follows a breach in which a group of hackers known as ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen personal information on nearly every FBI employee and their families. Law enforcement agencies have arrested several suspects and detained another who is alleged to be part of the group.

article_content_zh:
国土安全部记录史无前例地泄露，暴露了为该部门及其组成机构工作的 41,000 多名员工或承包商的详细信息。这些记录包括电子邮件地址、电话号码和办公室地址，还包括内部系统的引用以及有关卧底和监视计划的敏感信息。总而言之，此次泄密事件提供了国土安全部的组织和运作方式的地图。

这些记录涵盖国土安全部本身以及七个组成机构，包括移民和海关执法局以及美国海关和边境保护局，最后更新时间为 2026 年 8 月 19 日。透明非营利组织 Distributed Denial of Secrets 和网络安全研究员兼记者 Maia arson Crimew 为《连线》预览了这些数据，他们说这些数据是从一个自称为和平部的组织获得的。

Okta 发言人告诉《连线》杂志，该公司不知道其系统遭到任何破坏。 “我们知道这份报告。Okta 是安全的，我们没有证据表明我们的数据或系统受到损害，”发言人表示。

这次泄密事件发生之际，国土安全部正在积极追查批评者，试图揭露匿名社交媒体用户的身份，获取抗议者的客户记录，并获得针对记者的监控工具的授权。自特朗普第二届政府上台以来，国土安全部和联邦政府已采取行动隐藏国土安全部员工的姓名和面孔。该机构还扩大了“人肉搜索”的定义（该术语通常指出于恶意目的发布某人的家庭住址和其他个人详细信息），以涵盖发布有关公职人员的基本事实，例如他们的姓名和头衔。

此次泄密事件发生前，一群名为 ShinyHunters 的黑客声称窃取了几乎所有 FBI 员工及其家人的个人信息。执法机构逮捕了几名嫌疑人，并拘留了另一名据称是该组织成员的人。

国土安全部的记录可以在犯罪组织建立的网站上搜索。 “我认为我们不应该让他们吓到我们不调查他们，”她告诉《连线》杂志。

国土安全部和司法部没有回应《连线》杂志的置评请求。联邦调查局将《连线》杂志的调查转交给国土安全部。

根据《连线》对数据的分析，CBP 工作人员占了一半以上的记录。 ICE 约有 10,000 名员工，其中大约三分之一属于 ICE 的调查部门国土安全调查局。另外 6,200 人属于美国公民及移民服务局，近 1,000 人属于网络安全和基础设施安全局，其中一半以上是承包商。这些文件总共覆盖了国土安全部约七分之一的员工，揭示了国土安全部的结构，从高级领导层到个人移民代理和拘留承包商。

根据泄露的记录，与大多数大型组织一样，国土安全部使用权限组来控制对内部系统的访问。几乎泄漏中提到的每个人都可以访问至少其中一些系统。在 HSI，十多个现场办事处的 39 名员工属于名称中包含“CUC”的组织，政府法庭文件称“CUC”代表“经过认证的卧底行动”。另一个组织显然位于 HSI 的明尼苏达州圣保罗行动区，提到了“Keyhole”，联邦法院文件将其描述为经过认证的秘密行动，最近资助了 HSI 今年早些时候对明尼阿波利斯抗议团体的秘密监视。其他人提到了“通信拦截中心技术运营 (CICTO) 计划”、用于窃听的“第三章拦截计划”以及“非法传感器拦截计划 (ISIP)”。

这些团体的名称（总共超过 55,000 个）似乎是用于访问移民法庭记录、从被扣押的手机中提取数据以及进行监视的参考工具。其中包括 Palantir 的 Falcon 调查平台和分析电话记录和社交媒体的 PenLink。

名为“行政领导”和“人工智能访问”的两个权限组似乎列出了国土安全部网络过滤器的例外人员，该过滤器阻止了员工的某些网站。其中有 13 人，其中包括国土安全部前局长克里斯蒂·诺姆 (Kristi Noem)；最近离职的国土安全部首席...

title: Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22% (Tom Warren/The Verge)
title_en: Microsoft reports Q1 Xbox hardware revenue down 14% YoY, Xbox content and services revenue down 2%, and Windows OEM and Devices revenue down 22% (Tom Warren/The Verge)
author: The Verge
article_content:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Windows and Xbox revenues have declined during Microsoft’s first quarter of the 2027 financial year.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Microsoft just posted the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal financial results. The software maker made $92.3 billion in revenue and a net income of $33.6 billion during Q1. Revenue is up 19 percent, and net income has increased by 32 percent.

It’s a new financial year for Microsoft, so the company is changing up how it reports its finances by splitting its businesses into two segments for the first time. Gone are the previous segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. It’s now just Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer.

Agents and Infra, which includes businesses like Azure, Microsoft 365 commercial and consumer, and server products, makes up 83 percent ($76.8 billion) of the overall $92.3 billion of Microsoft’s revenue and has increased 25 percent year-over-year. The big changes to Microsoft’s financial reporting also mean we will now see the company disclose Azure revenue on a quarterly basis. Azure contributed $33.17 billion in revenue this quarter, up 48 percent year-over-year.

Devices and Consumer, which includes Windows, Xbox, Surface, and Microsoft’s search and advertising businesses, makes up the remaining 17 percent ($15.5 billion) of Microsoft’s $92.3 billion in revenues this quarter — a decrease of three percent.

Windows OEM and devices revenue is down 22 percent year-over-year, amid a RAMageddon crisis that has seen the overall PC market dropped by 20 percent in the recent quarter. Microsoft blames the revenue drop on the benefit of Windows 10 end of support during the prior year, as well as OEM inventory drawdowns and a weaker PC market.

title_zh: 微软Q1财报：硬件业务集体跳水

article_content_zh:

此次财报最大的变动在于组织结构的拆解，微软废除了原有的三大事业部，改为“代理与基础设施”以及“设备与消费者”。其中，包含Azure、Microsoft 365等核心业务的“代理与基础设施”部分贡献了总营收的83%，同比增长25%，成为财报绝对的“定海神针”。

content_snippet: Zillow (ZG.O) said on Wednesday it will pay $212.5 million in cash to settle a class action accusing the online real estate marketplace …
summary_en: Real estate giant Zillow has agreed to pay $212.5 million in cash to settle a long-running shareholder class-action lawsuit after the U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear its appeal. The lawsuit stemmed from the catastrophic collapse of its algorithmic home-flipping unit, Zillow Offers, which suffered massive forecasting failures and heavy losses. title: Sources: AI coding startup Cognition weighs a new funding round before year's end after receiving offers valuing it at $70B-$80B, up from $48B in September (Katie Roof/Business Insider)
title_en: Sources: AI coding startup Cognition weighs a new funding round before year's end after receiving offers valuing it at $70B-$80B, up from $48B in September (Katie Roof/Business Insider)
author: Business Insider
article_content:
Save Saved Listen to this story Founded in 2023 by Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan, Cognition is best known for Devin, an AI coding agent designed to automate software engineering tasks. The San Francisco-based company's existing investors include a16z, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, Elad Gil, and Pear VC.

Cognition's rapid valuation climb underscores the investor frenzy around AI coding, one of the hottest and most competitive corners of the AI market. As companies race to sell AI coding agents that can take on more of the work engineers do, investors are placing increasingly expensive bets on the few startups they think could emerge as leaders.

A $75 billion valuation wouldn't be so far-fetched, as SpaceX just acquired fellow AI coding giant Cursor for $60 billion a few months ago.

Last month, Cognition was drawn into a public feud with rival Factory AI, which accused Cognition employees of posing as job applicants to seek product information and faulted a former Factory adviser for meeting with Cognition executives. Cognition and the former adviser denied that confidential information was sought or shared.

Save Saved 听这个故事 Cognition 由 Scott Wu、Stevenhao 和 Walden Yan 于 2023 年创立，以 Devin 闻名，这是一种旨在自动化软件工程任务的人工智能编码代理。这家总部位于旧金山的公司现有投资者包括 a16z、Accel、Founders Fund、Khosla Ventures、Elad Gil 和 Pear VC。

Cognition 估值的快速攀升凸显了投资者对人工智能编码的狂热，这是人工智能市场最热门、竞争最激烈的领域之一。随着公司竞相出售可以承担更多工程师工作的人工智能编码代理，投资者对他们认为可能成为领导者的少数初创公司下了越来越大的赌注。

750 亿美元的估值并不是那么牵强，因为几个月前 SpaceX 刚刚以 600 亿美元收购了人工智能编码巨头 Cursor。

title: Alphabet reports Q3 negative free cash flow of $9.07B, worse than expected, capex of $51.36B, vs. $55.09B est., and keeps its FY capex forecast at $195B-$205B (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
title_en: Alphabet reports Q3 negative free cash flow of $9.07B, worse than expected, capex of $51.36B, vs. $55.09B est., and keeps its FY capex forecast at $195B-$205B (Samantha Subin/CNBC)
author: CNBC
article_content:
Alphabet shares slumped more than 10% after the search giant reported a drop in free cash flow during the third quarter, in a worrying sign for the artificial intelligence trade.

Revenue grew 25% from a year ago, but the company posted its first top-and-bottom-line miss in nearly four years.

Net income fell to $26.17 billion, or $2.12 per share, down from $34.98 billion, or $2.87 per share, a year ago.

The Google parent reported negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, which fell much further than the $2.70 billion expected by analysts.

As questions mount over heightened spending on the AI buildout, Alphabet's capital expenditures totaled $51.36 billion in Q3, falling short of the $55.09 billion expected by analysts. Investors are looking for a substantial return on investment to warrant the big spending plans from the hyperscalers.

Alphabet maintained its full-year capital expenditures forecast after lifting guidance to between $195 billion and $205 billion during the second quarter from $190 billion. Annual capex is expected to top $200 billion before exceeding $300 billion in 2027.

"We continue to expect our capex to increase significantly in 2027, and will provide further details on our Q4 call," finance chief Anat Ashkenazi told analysts during an earnings call.

The company's borrowing rose sharply during the quarter, with long-term debt climbing to $125.1 billion, up from $21.6 billion a year earlier — an increase of about 479%.

Operating income totaled $40.58 billion, missing a $43.19 billion forecast from FactSet.

Alphabet saw a $99.03 billion windfall in revenue from equity holdings in the second quarter, fueled by stakes in SpaceX and Anthropic. However, the category weighed on results in the third quarter, resulting in a loss of $8.66 billion.

The company continues to open its wallet to fuel the AI expansion, and that has contributed to strong revenue growth in its cloud division, home to its suite of AI offerings.

article_content_zh:
搜索巨头 Alphabet 公布第三季度自由现金流下降后，该公司股价下跌逾 10%，这是人工智能行业的一个令人担忧的迹象。

收入比一年前增长了 25%，但该公司近四年来首次出现营收和利润未达预期的情况。

净利润从一年前的 349.8 亿美元（即每股 2.87 美元）降至 261.7 亿美元（即每股 2.12 美元）。

谷歌母公司公布的自由现金流为负 90.7 亿美元，远低于分析师预期的 27 亿美元。

随着人工智能建设支出增加的问题越来越多，Alphabet 第三季度的资本支出总额为 513.6 亿美元，低于分析师预期的 550.9 亿美元。投资者正在寻求可观的投资回报，以保证超大规模企业的巨额支出计划。

Alphabet 维持全年资本支出预期，将第二季度资本支出指引从 1900 亿美元上调至 1950 亿美元至 2050 亿美元之间。年度资本支出预计将突破 2000 亿美元，并于 2027 年突破 3000 亿美元。

财务主管阿纳特·阿什肯纳齐 (Anat Ashkenazi) 在财报电话会议上对分析师表示：“我们仍然预计 2027 年的资本支出将大幅增加，并将在第四季度电话会议上提供更多细节。”

该公司的借款在本季度大幅增加，长期债务从去年同期的 216 亿美元攀升至 1,251 亿美元，增幅约为 479%。

营业收入总计 405.8 亿美元，低于 FactSet 预测的 431.9 亿美元。

在 SpaceX 和 Anthropic 股份的推动下，Alphabet 第二季度通过持有股权实现了 990.3 亿美元的意外收入。然而，该类别对第三季度业绩造成影响，导致亏损 86.6 亿美元。

该公司继续慷慨解囊，推动人工智能的扩张，这为其人工智能产品套件所在地的云部门带来了强劲的收入增长。

谷歌云首席执行官 Thomas Kurian 在首次公开财报电话会议上表示：“我们看到人工智能实验室、资本市场、金融服务机构和企业的巨大需求和强劲增长。”

云收入增长了一倍多，达到 307 亿美元，超过分析师预期的 287 亿美元。该公司继续从更大的竞争对手亚马逊网络服务和微软Azure手中夺取市场份额。

强劲的云计算业绩并没有摆脱谷歌大部分负面影响。

杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 分析师布伦特·希尔 (Brent Thill) 在 CNBC 节目《收盘钟声：加班》中表示：“云业务是唯一增长 103% 的业务。” “华尔街想要 100%，所以它并没有超出太多，而且它没有达到一些高端目标。其他一切都没有达到。”

该公司对人工智能模型的积极推动确实显示出消费者采用的迹象。谷歌表示，其 Gemini 应用程序已拥有 10 亿用户，使其成为其历史上增长最快的产品。

首席执行官 Sundar Pichai 告诉分析师，该公司已经看到对其最近推出的 Argon Gemini 模型的强劲需求。他补充说，周三宣布的碳迭代“几乎在每个领域”都优于氩。

Alphabet 的搜索收入增长 12%，达到 633.5 亿美元。这低于 649.6 亿美元的预期。皮查伊表示，该公司的人工智能投资推动了过去五年中最高的查询增长率。

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: Marvell Technology Inc. is in advanced talks to buy data center optics maker Lumentum Holdings Inc., according to people familiar with the matter …
summary_en: Semiconductor designer Marvell Technology is in advanced talks to acquire data center optics maker Lumentum, with a deal potentially announced as early as next week. title: eBay reports Q3 revenue up 14% YoY to $3.21B, above $3.12B est., and GMV up 15% to $23.17B, above $22.32B est.; EBAY jumps 4%+ after hours (Kelly Cloonan/Wall Street Journal)

author: Wall Street Journal

title: Filing: Microsoft recorded $10B in revenue from OpenAI in Q1, nearly 11% of its total quarterly revenue, and has $7.2B in outstanding receivables from OpenAI (Rebecca Bellan/TechCrunch)
title_en: Filing: Microsoft recorded $10B in revenue from OpenAI in Q1, nearly 11% of its total quarterly revenue, and has $7.2B in outstanding receivables from OpenAI (Rebecca Bellan/TechCrunch)
author: TechCrunch
article_content:
Microsoft generated $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ended September 30, the company said in regulatory filing on Wednesday. That represents nearly 11% of Microsoft’s total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion, highlighting the enormous financial ties that remain between the two companies even as they increasingly compete for the same customers.

For the full 2026 fiscal year, revenue from OpenAI hit $24.1 billion. At its latest quarterly pace, Microsoft would pull in $40 billion annually from OpenAI-related arrangements.

Microsoft also reported $7.2 billion in outstanding receivables from OpenAI at the end of September, up from $6 billion at the end of June. That money represents amounts OpenAI owes for previous transactions, not additional revenue.

It’s not clear how much of Microsoft’s revenue from OpenAI came from revenue-sharing payments or Azure cloud computing services. TechCrunch has reached out for more information. In November 2025, TechCrunch reported, citing leaked documents, that Microsoft had received $865.8 million in net revenue-sharing payments from OpenAI during the first nine months of that year.

OpenAI reportedly shares 20% of its revenue with Microsoft as part of a previous deal in which the software giant invested more than $13 billion in the AI startup. (Neither the AI lab nor Microsoft have publicly confirmed this percentage.) As part of an April 2026 agreement, OpenAI is on the hook to conitnue sharing revenue with Microsoft through 2030, subject to a cap, even as OpenAI is allowed to work with competing cloud providers.

The companies began loosening the ties of their once-exclusive partnership in October 2025, when Microsoft relinquished its hold on OpenAI to give the startup more freedom to partner with other cloud providers. In exchange, OpenAI committed to buying an additional $250 billion in Azure services as part of an October 2025 agreement.

title_zh: 微软单季从OpenAI吸金百亿美元
summary_zh: 微软披露最新财报，显示OpenAI带来的相关营收已占其季度总额的11%，双方财务捆绑深度远超外界预期
article_content_zh:
根据最新的财务披露，微软与OpenAI的商业捆绑深度已达到前所未有的程度。本季度从OpenAI获得的100亿美元营收，不仅支撑了微软财报的高增速，也显示出OpenAI作为AI基础设施重度消耗者对微软Azure云服务的绝对依赖。

分析指出，尽管微软与OpenAI在面向消费者的应用端存在竞争，但这种高达72亿美元的待收账款结构，使得双方在财务上实现了一荣俱荣、一损俱损的共生状态，这也是微软能够从容布局AI长跑的底气所在。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软在最新监管备案中披露，截至9月底的财季内，从OpenAI相关的商业安排中获得了100亿美元营收，占其923亿美元总营收的约11%。尽管双方在终端客户领域竞争日趋激烈，但微软账面上仍有高达72亿美元的待收账款，显示出双方深度绑定的金主与打工仔关系依然稳固。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Microsoft reported in a regulatory filing that it generated $10 billion from OpenAI-related arrangements in the quarter ending September, accounting for 11% of its total revenue. Despite growing competition, Microsoft holds $7.2 billion in outstanding receivables from OpenAI, underscoring their deep financial interdependence.

title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
title_en: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC
author: The Verge AI
article_content:
The MPC Sample Key isn't even formally announced yet, but Akai is already showing off what the modding community is cooking up through vibe coding. Akai has decided to embrace the explosion of hackers and custom firmware developers by giving them early access to the device, which will have open-source firmware.

It will likely run some version of the same software found on the MPC Sample, but with tweaks to accommodate the traditional keyboard, pitch, and mod wheels. Unlike the higher-end MPC Key 37, however, the Sample Key doesn't have pads. Instead, you play back samples with the keys.

Akai is strategically embracing the modding explosion to turn grassroots tinkering into an official competitive moat.
title_zh: 雅佳拥抱开源固件生态 新采样键盘未发先开放魔改
summary_zh: 电子乐器巨头雅佳宣布将为其尚未正式发布的采样键盘提供开源固件，并提前向民间极客社区开放硬件测试权限

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 知名音频硬件厂商雅佳在尚未正式发布全新采样键盘硬件前，便提前向第三方固件开发者与极客群体开放设备权限，并确认该设备将支持开源固件。新设备移除了传统的打击垫，改由全键盘触发采样并配备弯音轮，旨在通过开放底层软件生态，接纳社区正在兴起的氛围编程与个性化魔改热潮。面对民间日益庞大的越狱与自制固件诉求，厂商选择变防守为顺应，试图借开源极客之力构筑新型软硬件生态护城河。

The new device replaces traditional MPC pads with a playable keyboard and pitch/mod wheels, actively leaning into community-driven modifications and vibe coding. Akai is strategically embracing the modding explosion to turn grassroots tinkering into an official competitive moat.

title: ServiceNow reports Q3 subscription revenue up 21% YoY to $3.99B, forecasts Q4 current remaining performance obligations below est.; NOW drops 15%+ after hours (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)
title_en: ServiceNow reports Q3 subscription revenue up 21% YoY to $3.99B, forecasts Q4 current remaining performance obligations below est.; NOW drops 15%+ after hours (Brody Ford/Bloomberg)
author: Bloomberg
content_snippet: ServiceNow Inc. shares plunged after the company gave an outlook for quarterly subscription sales that met analysts' estimates …
summary_en: Enterprise cloud workflow provider ServiceNow reported Q3 subscription revenue grew 21% year-over-year to $3.99 billion, but issued Q4 current remaining performance obligations (cRPO) guidance that trailed Wall Street forecasts. The forward-looking shortfall sparked deep investor unease over enterprise IT spending velocity, sending its stock plummeting over 15% in after-hours trading.
title_zh: 企业软件巨头业绩指引欠佳 盘后股价应声大跌逾百分之十五
summary_zh: 企业级云服务巨头第四季度核心预收款指引未达华尔街预期，拖累盘后股价暴跌超15%

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 企业级工作流软件巨头在公布第三季度财报时显示，其订阅营收同比增长21%至39.9亿美元，整体表现平稳。然而，由于该公司对第四季度关键前瞻指标“当期剩余履约义务”的预测低于分析师预期，引发资本市场对企业IT支出放缓的强烈担忧，导致其股价在美股盘后交易中暴跌超过15%。在当前高估值与宏观紧缩双重压力下，华尔街对企业服务赛道的未来签单增速展现出极其苛刻的容错底线。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Enterprise cloud workflow provider ServiceNow reported Q3 subscription revenue grew 21% year-over-year to $3.99 billion, but issued Q4 current remaining performance obligations (cRPO) guidance that trailed Wall Street forecasts. The forward-looking shortfall sparked deep investor unease over enterprise IT spending velocity, sending its stock plummeting over 15% in after-hours trading.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 华尔街对SaaS巨头的规矩向来残忍：当期业绩超预期只是入场券，下季度的预收款指引只要少算了半个小数点，就立刻送你一个跌停大礼包。这年头吹再多‘AI赋能企业降本增效’的宏大叙事，也架不住现实中各大公司在续签千万大单时的犹豫不决。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Wall Street treats enterprise SaaS with zero mercy: beating current quarterly targets merely buys you admission, while a fraction-of-a-percent miss on forward pipeline guidance earns you an instant 15% haircut. No amount of shiny generative AI storytelling can hide corporate clients quietly tapping the brakes on multimillion-dollar contract renewals.
